using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api.Extensions;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiInfrastructure;
using NLog;
using NLog.Web;

var logger = LogManager.Setup().LoadConfigurationFromAppSettings().GetCurrentClassLogger();
logger.Debug("init main");

try
{
	var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

    // Add services to the container.
    builder.Services.AddServices(builder.Configuration);
	builder.Services.AddConfiguration<ConnectedServiceConfiguration>(builder.Configuration, "ConnectedServices");
	builder.Services.AddConfiguration<ApprovedAppsConfiguration>(builder.Configuration, "ApprovedApps");
	builder.Services.AddControllers();
	// Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
	builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
	builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

    // NLog: Setup NLog for Dependency injection
    builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
    builder.Logging.SetMinimumLevel(Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel.Trace);
    builder.Host.UseNLog();

    var app = builder.Build();

	// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
	if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
	{
		app.UseSwagger();
		app.UseSwaggerUI();
	}
    app.AppendHeader(ResponseHeaderConstants.ResponseHeaderDictionary);

    app.ConfigureExceptionHandler(app.Logger, ResponseHeaderConstants.ResponseHeaderDictionary);

    app.UseHttpsRedirection();

	app.UseAuthorization();

	app.MapControllers();

    app.Run();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    logger.Error(ex, "Stopped program because of exception");
    throw;
}
finally
{
    // Ensure to flush and stop internal timers/threads before application-exit (Avoid segmentation fault on Linux)
    LogManager.Shutdown();
}

using AspNetCoreRateLimit;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.Api.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.Api.Extensions;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.Services;
using NLog;
using NLog.Web;

var logger = LogManager.Setup().LoadConfigurationFromFile("nlog.config").GetCurrentClassLogger();
logger.Debug("init main");

try
{
    var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

    // Add services to the container.
    builder.Services.AddServices(builder.Configuration);
    builder.Services.AddControllers();
    // Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
    builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
    builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

    builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();

    builder.Services.Configure<IpRateLimitOptions>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("IpRateLimiting"));
    //builder.Services.Configure<IpRateLimitPolicies>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("IpRateLimitingPolicies"));

    builder.Services.AddSingleton<IIpPolicyStore, MemoryCacheIpPolicyStore>();
    builder.Services.AddSingleton<IRateLimitCounterStore, MemoryCacheRateLimitCounterStore>();
    builder.Services.AddSingleton<IRateLimitConfiguration, RateLimitConfiguration>();
    builder.Services.AddSingleton<IProcessingStrategy, AsyncKeyLockProcessingStrategy>();

    // NLog: Setup NLog for Dependency injection
    builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
    builder.Logging.SetMinimumLevel(Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel.Trace);
    builder.Host.UseNLog();

    builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();
    builder.Services.AddScoped<IRateLimitService, RateLimiteService>();

    MappedDiagnosticsContext.Set("applicationId", null);
    // Configure NLog Connection String from appsetting Json file.
    LogManager.Configuration.Variables["DefaultConnection"] = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString(AppConstants.DbConnectionStringName);

    var app = builder.Build();

    // Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
    if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
    {
        app.UseSwagger();
        app.UseSwaggerUI();
    }

    app.AppendHeader(ResponseHeaderConstants.ResponseHeaderDictionary);

    app.ConfigureExceptionHandler(app.Logger, ResponseHeaderConstants.ResponseHeaderDictionary);

    app.UseHttpsRedirection();

    app.UseRouting();

    app.UseIpRateLimiting();

    app.UseAuthorization();

    app.MapControllers();

    app.Run();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    logger.Error(ex, "Stopped program because of exception");
    throw;
}
finally
{
    // Ensure to flush and stop internal timers/threads before application-exit (Avoid segmentation fault on Linux)
    LogManager.Shutdown();
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Document;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Runtime;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Console
{
    internal class Program
    {
        private static string _orderNumber = string.Empty;

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            try
            {
                var documentRequest = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<DocumentRenderRequest>(args.First());

                _orderNumber = documentRequest.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber;

                var docExportService = new DocumentExportService(new LogService());

                var docDownloadResponse = docExportService.Export(documentRequest);

                System.Console.WriteLine($"{SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage}{docDownloadResponse.Base64String}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // var filePath = Path.Combine("C:\\temp", $"CommonApiSDKConsole-{DateTime.Today:yyyy-MM-dd}.txt");

                var message = $"Order Number:{_orderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";

                System.Console.WriteLine($"{message}");

                //using (var writer = File.AppendText(filePath))
                //{
                //    writer.WriteLine($"Time:{DateTime.Now:T}:{message}");
                //}
            }
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.AddressVerification;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api.Controllers
{
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [ApiController]
    public class AddressVerificationController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IAddressVerificationService _addressVerificationService;
        public AddressVerificationController(IAddressVerificationService addressVerificationService)
        {
            _addressVerificationService = addressVerificationService;
        }

        [HttpPut("VerifyAddress")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> VerifyAddress([FromBody] AddressVerificationRequest addressVerificationRequest)
        {
            var response = await _addressVerificationService.VerifyAddress(addressVerificationRequest);

            if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }
            if (!response.IsSuccess)
            {
                return NotFound("Could not verify address");
            }

            return Ok(response);
        }
        [HttpGet("GetCityStateByZipcode")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetCityStateByZipcode([FromQuery] AddressCityStateRequest addressCityStateRequest)
        {
            var response = await _addressVerificationService.GetCityStateByZipcode(addressCityStateRequest);

            if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }
            if (!response.IsSuccess)
            {
                return NotFound("Could not get city, state for the provided zip code");
            }

            return Ok(response);
        }
        [HttpPut("CorrectAddress")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CorrectAddress([FromBody] CorrectAddressRequest correctAddressRequest)
        {
            var response = await _addressVerificationService.CorrectAddress(correctAddressRequest);

            if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }

            return Ok(response);
        }
        [HttpPut("StandardizeAddress")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> StandardizeAddress([FromBody] StandardizeAddressRequest standardizeAddressRequest)
        {
            var response = await _addressVerificationService.StandardizeAddress(standardizeAddressRequest);

            if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }

            return Ok(response);
        }
        [HttpPut("CleanAddress")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CleanAddress([FromBody] CleanAddressRequest cleanAddressRequest)
        {
            var response = await _addressVerificationService.CleanAddress(cleanAddressRequest);          

            return Ok(response);
        }
        [HttpPut("CleanAddress2")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CleanAddress2([FromBody] CleanAddress2Request cleanAddressRequest)
        {
            var response = await _addressVerificationService.CleanAddress2(cleanAddressRequest);

            return Ok(response);
        }
    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ApplicationBuilderExtensions
    {
        public static IApplicationBuilder AppendHeader(this IApplicationBuilder builder,Dictionary<string,string> headers)
        {
            return builder.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                foreach (var header in headers)
                {
                    context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value); 
                }

                await next();
            });
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ConfigurationExtension
    {
        public static void AddConfiguration<T>(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration, string configurationTag = null) where T : class
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(configurationTag))
            {
                configurationTag = typeof(T).Name;
            }

            var instance = Activator.CreateInstance<T>();
            new ConfigureFromConfigurationOptions<T>(configuration.GetSection(configurationTag)).Configure(instance);
            services.AddSingleton(instance);
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\AddressVerification\FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api\Extensions\ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions.cs
=================================================

using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions
    {
        public static void ConfigureExceptionHandler(this IApplicationBuilder app, ILogger logger, Dictionary<string, string> headers = null)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler(appError =>
            {

                appError.Run(async context =>
                {
                    // Add custom headers to the response.
                    if (headers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var header in headers)
                        {
                            context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value);
                        }
                    }

                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

                    var contextFeature = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>();

                    if (contextFeature is not null)
                    {
                        logger.LogError(contextFeature.Error, contextFeature.Error.Message);

                        var internalServerJson = new ErrorDetails
                        {
                            StatusCode = context.Response.StatusCode,
                            Message = "Internal Server Error."
                        };

                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(internalServerJson);
                    }

                });
            });
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.AddressVerification;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiInfrastructure.ApiContracts;
using Refit;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Xml.Linq;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using System.Xml;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using System.ServiceModel;
using AddressCleansingService;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class AddressVerificationService : IAddressVerificationService
    {
        private readonly ServiceSoapClient _client;
        //private readonly IAddressVerificationApi _addressVerificationClient;
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;
        private readonly ConnectedServiceConfiguration _connectedServiceConfiguration;

        public AddressVerificationService(ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration, ConnectedServiceConfiguration connectedServiceConfiguration)
        {
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;
            _connectedServiceConfiguration = connectedServiceConfiguration;
            // _addressVerificationClient = RestService.For<IAddressVerificationApi>(connectedServiceConfiguration.AddressVerificationServiceBaseAddress);

            var binding = new BasicHttpBinding(BasicHttpSecurityMode.Transport);
            _client = new ServiceSoapClient(binding, new EndpointAddress(_connectedServiceConfiguration.AddressVerificationServiceBaseAddress));

        }
        public async Task<AddressVerificationResponse> VerifyAddress(AddressVerificationRequest addressVerificationRequest)
        {
            var addressVerificationResponse = new AddressVerificationResponse();

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != addressVerificationRequest.AppId))
            {
                addressVerificationResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (addressVerificationResponse.Messages.Any())
            {
                return addressVerificationResponse;
            }
            addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification = new AddressVerificationDTO();
            addressVerificationRequest.Zipcode ??= "";
            addressVerificationRequest.Address2 ??= "";
            addressVerificationRequest.County ??= "";

            // Map address request to API address request
            var apiRequest = new AddressVerificationApiRequest
            {
                address = addressVerificationRequest.Address,
                address2 = addressVerificationRequest.Address2,
                city_name = addressVerificationRequest.City,
                CountyName = addressVerificationRequest.County,
                state = addressVerificationRequest.State,
                zip_code = addressVerificationRequest.Zipcode,
                rtn_count = addressVerificationRequest.ReturnCount
            };

            // var addressVerificationAPIResponse = _addressVerificationClient.VerifyAddress(apiRequest).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

            var response = await _client.verify_addressAsync(apiRequest.address, apiRequest.address2, apiRequest.city_name, apiRequest.state, apiRequest.zip_code,
                 apiRequest.CountyName, apiRequest.rtn_count);

            string res = response.Body.verify_addressResult;

            var addressElement = XElement.Parse(res).Element("ADDRESS");

            if (addressElement != null)
            {
                var cassMessages = addressElement.Element("CASS_MESSAGES");

                if (cassMessages != null && cassMessages.Value == "1")
                {
                    addressVerificationResponse.IsSuccess = true;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.Address = addressElement.Element("ADDRESS").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.Address2 = addressElement.Element("ADDRESS_LINE2").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.City = addressElement.Element("CITY").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.County = addressElement.Element("COUNTY").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.State = addressElement.Element("STATE").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.Zipcode = addressElement.Element("POSTAL_CODE").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.PostalExtension = addressElement.Element("POSTAL_EXTENSION").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.StreetNumber = addressElement.Element("STREET_NUMBER").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.StreetType = addressElement.Element("STREET_TYPE").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.StreetName = addressElement.Element("STREET_NAME").Value;
                    addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification.ReturnCount = 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    addressVerificationResponse.IsSuccess = false;
                }
            }

            return addressVerificationResponse;
        }
        public async Task<AddressCityStateResponse> GetCityStateByZipcode(AddressCityStateRequest addressCityStateRequest)
        {
            const string successResponseCode = "703";
            AddressCityStateResponse response = new();

            if (!Regex.IsMatch(addressCityStateRequest.Zipcode, "^\\d{5}$"))
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid Zipcode, please provide valid Zipcode", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }
            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != addressCityStateRequest.AppId))
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return response;
            }

            // var apiResponse = await _addressVerificationClient.GetCityStateByZipcode(addressCityStateRequest.Zipcode);

            var getCityStateRespone = await _client.get_CityStateAsync(addressCityStateRequest.Zipcode);

            string res = getCityStateRespone.Body.get_CityStateResult;

            var xElement = XElement.Parse(res);

            var responseCode = xElement.Element("ADDRESS")?.Element("CASS_MESSAGES")?.Value;

            if (responseCode == successResponseCode)
            {
                response.City = xElement.Element("ADDRESS")?.Element("CITY_NAME")?.Value;
                response.State = xElement?.Element("ADDRESS")?.Element("STATE")?.Value;
                response.IsSuccess = true;
            }
            else
            {
                response.IsSuccess = false;
            }

            return response;
        }

        public async Task<CorrectAddressResponse> CorrectAddress(CorrectAddressRequest correctAddressRequest)
        {
            var response = new CorrectAddressResponse();

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != correctAddressRequest.AppId))
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return response;
            }
            response.CorrectAddress = new CorrectAddressDto();
            correctAddressRequest.Address ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.Country ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.State ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.CompanyName ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.SrtnFormat ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.Zipcode ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.Address2 ??= "";
            correctAddressRequest.County ??= "";

            // Map address request to API address request

            var apiRequest = new CorrectAddressApiRequest()

                address = correctAddressRequest.Address,
                address2 = correctAddressRequest.Address2,
                city_name = correctAddressRequest.City,
                CountyName = correctAddressRequest.County,
                state = correctAddressRequest.State,

                rtn_count = correctAddressRequest.ReturnCount,
                country = correctAddressRequest.Country,
                company_name = correctAddressRequest.CompanyName,
                srtn_format = correctAddressRequest.SrtnFormat

            };

            // var correctAddressApiResponse = _addressVerificationClient.CorrectAddress(apiRequest).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

            var correctAddressRespone = await _client.correct_addressAsync(apiRequest.company_name, apiRequest.address, apiRequest.address2, apiRequest.city_name,

            string res = correctAddressRespone.Body.correct_addressResult;

            if (addressElement != null)

                if (cassMessage != null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cassMessage.Value))
                {
                    response.IsSuccess = true;

                }
                else
                {
                    response.IsSuccess = false;
                }
            }

            return response;
        }

        public async Task<CleanAddressResponse> CleanAddress(CleanAddressRequest cleanAddressRequest)
        {
            CleanAddressResponse cleanAddressResponse = new()
            {
                CleanAddress = new()
            };

            var addressToClean = string.Empty;
            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != cleanAddressRequest.AppId))
            {
                cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cleanAddressRequest.Address))
                cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Address is required", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            else
                addressToClean = cleanAddressRequest.Address.Trim();

            if (cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Any())
            {
                return cleanAddressResponse;
            }

            var state = cleanAddressRequest.State;
            var splitAddresses = addressToClean.Split(' ');
            var zipCode = splitAddresses[^1];
            var postalCode = TryParsePostalCode(zipCode);
            var addressBeforeSplit = addressToClean;

            if (IsUsZipCode(zipCode))
            {
                AddressCityStateRequest addressCityStateRequest = new()
                {
                    AppId = cleanAddressRequest.AppId,
                    Zipcode = zipCode
                };
                var cityStateResponse = await GetCityStateByZipcode(addressCityStateRequest);

                if (cityStateResponse.IsSuccess)
                {
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = addressToClean.Replace(cityStateResponse.City, string.Empty).Replace(postalCode, string.Empty).Trim();
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = cityStateResponse.City;
                }
                else
                {

                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = addressToClean.Replace(postalCode, string.Empty).Trim();
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = string.Empty;
                }

                cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ToTitleCase(cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address.ToLower());
                cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ToTitleCase(cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City.ToLower());
                cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.State = state;
                cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Zipcode = postalCode;
                cleanAddressResponse.IsSuccess = true;
            }
            else
            {
                const int maxLoopCount = 2;
                var isValid = false;
                AddressVerificationDTO? verifiedAddress = new();
                var city = postalCode;
                addressToClean = addressToClean.Replace(city, string.Empty).Trim();

                // Following loop for address having city split by space.
                for (var i = 0; i < maxLoopCount; i++)
                {
                    AddressVerificationRequest addressVerificationRequest = new()
                    {
                        AppId = cleanAddressRequest.AppId,
                        Address = addressToClean,
                        County = cleanAddressRequest.County,
                        City = city,
                        State = state
                    };

                    var addressVerificationResponse = await VerifyAddress(addressVerificationRequest);

                    isValid = addressVerificationResponse.IsSuccess;
                    verifiedAddress = addressVerificationResponse.AddressVerification;

                    if (verifiedAddress == null) continue;

                    if (isValid)
                    {
                        break;
                    }

                    var fullCityName = string.Join(" ", splitAddresses.Skip(Math.Max(0, splitAddresses.Count() - maxLoopCount)).ToArray());
                    city = fullCityName;
                    addressToClean = addressBeforeSplit.Replace(fullCityName, string.Empty).Trim();
                }

                if (isValid)
                {
                    if (verifiedAddress is not null)
                    {
                        cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ToTitleCase(verifiedAddress.Address);
                        cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ToTitleCase(verifiedAddress.City);
                        cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Zipcode = verifiedAddress.Zipcode;
                        cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.State = state;
                    }
                    cleanAddressResponse.IsSuccess = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress = null;
                    cleanAddressResponse.IsSuccess = false;
                    cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Address correction failed", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                }
            }

            return cleanAddressResponse;
        }

        public async Task<CleanAddress2Response> CleanAddress2(CleanAddress2Request cleanAddressRequest)
        {
            CleanAddress2Response cleanAddressResponse = new()
            {
                CleanAddress = new()
            };

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != cleanAddressRequest.AppId))
            {
                cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cleanAddressRequest.Address))
                cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Address is required", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

            if (cleanAddressResponse.Messages.Any())
            {
                return cleanAddressResponse;
            }

            var addressToClean = cleanAddressRequest.Address.Trim().Replace(",", "").ToUpper();
            var splitAddresses = addressToClean.Split(' ');
            var zipCode = splitAddresses[^1];
            var postalCode = TryParsePostalCode(zipCode);

            if (IsUsZipCode(zipCode))
            {
                AddressCityStateRequest addressCityStateRequest = new()
                {
                    AppId = cleanAddressRequest.AppId,
                    Zipcode = postalCode
                };
                var cityStateResponse = await GetCityStateByZipcode(addressCityStateRequest);

                if (cityStateResponse is { IsSuccess: true })
                {
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = addressToClean.Replace(cityStateResponse.City ?? "", string.Empty).Replace(cityStateResponse.State ?? "", string.Empty).Replace(zipCode, string.Empty).Trim();
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = cityStateResponse.City;
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.State = cityStateResponse.State;
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Zipcode = postalCode;
                    cleanAddressResponse.IsSuccess = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var stateBySplit = "";

                    if (splitAddresses.Length >= 2)
                    {
                        stateBySplit = splitAddresses[^2];
                        addressToClean = addressToClean.Replace(stateBySplit, string.Empty);
                    }

                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = addressToClean.Replace(zipCode, string.Empty).Trim();
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = string.Empty;
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.State = stateBySplit;
                    cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Zipcode = postalCode;
                    cleanAddressResponse.IsSuccess = true;
                }

                cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ToTitleCase(cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.Address.ToLower());
                cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ToTitleCase(cleanAddressResponse.CleanAddress.City.ToLower());
            }

            return cleanAddressResponse;
        }
        private static bool IsUsZipCode(string zipCode)
        {
            return Regex.Match(zipCode, @"^\d{5}(?:[-\s]\d{4})?$").Success;
        }
        private static string TryParsePostalCode(string zipCode)
        {
            const int zipCodeMaxLength = 5;

            if (Regex.IsMatch(zipCode, "(^[0-9]{5}$)|(^[0-9]{9}$)|(^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{4}$)"))
                zipCode = zipCode[..zipCodeMaxLength];

            return zipCode;
        }
    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.GateWay.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ApplicationBuilderExtensions
    {
        public static IApplicationBuilder AppendHeader(this IApplicationBuilder builder,Dictionary<string,string> headers)
        {
            return builder.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                foreach (var header in headers)
                {
                    context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value); 
                }

                await next();
            });
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.GateWay.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ConfigurationExtension
    {
        public static void AddConfiguration<T>(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration, string configurationTag = null) where T : class
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(configurationTag))
            {
                configurationTag = typeof(T).Name;
            }

            var instance = Activator.CreateInstance<T>();
            new ConfigureFromConfigurationOptions<T>(configuration.GetSection(configurationTag)).Configure(instance);
            services.AddSingleton(instance);
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.GateWay.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions
    {
        public static void ConfigureExceptionHandler(this IApplicationBuilder app, ILogger logger, Dictionary<string, string> headers = null)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler(appError =>
            {

                appError.Run(async context =>
                {
                    // Add custom headers to the response.
                    if (headers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var header in headers)
                        {
                            context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value);
                        }
                    }

                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

                    var contextFeature = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>();

                    if (contextFeature is not null)
                    {
                        logger.LogError(contextFeature.Error, contextFeature.Error.Message);

                        var internalServerJson = new ErrorDetails
                        {
                            StatusCode = context.Response.StatusCode,
                            Message = "Internal Server Error."
                        };

                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(internalServerJson);
                    }

                });
            });
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Response;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.Api.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    public class TitlePointAuditLogDetailController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly ITitlePointAuditLogDetailService _titlePointAuditLogDetailService;
        private readonly IAuthorizationSevrice _authorizationService;
        private readonly IDownloadService _downloadService;
        private readonly IRateLimitService _rateLimiteService;
        

        public TitlePointAuditLogDetailController(
            ITitlePointAuditLogDetailService titlePointAuditLogDetailService, 
            IAuthorizationSevrice authorizationSevrice,
            IDownloadService downloadService, IRateLimitService rateLimiteService)
        {
            _titlePointAuditLogDetailService = titlePointAuditLogDetailService;
            _authorizationService = authorizationSevrice;
            _downloadService = downloadService;
            _rateLimiteService = rateLimiteService;
        }

        [HttpGet(Name = "GetAuditLogDetails")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAuditLogDetails()
        {
            var response = await _titlePointAuditLogDetailService.GetAuditLogsAsync();

            return Ok(response);

        }

        [HttpPost("SaveTitlePointAuditLogDetail")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveTitlePointAuditLogDetail([FromBody] TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest titlePointAuditLogDetail)
        {
            if (_rateLimiteService.IsLimiteExceeded(titlePointAuditLogDetail.ApplicationId ?? Guid.Empty, out string message))
            {
                return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests, message);
            }
            else
            {
                var response = await _titlePointAuditLogDetailService.SaveTitlePointAuditLogDetail(titlePointAuditLogDetail);
                if (response.HasErrors || response.HasValidationErrors)
                {
                    return BadRequest(response);
                }
                else
                    return Created("Record Created Successfully", response);
            }

        }
        
        [HttpPut("GetAdminReport")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAdminReport([FromBody] AdminReportRequest request)
        {
            var response = new DownloadResponse();
            if (_authorizationService.IsAdminAuthorised(request.UserName))
            {
                response = await _titlePointAuditLogDetailService.GetAdminReport(request);
                if (response.HasErrors || response.HasValidationErrors)
                {
                    return BadRequest(response);
                }
                else if (response.Messages.Any())
                {
                    return NotFound(response);
                }
                return File(response.FileData, response.ContentType, response.FileName);
            }
            else
            {
                return Unauthorized();
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("DownloadReport")]
        public IActionResult DownloadFile([FromBody] DownloadRequest request)
        {
            var response = _downloadService.DownloadFile(request);
            if(response.HasErrors || response.HasValidationErrors)
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }
            return File(response.FileData, response.ContentType,response.FileName);
        }

        [HttpPut("GetApplicationReport")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetApplicationReport([FromBody] ApplicationReportRequest applicationReportRequest)
        {
            var response = await _titlePointAuditLogDetailService.GetApplicationReport(applicationReportRequest);
            if (response.HasErrors || response.HasValidationErrors)
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }
            else if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return NotFound(response);
            }
            else
                return Ok(response);

        }

        [HttpPut("DownloadApplicationReport")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DownloadApplicationReport([FromBody] DownloadApplicationReportRequest downloadApplicationReportRequest)
        {
            var response = await _titlePointAuditLogDetailService.DownloadApplicationReport(downloadApplicationReportRequest);
            if (response.HasErrors || response.HasValidationErrors)
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }
            else if (response.Messages.Any())
            {
                return NotFound(response);
            }
            else
                return File(response.FileData, response.ContentType, response.FileName);

        }
    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ApplicationBuilderExtensions
    {
        public static IApplicationBuilder AppendHeader(this IApplicationBuilder builder,Dictionary<string,string> headers)
        {
            return builder.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                foreach (var header in headers)
                {
                    context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value); 
                }

                await next();
            });
        }
    }
}



=================================================
FILE: Src\AuditTracking\FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.Api\Extensions\ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions.cs
=================================================

using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions
    {
        public static void ConfigureExceptionHandler(this IApplicationBuilder app, ILogger logger, Dictionary<string, string> headers = null)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler(appError =>
            {

                appError.Run(async context =>
                {
                    // Add custom headers to the response.
                    if (headers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var header in headers)
                        {
                            context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value);
                        }
                    }

                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

                    var contextFeature = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>();

                    if (contextFeature is not null)
                    {
                        logger.LogError(contextFeature.Error, contextFeature.Error.Message);

                        var internalServerJson = new ErrorDetails
                        {
                            StatusCode = context.Response.StatusCode,
                            Message = "Internal Server Error."
                        };

                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(internalServerJson);
                    }

                });
            });
        }
    }
}

using FluentValidation;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Dto;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.ViewModel;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request
{
    public class AdminReportRequest
    {
        public Guid[]? ApplicationId { get; set; }
        public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
        public string UserName { get; set; }
        public string? TPUserName { get; set; }
        public string? UserEmail { get; set; }
        public bool? IsExactSearch { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<string, string>? SearchDetail { get; set; }
        
    }

    public class AdiminReportRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<AdminReportRequest>
    {
        public AdiminReportRequestValidator()
        {

            RuleFor(tp => tp.UserName)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("User Name is required");

            RuleFor(tp => tp.StartDate)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
               .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("Start Date is required")
               .LessThanOrEqualTo(tp => tp.EndDate)
               .WithMessage("Start Date should be less than or equal to End Date")
               .Must((tp,startDate)=> TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate(tp.StartDate,tp.EndDate))
               .WithMessage("Start Date and End Date range should be between 1 Year");

            RuleFor(tp => tp.EndDate)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("End Date is required")
                .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(tp => tp.StartDate)
                .WithMessage("End Date should be greater than or equal to Start Date");

            //RuleFor(tp => tp).Must(TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate)
            //   .WithMessage("Start Date and End Date range should be between 1 Year");

            RuleFor(tp => tp.TPUserName)
              .MaximumLength(100)
              .When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.TPUserName)).WithMessage("TitlePoint User Name should be max 100 characters");

            RuleFor(tp => tp.UserEmail)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
              .MaximumLength(100)
              .EmailAddress()
              .When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserEmail)).WithMessage("Invalid Email Address");


        }

        private bool TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
        {
            TimeSpan difference=endDate-startDate;
            return difference.TotalDays <= 365;
        }
    }
}

using FluentValidation;

using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.ViewModel;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request
{
    public class ApplicationReportRequest
    {
        public UserProfileRequest? UserProfile {  get; set; }
        public string? TpuserName {  get; set; }
        public Guid ApplicationId { get; set; }
        public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int RecordPerPage { get; set; }
        public bool? IsExactSearch { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<string, string>? SearchDetail { get; set; }
    }

    public class ApplicationReportRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<ApplicationReportRequest>
    {
        public ApplicationReportRequestValidator() 
        {
            RuleFor(tp => tp.ApplicationId).NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("Application Id is required");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.StartDate)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
               .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("StartDate is required")
               .LessThanOrEqualTo(tp => tp.EndDate)
               .WithMessage("StartDate should be less than or equal to EndDate")
               .Must((tp,startDate) => TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate(tp.StartDate,tp.EndDate))
               .WithMessage("StartDate and EndDate range should be between 1 Year");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.EndDate)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("EndDate is required")
                .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(tp => tp.StartDate)
                .WithMessage("EndDate should be greater than or equal to StartDate");
            When(tp => tp.PageNumber == 0, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.PageNumber).GreaterThan(0).WithMessage("PageNumber should be greater than 0");
            });
            When(tp => tp.RecordPerPage == 0, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.RecordPerPage).GreaterThan(0).WithMessage("RecordPerPage should be greater than 0");
            });

        }
        private bool TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
        {
            TimeSpan difference = endDate - startDate;
            return difference.TotalDays <= 365;
        }
    }
}

using FluentValidation;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.ViewModel;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request
{
    public class DownloadApplicationReportRequest
    {
        public UserProfileRequest? UserProfile { get; set; }
        public string? TpuserName { get; set; }
        public Guid ApplicationId { get; set; }
        public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
        public bool? IsExactSearch { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<string, string>? SearchDetail { get; set; }
    }

    public class DownloadApplicationReportRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<DownloadApplicationReportRequest>
    {
        public DownloadApplicationReportRequestValidator()
        {
            RuleFor(tp => tp.ApplicationId).NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("Application Id is required");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.StartDate)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
               .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("StartDate is required")
               .LessThanOrEqualTo(tp => tp.EndDate)
               .WithMessage("StartDate should be less than or equal to EndDate")
               .Must((tp, startDate) => TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate(tp.StartDate, tp.EndDate))
               .WithMessage("StartDate and EndDate range should be between 1 Year");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.EndDate)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("EndDate is required")
                .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(tp => tp.StartDate)
                .WithMessage("EndDate should be greater than or equal to StartDate");

        }
        private bool TimeSpanBetweenStartAndEndDate(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
        {
            TimeSpan difference = endDate - startDate;
            return difference.TotalDays <= 365;
        }
    }
}

using FluentValidation;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.ViewModel;
using System;


namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request
{
    public class DownloadRequest
    {
        public List<TitlePointAuditLogDetailViewModel> Data { get; set; }
        public string FileName { get; set; }
        public string FileType { get; set; }
    }

    public class DownloadRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<DownloadRequest>
    {
        private readonly string[] _fileExtensions;
        public DownloadRequestValidator(string[] fileExtensions) 
        {
            _fileExtensions = fileExtensions;

            //RuleFor(x => x.Data)
            //   .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("Data is required");

            RuleFor(x => x.FileName)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("File Name is required");
                //.Matches("^[0-9A-Za-z\\s-_]+$")
                //.WithMessage("File Name should not contain special characters except _ and - ");

            RuleFor(x => x.FileType)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("File Type is required")
                .Must(AvailableTypes)
                .WithMessage("Invalid File Type (Ex: '.xlsx')");
        }

        private bool AvailableTypes(string fileType)
        {
            return _fileExtensions.Contains(fileType);
        }
    }
}

using FluentValidation;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Dto;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.ViewModel;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request
{
    public class TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest
    {
        public CompleteUserProfileRequest UserProfile { get; set; }
        public Guid? ApplicationId { get; set; }

        public string TpuserName { get; set; } = null!;

        public string? TporderId { get; set; }

        public string ServiceType { get; set; } = null!;

        public string? SearchParameter { get; set; }

        public int? SearchResultCount { get; set; }

        public string EndPointUrl { get; set; } = null!;

        public Dictionary<string, string>? SearchDetail { get; set; }
        public string? SearchBy { get; set; }

    }

    public class TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest>
    {
        public TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequestValidator()
        {

            RuleFor(tp => tp.ApplicationId)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("Application Id is required");

            RuleFor(tp => tp.TpuserName)
                .NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("TpuserName is required")
                .MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("TpuserName should be max 100 characters");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserEmail).NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("UserEmail is required")
                .EmailAddress().WithMessage("Invalid UserEmail");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.ServiceType).NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("ServiceType is required");
            RuleFor(tp => tp.EndPointUrl).NotNull().NotEmpty().WithMessage("EndPointUrl is required");
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserFirstName), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserFirstName).MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("UserFirstName should be max 100 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserLastName), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserLastName).MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("UserLastName should be max 100 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserCompanyName), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserCompanyName).MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("UserCompanyName should be max 100 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserCounty), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserCounty).MaximumLength(50).WithMessage("UserCounty should be max 50 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserCity), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserCity).MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("UserCity should be max 100 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserState), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserState).MaximumLength(50).WithMessage("UserState should be max 50 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.UserProfile.UserZipCode), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.UserProfile.UserZipCode).MaximumLength(20).WithMessage("UserZipCode should be max 20 characters");
            });
            When(tp => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tp.TporderId), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(tp => tp.TporderId).MaximumLength(20).WithMessage("TporderId should be max 20 characters");
            });

        }
    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseBase
    {

        private List<ResponseMessage> _messages = new List<ResponseMessage>();

        public virtual bool HasErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error) > 0; }
        }
        public virtual bool HasValidationErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation) > 0; }
        }

        public virtual List<ResponseMessage> Messages
        {
            get { return _messages; }
            private set { _messages = value; }
        }

        public void SetResponseMessage(ResponseMessage msg)
        {
            Messages.Add(msg);
        }

        public void SetMessages(IEnumerable<ResponseMessage> messages)
        {
            if (messages != null)
                Messages.AddRange(messages);
        }
    }
}

        //{

        //    set { }
        //}

        //public virtual string ResponseCode
        //{
        //    get { return _responsecode; }
        //    set { _responsecode = value; }
        //}

        public LevelEnum Level
        {
            get { return _level; }
            set { _level = value; }
        }

        public string Message
        {
            get { return _message; }
            set { _message = value; }
        }

        //public int Id
        //{
        //    get { return _id; }
        //    set { _id = value; }
        //}

        public ResponseMessage()
        {

        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level, string responseCode)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
            //ResponseCode = responseCode;
        }

        public ResponseMessage(Exception ex)
        {
            Message = GetExceptionMessageText(ex);
            Level = LevelEnum.Error;
            //ExceptionThrown = ex;
            //ResponseCode = "0";

        }

        public ResponseMessage(string message, Exception ex) : this(ex)
        {
            Message = message;
        }

        public static string GetExceptionMessageText(Exception ex)
        {
            string err = string.Format("Exception '{0}' \nTARGET: {1} \nSOURCE: {2} \nSTACK: {3}\n\n  ", ex.Message, ex.TargetSite, ex.Source, ex.StackTrace);
            if (ex.InnerException != null)
                err += GetExceptionMessageText(ex.InnerException);
            return err;
        }

    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.DatabaseContext;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using System;


namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class AuthorizationService : IAuthorizationSevrice
    {
        private readonly AuditTrackingDbContext _auditTrackingDbContext;
        private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
        public AuthorizationService(AuditTrackingDbContext auditTrackingDbContext,IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            _auditTrackingDbContext = auditTrackingDbContext;
            _configuration = configuration;
        }
        public bool IsAdminAuthorised(string AdminEmail)
        {
            var emailId = _configuration["AdminEmail"].ToLower().Split(';') ;
            return emailId.Contains(AdminEmail.ToLower());
        }

        public bool IsValidApplication(Guid? applicationID)
        {
            if (applicationID != null)
            {
                var appId = _auditTrackingDbContext.ApplicationDetails.SingleOrDefault(ap => ap.ApplicationId == applicationID && ap.IsActive == true);
                return (appId!=null)? true : false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\AuditTracking\FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure\Services\DownloadService.cs
=================================================


using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.Response;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiDomain.ViewModel;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.DatabaseContext;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using NPOI.SS.UserModel;
using NPOI.SS.Util;
using NPOI.XSSF.UserModel;


namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class DownloadService : IDownloadService
    {
        private readonly AuditTrackingDbContext _auditTrackingDbContext;
        private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
        public DownloadService(AuditTrackingDbContext auditTrackingDbContext, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            _auditTrackingDbContext=auditTrackingDbContext;
            _configuration = configuration;
        }

        public DownloadResponse DownloadFile(DownloadRequest request)
        {
            var fileExtensions = _configuration["ReportTypes"].ToLower().Split(';');
            var response = ValidateDownloadRequest(request,fileExtensions);

            if (!response.Messages.Any())
            {
                switch (request.FileType)
                {
                    case ".xlsx": response=DownloadExcelFile(request);
                        break;
                }
            }
            return response;

        }

        public DownloadResponse ValidateDownloadRequest(DownloadRequest request, string[] fileExtensions)
        {
            var response = new DownloadResponse();
            var validate = new DownloadRequestValidator(fileExtensions);
            var result = validate.Validate(request);
            if (!result.IsValid)
            {
                foreach (var error in result.Errors)
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ToString(), ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation));
                }
            }

            return response;
        }

        public DownloadResponse DownloadExcelFile(DownloadRequest request)
        {
            var response=new DownloadResponse();
            MemoryStream fileStream;
            FileStream stream;
            //Listing unique catagories
            var uniqueCategories = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.Select(s => s.SearchCategory).Distinct().ToList();
            using (fileStream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                IWorkbook workbook = new XSSFWorkbook();
                ISheet worksheet = workbook.CreateSheet("Sheet 1");

                //To add headers
                var t = typeof(TitlePointAuditLogDetailViewModel);
                int coulumn = 0;
                int row = 0;
                IRow excelRow = worksheet.CreateRow(row);
                var totalColumns = t.GetProperties().Count() + uniqueCategories.Count();

                //To set the border for cell
                ICellStyle borderStyle = workbook.CreateCellStyle();
                borderStyle.BorderBottom = BorderStyle.Thin;
                borderStyle.BorderLeft = BorderStyle.Thin;
                borderStyle.BorderTop = BorderStyle.Thin;
                borderStyle.BorderRight = BorderStyle.Thin;

                //To make the cell style as Bold and fill the background colour
                IFont font = workbook.CreateFont();
                font.IsBold = true;
                ICellStyle style = workbook.CreateCellStyle();
                style.SetFont(font);
                style.FillForegroundColor = NPOI.HSSF.Util.HSSFColor.Lavender.Index;
                style.FillPattern = FillPattern.SolidForeground;

                //To add header columns
                for (int i = 0; i < t.GetProperties().Count(); i++)
                {
                    var column = t.GetProperties()[i];
                    if (column.Name.Contains("SearchDetail"))
                    {
                        for (int j = 0; j < uniqueCategories.Count; j++)
                        {
                            excelRow.CreateCell(coulumn + j).SetCellValue(uniqueCategories[j]);
                            worksheet.AutoSizeColumn(coulumn + j);

                        }
                        coulumn += uniqueCategories.Count;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        excelRow.CreateCell(coulumn).SetCellValue(column.Name);
                        worksheet.AutoSizeColumn(coulumn);
                        coulumn++;
                    }
                }
                for(int columns=0;columns<totalColumns-1;columns++)
                {
                    excelRow.GetCell(columns).CellStyle = borderStyle;
                    excelRow.GetCell(columns).CellStyle = style;
                }
                row++;
                coulumn = 0;
                worksheet.SetAutoFilter(new CellRangeAddress(worksheet.FirstRowNum, worksheet.LastRowNum, worksheet.GetRow(0).FirstCellNum, worksheet.GetRow(0).LastCellNum-1));
                
                //To add records
                foreach (var record in request.Data)
                {
                    excelRow = worksheet.CreateRow(row);
                    for (int i = 0; i < record.GetType().GetProperties().Count(); i++)
                    {
                        var column = record.GetType().GetProperties()[i];
                        if (column.Name.Contains("SearchDetail"))
                        {
                            foreach (var searchDetailKeyValue in record.SearchDetail)
                            {
                                int categoryColumns = coulumn;
                                for (int j = 1; j <= uniqueCategories.Count; j++)
                                {
                                    if (worksheet.GetRow(0).GetCell(categoryColumns).ToString().ToLower() == searchDetailKeyValue.Key.ToLower())
                                    {
                                        excelRow.CreateCell(categoryColumns).SetCellValue(searchDetailKeyValue.Value.ToString());
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        var cellValue = worksheet.GetRow(row).GetCell(categoryColumns);
                                        if (cellValue == null || String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cellValue.ToString()))
                                            excelRow.CreateCell(categoryColumns).SetCellValue("");
                                    }
                                    categoryColumns++;
                                }
                                categoryColumns = coulumn - uniqueCategories.Count;
                            }
                            coulumn = coulumn + uniqueCategories.Count - 1;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var cellValue = column.GetValue(record,null);
                            if (cellValue == null || String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cellValue.ToString()))
                                excelRow.CreateCell(coulumn).SetCellValue("");
                            else
                                excelRow.CreateCell(coulumn).SetCellValue(cellValue.ToString());
                        }
                        coulumn++;
                    }

                    for (int categoryColumns = 0; categoryColumns < totalColumns-1; categoryColumns++)
                    {
                        if (excelRow.GetCell(categoryColumns) == null)
                            excelRow.CreateCell(categoryColumns);
                        excelRow.GetCell(categoryColumns).CellStyle = borderStyle;
                    }
                    row++;
                    coulumn = 0;
                }
                 for (int j = 0; j < worksheet.GetRow(1).LastCellNum; j++)
                {
                    worksheet.AutoSizeColumn(j);
                }

                workbook.Write(fileStream);
            }

            response.FileData = fileStream.ToArray();
            response.ContentType = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet";
            response.FileName = request.FileName + request.FileType;
            return response;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\AuditTracking\FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure\Services\RateLimiteService.cs
=================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using SixLabors.ImageSharp;
using SixLabors.ImageSharp.Processing.Processors.Transforms;
using NLog;
using static System.Net.Mime.MediaTypeNames;


namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class RateLimiteService : IRateLimitService
    {
        private readonly IMemoryCache _memoryCache;
        private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
        //private const int totalRequestLimit = MaxRequest + extraRequest;
        private static Logger logger = LogManager.GetCurrentClassLogger();

        public RateLimiteService(IMemoryCache memoryCache, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            _memoryCache = memoryCache;
            _configuration = configuration;
        }

        public bool IsLimiteExceeded(Guid appId, out string message)
        {
            logger.Error("Inside IsLimitExceed");
            var MaxRequest = Convert.ToInt32(_configuration["MaxRequest"]);
            var extraRequest = Convert.ToInt32(_configuration["extraRequest"]);
            var extraRequestCount = Convert.ToInt32(_configuration["extraRequestCount"]);
            var totalRequestLimit = MaxRequest + (extraRequest * extraRequestCount);
            message = string.Empty;
            string key = $"{appId}";

            _memoryCache.TryGetValue(key, out int currentCount);
            var startDatetime = _memoryCache.Get("StartDateTime");
            if (startDatetime == null)
            {
                startDatetime = DateTime.Now;
                _memoryCache.Set("StartDateTime", startDatetime);
                logger.Error("Request Start time {@msg}", startDatetime);
            }
            var dateTimeDiff = DateTime.Now - Convert.ToDateTime(startDatetime);
            if (dateTimeDiff.TotalMinutes > 2)
            {
                currentCount = 0;
                _memoryCache.Set(key, currentCount);
                _memoryCache.Set("StartDateTime", DateTime.Now);
            }
            else
            {
                if (currentCount >= totalRequestLimit)
                {
                    logger.Error("Limite exceed for {@applicationId} and Request Start time is {@msg}",key, DateTime.Now);
                    message = $"Rate limit exceed. Maximum {totalRequestLimit} requests allowed";
                    return true;
                }
                if (currentCount >= MaxRequest)
                {
                    message = $"you have exceed the normal rate limit. only {extraRequest} extra request allowed";
                }
            }
            _memoryCache.Set(key, currentCount + 1);
            //var data = _memoryCache.Set(key, currentCount + 1, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2));
            return false;
        }
    }
}

        public async Task<TitlePointAuditLogDetailResponse> GetAuditLogsAsync()
        {
