            var auditLogs = await _auditTrackingDbContext.TitlePointAuditLogDetails
                                  .Where(x => x.Id == 1).ToListAsync();

            return response;
        }
        public async Task<TitlePointAuditLogResponse> SaveTitlePointAuditLogDetail(TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest)
        {
            TitlePointAuditLogResponse response = new TitlePointAuditLogResponse();
            response = ValidateTitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest(titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest);
            if (!response.Messages.Any())
            {
                TitlePointAuditLogDetail titlePointAuditLogDetail = new TitlePointAuditLogDetail()
                {
                    ApplicationId = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.ApplicationId,
                    TpuserName = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.TpuserName,
                    UserFirstName = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserFirstName,
                    UserLastName = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserLastName,
                    UserEmail = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserEmail,
                    UserCompanyName = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserCompanyName,
                    UserCounty = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserCounty,
                    UserState = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserState,
                    UserCity = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserCity,
                    UserZipCode = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.UserProfile.UserZipCode,
                    TporderId = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.TporderId,
                    ServiceType = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.ServiceType,
                    SearchParameter = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.SearchParameter,
                    SearchResultCount = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.SearchResultCount,
                    EndPointUrl = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.EndPointUrl,
                    CreatedDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    SearchBy = titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.SearchBy
                };
                _auditTrackingDbContext.TitlePointAuditLogDetails.Add(titlePointAuditLogDetail);
                _auditTrackingDbContext.SaveChanges();
                response.Id = titlePointAuditLogDetail.Id;
                {
                    List<SearchDetail> titlePointSearchDeatil = new List<SearchDetail>();
                    if (titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.SearchDetail != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var item in titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.SearchDetail)
                        {
                            SearchDetail searchDeatil = new SearchDetail()
                            {
                                AuditId = response.Id,
                                SearchCategory = item.Key,
                                SearchValue = item.Value,
                                CreatedDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                            };
                            titlePointSearchDeatil.Add(searchDeatil);
                            _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.AddRange(titlePointSearchDeatil);
                        }
                    }
                    _auditTrackingDbContext.SaveChanges();
                }
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Record created successfully", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Message));
            }
            return response;
        }

        private TitlePointAuditLogResponse ValidateTitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest(TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequest titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest)
        {
            TitlePointAuditLogResponse response = new TitlePointAuditLogResponse();

            var validate = new TitlePointAuditLogDetailRequestValidator();
            var result = validate.Validate(titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest);
            if (!result.IsValid)
            {
                foreach (var error in result.Errors)
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ToString(), ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation));
                }
                return response;
            }
            var Application = _authorizationSevrice.IsValidApplication(titlePointAuditLogDetailRequest.ApplicationId);
            if (!Application)
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Application not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

            }
            return response;
        }

        public async Task<DownloadResponse> GetAdminReport(AdminReportRequest request)
        {
            var baseresponse = ValidateAdminReportRequest(request);
            var requestdto = ConvertAdminReportRequestToDto(request);
            var query = new List<TitlePointAuditLogDetailViewModel>();
            if (!baseresponse.Messages.Any())
            {
                var predicateBuilder = PredicateBuilder.True<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                var searchpredicate = PredicateBuilder.True<SearchDetail>();
                var searchDetailAuditIds = new List<long>();
                var totalauditIDs = new List<long>();
                var SearchDetailList = new List<string>();
                if (request.IsExactSearch is not null && request.IsExactSearch == true)
                {
                    if (requestdto.SearchDetail != null && requestdto.SearchDetail.Count > 0)
                    {
                        var searchDetails = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.ToList();
                        searchpredicate = PredicateBuilder.False<SearchDetail>();
                        foreach (var pair in requestdto.SearchDetail)
                        {
                            searchDetailAuditIds = searchDetails.Where(w => w.SearchCategory.ToLower() == pair.Key.ToLower() && w.SearchValue.ToLower() == pair.Value.ToLower()).Select(s => s.AuditId).ToList();
                            if (searchDetailAuditIds.Count == 0)
                            {
                                totalauditIDs = searchDetailAuditIds;
                                break;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (totalauditIDs.Count == 0)
                                    totalauditIDs.AddRange(searchDetailAuditIds);
                                else
                                    totalauditIDs = totalauditIDs.Where(w => searchDetailAuditIds.Contains(w)).ToList();
                            }
                        }
                        //var auditIDs = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.Where(searchpredicate).Select(s => s.AuditId).Distinct().ToList();
                        predicateBuilder = PredicateBuilder.True<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                        // Replace the loop-based Or chaining with Contains to prevent stack overflow
                        if (totalauditIDs.Count > 0)
                        {
                            predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => totalauditIDs.Contains(p.Id));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            predicateBuilder = PredicateBuilder.False<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                        }
                    }


                    var toDate = requestdto.EndDate.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);

                    predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.CreatedDate >= requestdto.StartDate && p.CreatedDate <= toDate);
                    //var datalistlist = _auditTrackingDbContext.TitlePointAuditLogDetails.Include(t => t.Application).Include(t => t.SearchDetails).Where(predicateBuilder).ToList();

                    if (requestdto.ApplicationId is not null && requestdto.ApplicationId.Length > 0)
                    {
                        var applicationPredicate = PredicateBuilder.False<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                        foreach (var applicationId in requestdto.ApplicationId)
                        {
                            applicationPredicate = applicationPredicate.Or(p => p.ApplicationId == applicationId);
                        }
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(applicationPredicate);
                    }

                    if (requestdto.TPUserName is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestdto.TPUserName))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.TpuserName == requestdto.TPUserName);
                    }

                    if (requestdto.UserEmail is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestdto.UserEmail))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserEmail == requestdto.UserEmail);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (requestdto.SearchDetail != null && requestdto.SearchDetail.Count > 0)
                    {
                        SearchDetailList = requestdto.SearchDetail.Where(w => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(w.Value)
                 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(w.Value)).Select(s => s.Key).ToList();
                        if (SearchDetailList != null && SearchDetailList.Count > 0)
                        {
                            var searchDetails = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.ToList();
                            searchpredicate = PredicateBuilder.False<SearchDetail>();
                            foreach (var s in SearchDetailList)
                            {
                                var searchValue = requestdto.SearchDetail[s];
                                searchDetailAuditIds = searchDetails.Where(w => w.SearchCategory.ToLower() == s.ToLower() && w.SearchValue.ToLower().Contains(searchValue.ToLower())).Select(s => s.AuditId).ToList();
                                if (searchDetailAuditIds.Count == 0)
                                {
                                    totalauditIDs = searchDetailAuditIds;
                                    break;
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (totalauditIDs.Count == 0)
                                        totalauditIDs.AddRange(searchDetailAuditIds);
                                    else
                                        totalauditIDs = totalauditIDs.Where(w => searchDetailAuditIds.Contains(w)).ToList();
                                }
                            }
                            //var auditIDs = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.Where(searchpredicate).Select(s => s.AuditId).Distinct().ToList();
                            predicateBuilder = PredicateBuilder.True<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                            // Replace the loop-based Or chaining with Contains to prevent stack overflow
                            if (totalauditIDs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => totalauditIDs.Contains(p.Id));
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                predicateBuilder = PredicateBuilder.False<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                            }

                        }
                    }
                    var toDate = requestdto.EndDate.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
                    predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.CreatedDate >= requestdto.StartDate && p.CreatedDate <= toDate);

                    if (requestdto.ApplicationId is not null && requestdto.ApplicationId.Length > 0)
                    {
                        var applicationPredicate = PredicateBuilder.False<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                        foreach (var applicationId in requestdto.ApplicationId)
                        {
                            applicationPredicate = applicationPredicate.Or(p => p.ApplicationId == applicationId);
                        }
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(applicationPredicate);
                    }

                    if (requestdto.TPUserName is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestdto.TPUserName))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.TpuserName.Contains(requestdto.TPUserName));
                    }

                    if (requestdto.UserEmail is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestdto.UserEmail))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserEmail.Contains(requestdto.UserEmail));
                    }
                }

                var dataList = _auditTrackingDbContext.TitlePointAuditLogDetails.Include(t => t.Application).Include(s => s.SearchDetails).Where(predicateBuilder).ToList();

                if (requestdto.SearchDetail != null && requestdto.SearchDetail.Any() && (requestdto.IsExactSearch == true || SearchDetailList.Count > 0))
                    dataList = dataList.Where(w => totalauditIDs.Contains(w.Id)).ToList();

                foreach (var data in dataList)
                {

                    var reportResponse = new TitlePointAuditLogDetailViewModel();
                    reportResponse.Id = data.Id;
                    reportResponse.ApplicationName = data.Application.ApplicationName;
                    reportResponse.TpuserName = data.TpuserName;
                    reportResponse.UserFirstName = data.UserFirstName;
                    reportResponse.UserLastName = data.UserLastName;
                    reportResponse.UserEmail = data.UserEmail;
                    reportResponse.UserCompanyName = data.UserCompanyName;
                    reportResponse.UserCounty = data.UserCounty;
                    reportResponse.UserCity = data.UserCity;
                    reportResponse.UserState = data.UserState;
                    reportResponse.UserZipCode = data.UserZipCode;
                    reportResponse.TPorderId = data.TporderId;
                    reportResponse.SearchResultCount = data.SearchResultCount;
                    reportResponse.EndPointUrl = data.EndPointUrl;
                    reportResponse.CreatedDate = data.CreatedDate;
                    reportResponse.ServiceType = data.ServiceType;
                    reportResponse.SearchBy = data.SearchBy;
                    foreach (var item in data.SearchDetails)
                    {
                        reportResponse.SearchDetail.Add(item.SearchCategory, item.SearchValue);

                    }
                    query.Add(reportResponse);

                }

                if (query.Count > 0)
                {
                    var FileName = _configuration["AdminReportFileName"] + " " + DateTime.Now.ToString("dd-MM-yyyy hh-mm-ss tt");
                    var FileType = _configuration["ReportTypes"];
                    var downloadRequest = new DownloadRequest() { Data = query, FileName = FileName, FileType = FileType };
                    baseresponse = _downloadService.DownloadFile(downloadRequest);
                }
                else
                {
                    baseresponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Data not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Message));
                }
            }


            return baseresponse;
        }

        public DownloadResponse ValidateAdminReportRequest(AdminReportRequest request)
        {
            var response = new DownloadResponse();
            var validate = new AdiminReportRequestValidator();
            var result = validate.Validate(request);
            if (!result.IsValid)
            {
                foreach (var error in result.Errors)
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ToString(), ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation));
                }
            }
            if (request.ApplicationId is not null && request.ApplicationId.Length > 0)
            {
                foreach (var applicationId in request.ApplicationId)
                {
                    var Application = _authorizationSevrice.IsValidApplication(applicationId);
                    if (!Application)
                    {
                        response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(applicationId + "  Application not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                    }
                }
            }
            return response;
        }

        public AdminReportRequestDto ConvertAdminReportRequestToDto(AdminReportRequest request)
        {
            var AdminReportRequestDto = new AdminReportRequestDto()
            {
                ApplicationId = request.ApplicationId,
                StartDate = request.StartDate,
                EndDate = request.EndDate,
                UserName = request.UserName,
                TPUserName = request.TPUserName,
                UserEmail = request.UserEmail,
                IsExactSearch = request.IsExactSearch,
                SearchDetail = request.SearchDetail
            };
            return AdminReportRequestDto;
        }

                    }

                    {

                    .Skip((applicationReportRequest.PageNumber - 1) * applicationReportRequest.RecordPerPage).Take(applicationReportRequest.RecordPerPage).ToList();

                // if (applicationReportRequest.SearchDetail != null && applicationReportRequest.SearchDetail.Any() && (applicationReportRequest.IsExactSearch == true || SearchDetailList.Count > 0))

                    reportResponse.UserEmail = data.UserEmail;
                    reportResponse.UserCompanyName = data.UserCompanyName;

                    reportResponse.CreatedDate = data.CreatedDate;
                    reportResponse.SearchBy = data.SearchBy;
                    reportResponse.SearchDetail = new Dictionary<string, string>();
                    if (data.SearchDetails.Count > 0)
                    {
                        foreach (var item in data.SearchDetails)
                        {
                            reportResponse.SearchDetail.Add(item.SearchCategory, item.SearchValue);
                        }
                    }
                    query.Add(reportResponse);
                }
                if (query.Count > 0)
                {
                    response.AuditDetails = query;
                    response.TotalRecord = dataListDetails.ToList().Count;
                    response.PageNumber = applicationReportRequest.PageNumber;
                    response.RecordPerPage = applicationReportRequest.RecordPerPage;
                }
                else
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Data not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Message));

            }
            return response;
        }

        private ApplicationReportResponse ValidateApplicationReportRequest(ApplicationReportRequest applicationReportRequest)
        {
            var response = new ApplicationReportResponse();
            var validate = new ApplicationReportRequestValidator();
            var result = validate.Validate(applicationReportRequest);
            if (!result.IsValid)
            {
                foreach (var error in result.Errors)
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ToString(), ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation));
                }
                return response;
            }

            var Application = _authorizationSevrice.IsValidApplication(applicationReportRequest.ApplicationId);
            if (!Application)
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Application not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

            }
            return response;
        }

                    var toDate = downloadApplicationReportRequest.EndDate.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
                    predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.CreatedDate >= downloadApplicationReportRequest.StartDate && p.CreatedDate <= toDate);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (downloadApplicationReportRequest.SearchDetail != null && downloadApplicationReportRequest.SearchDetail.Count > 0)
                    {
                        SearchDetailList = downloadApplicationReportRequest.SearchDetail.Where(w => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(w.Value)
                        && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(w.Value)).Select(s => s.Key).ToList();
                        if (SearchDetailList != null && SearchDetailList.Count > 0)
                        {
                            var searchDetails = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.Where(w => w.Audit.ApplicationId == downloadApplicationReportRequest.ApplicationId).ToList();
                            //searchpredicate = PredicateBuilder.False<SearchDetail>();
                            foreach (var s in SearchDetailList)
                            {
                                var searchValue = downloadApplicationReportRequest.SearchDetail[s];
                                searchDetailAuditIds = searchDetails.Where(w => w.SearchCategory.ToLower() == s.ToLower() && w.SearchValue.ToLower().Contains(searchValue.ToLower())).Select(s => s.AuditId).ToList();
                                if (searchDetailAuditIds.Count == 0)
                                {
                                    totalauditIDs = searchDetailAuditIds;
                                    break;
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (totalauditIDs.Count == 0)
                                        totalauditIDs.AddRange(searchDetailAuditIds);
                                    else
                                        totalauditIDs = totalauditIDs.Where(w => searchDetailAuditIds.Contains(w)).ToList();
                                }
                            }
                            // var auditIDs = _auditTrackingDbContext.SearchDetails.Where(searchpredicate).Select(s => s.AuditId).Distinct().ToList();
                            //predicateBuilder = PredicateBuilder.False<TitlePointAuditLogDetail>();
                            //foreach (var id in totalauditIDs)
                            //{
                            //    predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.Or(p => p.Id == id);
                            //}

                        }
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.TpuserName))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.TpuserName.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.TpuserName));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserFirstName))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserFirstName.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserFirstName));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserLastName))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserLastName.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserLastName));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserEmail))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserEmail == downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserEmail);
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserCompanyName))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserCompanyName.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserCompanyName));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserCounty))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserCounty.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserCounty));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserState))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserState.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserState));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserCity))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserCity.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserCity));
                    }
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserZipCode))
                    {
                        predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.UserZipCode.Contains(downloadApplicationReportRequest.UserProfile.UserZipCode));
                    }
                    predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.ApplicationId == downloadApplicationReportRequest.ApplicationId);
                    var toDate = downloadApplicationReportRequest.EndDate.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
                    predicateBuilder = predicateBuilder.And(p => p.CreatedDate >= downloadApplicationReportRequest.StartDate && p.CreatedDate <= toDate);
                }
                var dataList = _auditTrackingDbContext.TitlePointAuditLogDetails.Include(t => t.Application).Include(t => t.SearchDetails).Where(predicateBuilder).ToList();
                if (downloadApplicationReportRequest.SearchDetail != null && downloadApplicationReportRequest.SearchDetail.Any() && (downloadApplicationReportRequest.IsExactSearch == true || SearchDetailList.Count > 0))
                    dataList = dataList.Where(w => totalauditIDs.Contains(w.Id)).ToList();
                foreach (var data in dataList)
                {
                    var reportResponse = new TitlePointAuditLogDetailViewModel();
                    reportResponse.Id = data.Id;
                    reportResponse.ApplicationName = data.Application.ApplicationName;
                    reportResponse.TpuserName = data.TpuserName;
                    reportResponse.UserFirstName = data.UserFirstName;
                    reportResponse.UserLastName = data.UserLastName;
                    reportResponse.UserEmail = data.UserEmail;
                    reportResponse.UserCompanyName = data.UserCompanyName;
                    reportResponse.UserCounty = data.UserCounty;
                    reportResponse.UserCity = data.UserCity;
                    reportResponse.UserState = data.UserState;
                    reportResponse.UserZipCode = data.UserZipCode;
                    reportResponse.TPorderId = data.TporderId;
                    reportResponse.SearchResultCount = data.SearchResultCount;
                    reportResponse.EndPointUrl = data.EndPointUrl;
                    reportResponse.CreatedDate = data.CreatedDate;
                    reportResponse.ServiceType = data.ServiceType;
                    reportResponse.SearchBy = data.SearchBy;
                    foreach (var item in data.SearchDetails)
                    {
                        reportResponse.SearchDetail.Add(item.SearchCategory, item.SearchValue);
                    }
                    query.Add(reportResponse);
                }
                if (query.Count > 0)
                {
                    var currentDateTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("dd-MM-yyyy hh-mm-ss tt");
                    var FileName = _configuration["ApplicationReportFileName"] + ' ' + currentDateTime;
                    var FileType = _configuration["ReportTypes"];
                    var downloadRequest = new DownloadRequest() { Data = query, FileName = FileName, FileType = FileType };
                    response = _downloadService.DownloadFile(downloadRequest);
                }
                else
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Data not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Message));
                }

            }
            return response;
        }

        private DownloadResponse ValidateDownloadApplicationReportRequest(DownloadApplicationReportRequest downloadApplicationReportRequest)
        {
            var response = new DownloadResponse();
            var validate = new DownloadApplicationReportRequestValidator();
            var result = validate.Validate(downloadApplicationReportRequest);
            if (!result.IsValid)
            {
                foreach (var error in result.Errors)
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ToString(), ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation));
                }
                return response;
            }

            var Application = _authorizationSevrice.IsValidApplication(downloadApplicationReportRequest.ApplicationId);
            if (!Application)
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Application not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

            }
            return response;
        }



    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class WeatherForecastService : IWeatherForecastService
    {
        private static readonly string[] Summaries = new[]
        {
            "Freezing", "Bracing", "Chilly", "Cool", "Mild", "Warm", "Balmy", "Hot", "Sweltering", "Scorching"
        };

        public WeatherForecastResponse GetWeatherForecast()
        {
            var response = new WeatherForecastResponse();

            response.WeatherForecast = Enumerable.Range(1, 5).Select(index => new WeatherForecastDto
            {
                Date = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Now.AddDays(index)),
                TemperatureC = Random.Shared.Next(-20, 55),
                Summary = Summaries[Random.Shared.Next(Summaries.Length)]
            })
           .ToArray();

            return response;
        }
    }

using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.Api.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    public class LogController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly LogOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration;

        public LogController(LogOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration)
        {
            _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration = logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration;
        }
        [HttpGet("GetOrderLogDetails")]
        public IActionResult GetOrderLogDetails(string fileName,string? searchValue)
        {
            var path = _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration.Path;

            var files = Directory.GetFiles(path);

            var file = files.FirstOrDefault(x => Path.GetFileName(x) == fileName);

            if (System.IO.File.Exists(file))
            {
                var logDetails = System.IO.File.ReadLines(file);

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchValue))
                {
                    logDetails = logDetails.Where(x => x.Contains(searchValue));
                }
                return Ok(logDetails);
            }
            return NotFound("No Logs found");

        }
    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ApplicationBuilderExtensions
    {
        public static IApplicationBuilder AppendHeader(this IApplicationBuilder builder,Dictionary<string,string> headers)
        {
            return builder.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                foreach (var header in headers)
                {
                    context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value); 
                }

                await next();
            });
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ConfigurationExtension
    {
        public static void AddConfiguration<T>(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration, string configurationTag = null) where T : class
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(configurationTag))
            {
                configurationTag = typeof(T).Name;
            }

            var instance = Activator.CreateInstance<T>();
            new ConfigureFromConfigurationOptions<T>(configuration.GetSection(configurationTag)).Configure(instance);
            services.AddSingleton(instance);
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\SmartView\FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.Api\Extensions\ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions.cs
=================================================

using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions
    {
        public static void ConfigureExceptionHandler(this IApplicationBuilder app, ILogger logger, Dictionary<string, string> headers = null)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler(appError =>
            {

                appError.Run(async context =>
                {
                    // Add custom headers to the response.
                    if (headers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var header in headers)
                        {
                            context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value);
                        }
                    }

                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

                    var contextFeature = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>();

                    if (contextFeature is not null)
                    {
                        logger.LogError(contextFeature.Error, contextFeature.Error.Message);

                        var internalServerJson = new ErrorDetails
                        {
                            StatusCode = context.Response.StatusCode,
                            Message = "Internal Server Error."
                        };

                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(internalServerJson);
                    }

                });
            });
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\SmartView\FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure\Helpers\XmlSerializerHelper.cs
=================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.SqlTypes;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Xml.Linq;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure.Helpers
{
    public static class XmlSerializerHelper<T>
    {
        /// 

        /// Serializes the specified object and returns the xml value
        /// 

        /// 
        /// 
        public static string Serialize(T obj)
        {
            var writer = new StringWriter();
            System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer serializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(T));
            serializer.Serialize(writer, obj);

            var result = writer.ToString();

            int idx = result.IndexOf(">") + 1;
            result = result.Remove(0, idx);

            result = RemoveAllNamespaces(result);
            return result;
        }

        /// 

        ///  Deserializes the XML content to a specified object
        /// 

        /// 
        /// 
        public static T? Deserialize(string xml)
        {
            T? result = default(T);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(xml))
            {
                TextReader tr = new StringReader(xml);

                System.Xml.XmlReader reader = System.Xml.XmlReader.Create(tr);
                System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer serializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(T));

                if (serializer.CanDeserialize(reader))
                    result = (T?)serializer.Deserialize(reader);
            }
            return result;
        }

        public static string RemoveAllNamespaces(string xmlDocument)
        {
            XElement xmlDocumentWithoutNs = RemoveAllNamespaces(XElement.Parse(xmlDocument));

            return xmlDocumentWithoutNs.ToString();
        }

        //Core recursion function
        private static XElement RemoveAllNamespaces(XElement xmlDocument)
        {
            if (!xmlDocument.HasElements)
            {
                XElement xElement = new XElement(xmlDocument.Name.LocalName);
                xElement.Value = xmlDocument.Value;

                foreach (XAttribute attribute in xmlDocument.Attributes())
                    xElement.Add(attribute);

                return xElement;
            }
            return new XElement(xmlDocument.Name.LocalName, xmlDocument.Elements().Select(el => RemoveAllNamespaces(el)));
        }
    }
}



=================================================
FILE: Src\SmartView\FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure\Services\DocumentDownloadService.cs
=================================================

using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure.Helpers;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class DocumentDownloadService : IDocumentDownloadService
    {
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;
        private readonly ISmartXmlService _smartXmlService;
        public DocumentDownloadService(ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration, ISmartXmlService smartXmlService)
        {
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;
            _smartXmlService = smartXmlService;
        }

        public async Task<DocumentDownloadResponse> DownloadDocument(DocumentDownloadRequest request)
        {
            var response = new DocumentDownloadResponse();

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != request.AppId))
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (response.HasErrors)
            {
                return response;
            }

            var svRequest = new SmartViewRequestElement
            {
                Type = SmartViewRequestTypes.GetOrderId,
                User = request.UserId,
                Password = request.Password,
                OnBehalfOf = request.OnBehalfOf,
                TargetOrder = request.TargetOrder
            };

            var smartOrder = new SmartViewSmartOrderElement
            {
                SmartViewRequest = svRequest
            };

            var orderRequest = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewSmartOrderElement>.Serialize(smartOrder);

            var apiSmartXml = await _smartXmlService.SmartXml(orderRequest);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(apiSmartXml))
            {
                var orderResponse = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewDocumentListResponse>.Deserialize(apiSmartXml);

                if (orderResponse is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(orderResponse.Response.Message))
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(orderResponse.Response.Message, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                }

                if (orderResponse is not null && orderResponse.Response.ReAction == "OK")
                {
                    if (orderResponse.Orders is not null && orderResponse.Orders.Any())
                    {
                        svRequest.Type = SmartViewRequestTypes.DocumentDownload;
                        svRequest.OrderId = orderResponse.Orders.First().Id;
                        svRequest.Guid = request.Guid.ToString();

                        orderRequest = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewSmartOrderElement>.Serialize(smartOrder);

                        var fileBytes = await _smartXmlService.SmartXmlDownloadAsync(orderRequest);

                        response.FileBytes = fileBytes;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Order not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                    }
                }
            }

            response.IsSuccess = !response.Messages.Any();

            return response;
        }
      
        /// <summary>
        /// This service using to download the document by version
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public async Task<DocumentDownloadResponse> DownloadDocumentByVersion(DocumentDownloadByVersionRequest request)
        {

                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(orderResponse.Response.Message, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                    }
                }
            }

            response.IsSuccess = !response.Messages.Any();

            return response;

using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure.Helpers;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class DocumentUploadService : IDocumentUploadService
    {
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;
        private readonly ISmartXmlService _smartXmlService;
        private readonly ISmartXmlDocService _smartXmlDocService;
        private readonly ILogService _logService;

        public DocumentUploadService(ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration, ISmartXmlService smartXmlService, ISmartXmlDocService smartXmlDocService, ILogService logService)
        {
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;
            _smartXmlService = smartXmlService;
            _smartXmlDocService = smartXmlDocService;
            _logService = logService;
        }

        public async Task<DocumentUploadResponse> UploadDocument(DocumentUploadRequest request)
        {
            var response = new DocumentUploadResponse();
            var orderNumber= request.Document.TargetOrder;

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + orderNumber + " " + "****UploadDocument started****");

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != request.AppId))
            {
                response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
            }

            if (response.HasErrors)
            {
                return response;
            }
            _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} Validation completed");

            var svRequest = new SmartViewRequestElement
            {
                Type = SmartViewRequestTypes.GetOrderId,
                User = request.UserId,
                Password = request.Password,
                OnBehalfOf = request.OnBehalfOf,
                TargetOrder = request.Document.TargetOrder
            };

            var smartOrder = new SmartViewSmartOrderElement
            {
                SmartViewRequest = svRequest
            };

            _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} GetOrderId started");

            var orderRequest = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewSmartOrderElement>.Serialize(smartOrder);

            var apiSmartXml = await _smartXmlService.SmartXml(orderRequest);

            _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} GetOrderId completed");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(apiSmartXml))
            {
                var orderResponse = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewResponse>.Deserialize(apiSmartXml);

                _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} GetOrderId response received");

                if (orderResponse is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(orderResponse.Response.Message))
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(orderResponse.Response.Message, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                    _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} GetOrderId response message: {orderResponse.Response.Message}");

                }

                _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} GetOrderId response reaction: {orderResponse?.Response.ReAction}");

                if (orderResponse is not null && orderResponse.Response.ReAction == "OK")
                {
                    if (orderResponse.Orders is not null && orderResponse.Orders.Any())
                    {
                        _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} GetOrderId order found and order id is {orderResponse.Orders.First().Id}");

                        var svDocumentRequest = new SmartViewDocumentRequest
                        {
                            Request =
                            {
                                Type = SmartViewRequestTypes.DocumentUpload,
                                User = request.UserId,
                                Password = request.Password,
                                OnBehalfOf = request.OnBehalfOf
                            },
                            Document =
                            {
                                FileName = request.Document.FileName,
                                DocumentType = request.Document.DocumentType,
                                FolderName = request.Document.FolderName,
                                OrderId = orderResponse.Orders.First().Id
                            }
                        };


                        var documentRequest = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewDocumentRequest>.Serialize(svDocumentRequest);
                        var svDocRequest = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewDocRequestElement>.Serialize(svDocumentRequest.Document);

                        _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} SmartXmlDoc document request: {svDocRequest}");

                        _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} SmartXmlDoc started");

                        var apiDocumentXml = await _smartXmlDocService.SmartXmlDoc(documentRequest, Convert.FromBase64String(request.Document.FileBase64Binary));

                        _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} SmartXmlDoc completed");

                        var orderDocumentsResponse = XmlSerializerHelper<SmartViewResponse>.Deserialize(apiDocumentXml);

                        _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} SmartXmlDoc response reaction:{orderDocumentsResponse?.Response.ReAction}, response message: {orderDocumentsResponse?.Response.Message}");

                        if (orderDocumentsResponse is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(orderDocumentsResponse.Response.Message))
                        {
                            response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(orderDocumentsResponse.Response.Message, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                            _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} SmartXmlDoc response: {orderDocumentsResponse.Response.Message}");
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Order not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                        _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} Order not found");

                    }
                }

            }

            response.IsSuccess = !response.Messages.Any();

            _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{orderNumber} ****UploadDocument completed****");

            return response;
        }
        public async Task<DocumentUploadResponse> UploadDocument3(DocumentUpload3Request request)
        {

using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class LogService : ILogService
    {
        private readonly LogOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration;

        public LogService(LogOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration)
        {
            _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration = logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration;
        }   

        public void LogInfo(string message)
        {
            var path = _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration.Path;
            var enableLog = _logOrderSmartViewActivityConfiguration.Enable;

            if (Convert.ToBoolean(enableLog))
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(path))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
                }
                var filePath = Path.Combine(path, $"{DateTime.Today:yyyy-MM-dd}.log");

                using var writer = File.AppendText(filePath);
                writer.WriteLine($"Time:{DateTime.Now:T}:{message}");
            }
        }
    }
}

                                        .Select(b => new BuyerDto
                                        {
                                            FirstName = b.FirstName,
                                            MiddleName = b.MiddleName,
                                            LastName = b.LastName
                                        }).ToList(),
                                    Sellers = orderDetailResponse.Order.Sellers?
                                        .Select(s => new SellerDto
                                        {
                                            FirstName = s.FirstName,
                                            MiddleName = s.MiddleName,
                                            LastName = s.LastName
                                        }).ToList(),
                                    Property = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property != null ? new PropertyDto
                                    {
                                        Number = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.Number,
                                        Direction = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.Direction,
                                        Street = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.Street,
                                        Suffix = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.Suffix,
                                        Unit = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.Unit,
                                        City = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.City,
                                        StateCode = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.StateCode,
                                        CountyName = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.CountyName,
                                        TaxParcel = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.TaxParcel,
                                        ZipCode = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.ZipCode,
                                        ZipPlus4 = orderDetailResponse.Order.Property.ZipPlus4
                                    } : null
                                };
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        response.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Order not found", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                    }
                }
            }

            response.IsSuccess = !response.Messages.Any();

            return response;
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Filters;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Web.Http;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Constants;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api
{
    public static class WebApiConfig
    {
        public static void Register(HttpConfiguration config)
        {
            // Add custom header filter to the global filters collection
            var headers = ResponseHeaderConstants.ResponseHeaderDictionary;

            var customHeaderFilter = new CustomHeaderFilter
            {
                Headers = headers
            };

            var customExceptionFilter = new CustomExceptionFilter
            {
                Headers = headers
            };

            config.Filters.Add(customHeaderFilter);

            config.Filters.Add(customExceptionFilter);

            // Web API routes
            config.MapHttpAttributeRoutes();

            config.Routes.MapHttpRoute(
                name: "DefaultApi",
                routeTemplate: "api/{controller}/{action}/{id}",
                defaults: new { id = RouteParameter.Optional }
            );
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Document;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response.Document;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Http;
using System.Web.Http.Description;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Controllers
{
    public class DocumentController : ApiController
    {
        private readonly IDocumentRenderService _documentRenderService;

        public DocumentController(IDocumentRenderService documentRenderService)
        {
            _documentRenderService = documentRenderService;
        }

        [System.Web.Http.HttpPut]
        [ResponseType(typeof(DocumentDownloadResponse))]
        public async Task<IHttpActionResult> Download(DocumentRenderRequest request)
        {
            var documentDownloadResponse = await _documentRenderService.Download(request);

            var result = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK);

            if (documentDownloadResponse.IsDocumentExported)
            {
                result.Content = new ByteArrayContent(documentDownloadResponse.ByteArray);

                result.Content.Headers.ContentDisposition = new ContentDispositionHeaderValue("attachment")
                {
                    FileName = documentDownloadResponse.FileName
                };
                result.Content.Headers.ContentType = new MediaTypeHeaderValue(MimeMapping.GetMimeMapping(documentDownloadResponse.FileName));
            }
            else
            {
                //var message = string.Join(", ",documentDownloadResponse.Messages);

                //result.Content = new StringContent(message);
                result.Content = new StringContent("Document generation failed. Please contact support if the issue persists.");
            }

            result.Content.Headers.Add("IsDocumentRendered", documentDownloadResponse.IsDocumentExported.ToString());

            var response = ResponseMessage(result);

            return response;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\SoftProSdk\FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api\Controllers\LogController.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Configuration;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Http;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Controllers
{
    public class LogController : ApiController
    {
        [HttpGet]
        public IHttpActionResult GetLogDetails(string fileName)
        {
            var path = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["LogPath"];

            var files = Directory.GetFiles(path);

            var file = files.FirstOrDefault(x => Path.GetFileName(x) == fileName);

            if (file != null && File.Exists(file))
            {
                List<string> logDetails = new List<string>();

                using (var stream = new FileStream(file, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite))
                using (var reader = new StreamReader(stream))
                {
                    while (!reader.EndOfStream)
                    {
                        logDetails.Add(reader.ReadLine());
                    }
                }

                return Ok(logDetails);
            }

            return NotFound();

        }
        [HttpGet]
        public IHttpActionResult GetOrderLogDetails(string fileName, string searchValue)
        {
            var path = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["SoftProSDKOrderLogsPath"];

            var files = Directory.GetFiles(path);

            var file = files.FirstOrDefault(x => Path.GetFileName(x) == fileName);

            if (file != null && File.Exists(file))
            {
                List<string> logDetails = new List<string>();

                using (var stream = new FileStream(file, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite))
                using (var reader = new StreamReader(stream))
                {
                    while (!reader.EndOfStream)
                    {
                        logDetails.Add(reader.ReadLine());
                    }
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchValue))
                {
                    logDetails = logDetails.Where(x => x.Contains(searchValue)).ToList();
                }

                return Ok(logDetails);
            }

            return NotFound();

        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\SoftProSdk\FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api\Filters\CustomExceptionFilter.cs
=================================================

using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NLog;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Runtime;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Http.Filters;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Filters
{
    public class CustomExceptionFilter : ExceptionFilterAttribute
    {

        private static readonly Logger NLogger = LogManager.Setup().LoadConfigurationFromFile("nlog.config").GetCurrentClassLogger();

        public Dictionary<string, string> Headers = new Dictionary<string, string>();

        public override void OnException(HttpActionExecutedContext actionExecutedContext)
        {
            var exceptionMessage = actionExecutedContext.Exception.InnerException == null ? actionExecutedContext.Exception.Message : actionExecutedContext.Exception.InnerException.Message;

            // Log error to text file.
            NLogger.Error(actionExecutedContext.Exception);

            var exceptionObject = new
            {
                Message = exceptionMessage,
                StackTrace = actionExecutedContext.Exception.StackTrace,
                InnerException = actionExecutedContext.Exception.InnerException
            };

            var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError)
            {
                //Content = new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(exceptionObject), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"),
                Content = new StringContent("Something Went Wrong!"),
                ReasonPhrase = "Internal Server Error.Please Contact your Administrator."
            };

            // Add custom headers if any.
            if (Headers != null)
            {
                foreach (var header in Headers)
                {
                    response.Headers.Add(header.Key, header.Value);
                }
            }

            actionExecutedContext.Response = response;
        }
    }
}


=================================================
FILE: Src\SoftProSdk\FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api\Filters\CustomHeaderFilter.cs
=================================================

using Aspose.Pdf;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NLog;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Runtime;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Http.Filters;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Filters
{
    public class CustomHeaderFilter : ActionFilterAttribute
    {
        public Dictionary<string, string> Headers = new Dictionary<string, string>();

        public override void OnActionExecuted(HttpActionExecutedContext actionExecutedContext)
        {
            if (Headers != null && actionExecutedContext.Response != null)
            {
                foreach (var header in Headers)
                {
                    actionExecutedContext.Response.Headers.Add(header.Key, header.Value);
                }
            }

            base.OnActionExecuted(actionExecutedContext);
        }
    }
}

    public class JsonHelper
    {
        public static IEnumerable<string> RetrievalUsingReflection(object obj)
        {
            foreach (var property in obj.GetType().GetProperties())
            {
                var jsonProperty = property.GetCustomAttribute<JsonPropertyAttribute>();

using System.Text;
using SoftPro.Documents.Client.Rendering;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Common
{
    public class RenderPrompts : IPrompt<PromptEventArgs>
    {
        public void Request(PromptEventArgs value)
        {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

            foreach (var prompt in value.Requests)
            {
                if (prompt is IValueRequest)
                {
                    IValueRequest response = (IValueRequest)prompt;
                    sb.Append(response.Handled + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Text + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Value + "|");
                }
                else if (prompt is ISelectionRequest)
                {
                    ISelectionRequest response = (ISelectionRequest)prompt;
                    sb.Append(response.Handled + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Text + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Selected + "|");
                }
                prompt.Handled = true;
            }
        }
    }

    public class BorrowerCDFRenderPrompts : IPrompt<PromptEventArgs>
    {
        public void Request(PromptEventArgs value)
        {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

            foreach (var prompt in value.Requests)
            {
                if (prompt is IValueRequest)
                {
                    IValueRequest response = (IValueRequest)prompt;
                    sb.Append(response.Handled + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Text + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Value + "|");

                    switch (response.ID)
                    {
                        case "DOCUMENTSTATUS":
                            if (response.Available != null && response.Available.Contains("Draft"))
                                response.Value = response.Available["Draft"];
                            break;
                    }

                }
                else if (prompt is ISelectionRequest)
                {
                    ISelectionRequest response = (ISelectionRequest)prompt;
                    sb.Append(response.Handled + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Text + "|");
                    sb.Append(response.Selected + "|");

                }
                prompt.Handled = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Extensions
{
    public static class Extensions
    {
        public static string ConvertToBase64(this Stream stream)
        {
            byte[] bytes;
            using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
                bytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
            }

            return Convert.ToBase64String(bytes);
        }
    }

FILE: Src\SoftProSdk\FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain\Extensions\PredicateBuilder.cs
=================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Extensions
{
    public static class PredicateBuilder
    {
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> True<T>() { return f => true; }
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> False<T>() { return f => false; }

        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> Or<T>(this Expression<Func<T, bool>> expr1,
                                                            Expression<Func<T, bool>> expr2)
        {
            var invokedExpr = Expression.Invoke(expr2, expr1.Parameters.Cast<Expression>());
            return Expression.Lambda<Func<T, bool>>
                  (Expression.OrElse(expr1.Body, invokedExpr), expr1.Parameters);
        }

        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> And<T>(this Expression<Func<T, bool>> expr1,
                                                             Expression<Func<T, bool>> expr2)
        {
            var invokedExpr = Expression.Invoke(expr2, expr1.Parameters.Cast<Expression>());
            return Expression.Lambda<Func<T, bool>>
                  (Expression.AndAlso(expr1.Body, invokedExpr), expr1.Parameters);
        }

    }
}
