using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response;
using System.Collections.Specialized;
using System.Configuration;
using System.Linq;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{ 
    public class AppService : IAppService
    {
        public ResponseMessage ValidateApprovedApps(string appId)
        {
            var response = new ResponseMessage();

            if (ConfigurationManager.GetSection(AppConstants.ApprovedAppSectionName) is NameValueCollection nameValues)
            {
                var approvedApps = nameValues.AllKeys.ToDictionary(k => k, v => nameValues[v]);

                if (!approvedApps.ContainsValue(appId))
                {
                    response.Messages.Add(ErrorConstants.InvalidAppMessage);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                response.Messages.Add(ErrorConstants.InvalidAppMessage);
            }

            return response;
        }
    }
}


=================================================
FILE: Src\SoftProSdk\FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure\Services\CashLoanService.cs
=================================================

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Document;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response.Order;
using SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Orders;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Enumerations;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Runtime;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class CashLoanService : ICashLoanService
    {
        private readonly IAppService _appService;
        private readonly ICommonService _commonService;
        private readonly ILogService _logService;

        public CashLoanService(IAppService appService, ICommonService commonService, ILogService logService)
        {
            _appService = appService;
            _commonService = commonService;
            _logService = logService;
        }

        public Task<OrderResponse> CashToLoan(CashLoanRenderRequest request)
        {
            var response = new OrderResponse();

            using (var selectServer = new SelectServerService().Open(request.Server))
            {
                IOrderStore orderStore = null;
                IOrder orderItem = null;
                IOrderInfo orderInfo = null;

                try
                {
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "****Cash to Loan Started*****");

                    orderStore = selectServer.GetService<IOrderStore>();

                    orderInfo = orderStore.Orders.Where(t => t.Number == request.OrderNumber).First();

                    orderItem = orderStore.OpenOrder(orderInfo, OrderEditMode.ReadWrite);
                    var order = (dynamic)orderItem;

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Order Opened");

                    var policyManager = selectServer.GetService<IEnumManager>();

                    order.IsCashSale = false;
                    order.PolicyType = policyManager.GetEnum<IOrderPolicyType>().Values
                                       .FirstOrDefault(pol => pol.Name == SoftProConstants.Simultaneous);


                    var lender = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)order.Contacts)
                                 .FirstOrDefault(x => x.ContactType == ContactType.Lender
                                 && x.Code == SoftProConstants.LenderContactCode);


                    var loanAmount = request.OrderData?.Loans?.FirstOrDefault()?.Funding?.LoanAmount;

                    foreach (var loan in order.Loans)
                    {
                        loan.Lender = lender;
                        loan.Funding.LoanAmount = Convert.ToDecimal(loanAmount);

                        break;
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Loan set");

                    foreach (var titleInsuranceCalculation in order.Title.TitleInsuranceCalculations)
                    {
                        titleInsuranceCalculation.PolicyType = PolicyType.Simultaneous;
                        titleInsuranceCalculation.SimultaneousIssueOptions.CalculateFullPremium = false;
                        titleInsuranceCalculation.LoanPolicy.VersionLookupCode = SoftProConstants.PolicyVersionLookupCode;

                        break;
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Title Insurance Calculation done");

                    foreach (var additionalCharge in AdditionalCharges.CashLoanCharges)
                    {
                        var additionalCharges = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)order.Title.AdditionalCharges;

                        if (!additionalCharges.Any(charge => charge.Description?.ToUpper() == additionalCharge?.ToUpper()))
                        {
                            dynamic newATC = orderItem.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.AdditionalTitleCharge);
                            newATC.Description = additionalCharge;

                            order.Title.AdditionalCharges.Add(newATC);
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Additional Title Charges added");

                    foreach (var endorsementLookupCode in AdditionalCharges.EndorsementLookupCodes)
                    {
                        var endorsments = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)((IEnumerable<dynamic>)order.Title.TitleInsuranceCalculations)
                                           .FirstOrDefault().LoanPolicy.Endorsements;

                        if (!endorsments.Any(charge => charge.LookupCode?.ToUpper() == endorsementLookupCode?.ToUpper()))
                        {
                            dynamic newEndorsement = orderItem.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.Endorsement);
                            newEndorsement.LookupCode = endorsementLookupCode;

                            ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)order.Title.TitleInsuranceCalculations)
                                           .FirstOrDefault().LoanPolicy.Endorsements.Add(newEndorsement);
                        }
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Endorsements added");

                    foreach (var cdf in order.CDFs)
                    {
                        foreach (var line in cdf.TaxesAndGovernmentFeesSection.Lines)
                        {
                            if (line.Number == 1)
                            {
                                int feeCounter = 0;
                                int feeCounts = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)line.Charges)?.FirstOrDefault()?.Fees.Count;

                                // Add Mortgage If not exists
                                if (feeCounts == 1)
                                {
                                    dynamic taxGovChargFee = orderItem.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.TaxAndGovernmentDetailChargeFee);

                                    ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)line.Charges)?.FirstOrDefault()?.Fees.Add(taxGovChargFee);

                                }

                                foreach (var fee in ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)line.Charges)?.FirstOrDefault()?.Fees)
                                {
                                    feeCounter++;
                                    if (feeCounter == 1)
                                    {
                                        fee.Pages = 1;
                                        fee.DocumentType = DocumentType.Deed;
                                    }
                                    else if (feeCounter == 2)
                                    {
                                        fee.Pages = 1;
                                        fee.DocumentType = DocumentType.Mortgage;
                                    }
                                }
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        break;
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "CDF completed");

                    response.Result.Messages = orderItem.GetMessages().Where(x => x.Level == OrderMessageLevel.Error).Select(x => new OrderMessage { Text = x.Text });

                    var resultMessages = response.Result.Messages as OrderMessage[] ?? response.Result.Messages.ToArray();

                    response.Result.Status = !resultMessages.Any() ? SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage : SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;

                    if (response.Result.Status == SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage)
                    {
                        orderStore.ApplyChanges(order);

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Order Saved success");

                        //response.Result.Select.Order.OrderData = order.Adapt<OrderData>();
                        response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = order.Number;
                        response.Result.SelectOrderGuid = order.Identifier.Guid;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + " Validation Errors-> " + string.Join(", ", resultMessages.Select(x => x.Text)));
                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Order Saved Failed");
                    }
                }
                catch (LockException ex)
                {
                    var message = $"Order Number:{request.OrderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";
                    _logService.LogInfo(message);

                    _commonService.OrderCloseRequest(orderStore, orderInfo);

                    // Return generic error response instead of throwing
                    response.Result.Status = SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = request.OrderNumber;

                    var messages = new List<OrderMessage>
                    {
                        new OrderMessage { Text = ex.Message }
                    };
                    response.Result.Messages = messages;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    var message = $"Order Number:{request.OrderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";
                    _logService.LogInfo(message);

                    // Return generic error response instead of throwing
                    response.Result.Status = SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = request.OrderNumber;

                    var messages = new List<OrderMessage>
                    {
                        new OrderMessage { Text = GetUserFriendlyErrorMessage(ex) }
                    };
                    response.Result.Messages = messages;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (orderItem != null)
                    {
                        orderStore?.CloseOrder(orderItem);
                        orderItem.Dispose();
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "****Cash to Loan Ended*****");
                }
            }

            return Task.FromResult(response);
        }

        public Task<OrderResponse> LoanToCash(CashLoanRenderRequest request)
        {
            var response = new OrderResponse();

            using (var selectServer = new SelectServerService().Open(request.Server))
            {
                IOrderStore orderStore = null;
                IOrder orderItem = null;
                IOrderInfo orderInfo = null;

                try
                {
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "****Loan to Cash Started*****");

                    orderStore = selectServer.GetService<IOrderStore>();

                    orderInfo = orderStore.Orders.Where(t => t.Number == request.OrderNumber).First();

                    orderItem = orderStore.OpenOrder(orderInfo, OrderEditMode.ReadWrite);
                    var order = (dynamic)orderItem;

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Order Opened");

                    var policyManager = selectServer.GetService<IEnumManager>();

                    order.IsCashSale = true;
                    order.PolicyType = policyManager.GetEnum<IOrderPolicyType>().Values
                                       .FirstOrDefault(pol => pol.Name == SoftProConstants.OwnersPolicy);

                    foreach (var loan in order.Loans)
                    {
                        ((IOrderItem)loan).Reset(SoftProConstants.Lender);
                        ((IOrderItem)loan.Funding).Reset(SoftProConstants.LoanAmount);
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Loans reset");

                    foreach (var titleInsuranceCalculation in order.Title.TitleInsuranceCalculations)
                    {
                        titleInsuranceCalculation.PolicyType = PolicyType.Owners;

                        break;
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "TitleInsuranceCalculations done");

                    foreach (var titleProduct in order.Title.TitleProducts)
                    {
                        if (titleProduct.Type == TitleProductType.Commitment)
                        {
                            foreach (var prepared in titleProduct.PreparedFor)
                            {
                                ((IOrderItem)prepared).Reset(SoftProConstants.Contact);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "TitleProducts done");

                    foreach (var lender in order.Lenders)
                    {
                        if (lender.Code == SoftProConstants.LenderContactCode)
                        {
                            order.Contacts.Remove(lender);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Lenders done");

                    foreach (var additionalCharge in order.Title.AdditionalCharges)
                    {
                        if (AdditionalCharges.CashLoanCharges.Any(charge => charge.ToUpper() == additionalCharge.Description?.ToUpper()))
                        {
                            order.Title.AdditionalCharges.Remove(additionalCharge);

                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "AdditionalCharges done");

                    foreach (var CDF in order.CDFs)
                    {
                        foreach (var line in CDF.TaxesAndGovernmentFeesSection.Lines)
                        {
                            if (line.Number == 1)
                            {
                                foreach (var fee in ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)line.Charges)?.FirstOrDefault()?.Fees)
                                {
                                    if (fee.DocumentType == DocumentType.Deed)
                                    {
                                        fee.Pages = 1;
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)line.Charges)?.FirstOrDefault()?.Fees.Remove(fee);
                                    }
                                }
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        break;
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "CDF done");

                    response.Result.Messages = orderItem.GetMessages().Where(x => x.Level == OrderMessageLevel.Error).Select(x => new OrderMessage { Text = x.Text });

                    var resultMessages = response.Result.Messages as OrderMessage[] ?? response.Result.Messages.ToArray();

                    response.Result.Status = !resultMessages.Any() ? SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage : SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;

                    if (response.Result.Status == SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage)
                    {
                        orderStore.ApplyChanges(order);

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Order Saved Success");

                        //response.Result.Select.Order.OrderData = order.Adapt<OrderData>();
                        response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = order.Number;
                        response.Result.SelectOrderGuid = order.Identifier.Guid;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + " Validation Errors-> " + string.Join(", ", resultMessages.Select(x => x.Text)));
                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "Order Saved Failed");

                    }
                }
                catch (LockException ex)
                {
                    var message = $"Order Number:{request.OrderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";
                    _logService.LogInfo(message);

                    _commonService.OrderCloseRequest(orderStore, orderInfo);

                    // Return generic error response instead of throwing
                    response.Result.Status = SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = request.OrderNumber;

                    var messages = new List<OrderMessage>
                    {
                        new OrderMessage { Text = ex.Message }
                    };
                    response.Result.Messages = messages;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    var message = $"Order Number:{request.OrderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";
                    _logService.LogInfo(message);

                    // Return generic error response instead of throwing
                    response.Result.Status = SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = request.OrderNumber;

                    var messages = new List<OrderMessage>
                    {
                        new OrderMessage { Text = GetUserFriendlyErrorMessage(ex) }
                    };
                    response.Result.Messages = messages;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (orderItem != null)
                    {
                        orderStore?.CloseOrder(orderItem);
                        orderItem.Dispose();
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.OrderNumber + " " + "****Loan to Cash Ended*****");

                }
            }

            return Task.FromResult(response);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extracts user-friendly error message without exposing stack traces
        /// </summary>
        private string GetUserFriendlyErrorMessage(Exception ex)
        {
            // Return only the exception message, not stack trace or inner exceptions
            return ex.Message;
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Common;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class CommonService : ICommonService
    {
        private readonly IAppService _appService;
        public CommonService(IAppService appService)
        {
            _appService = appService;
        }

        public Task<string> GetTextFromRtf(RtfConvertRequest request)
        {
            using (var rtBox = new RichTextBox())
            {
                rtBox.Rtf = request.Rtf;

                return Task.FromResult(rtBox.Text);
            }
        }

        public Task<bool> OrderCloseRequest(IOrderStore orderStore, IOrderInfo orderInfo)
        {
            bool isClosed = false; ;

            using (IOrder Order = orderStore.OpenOrder(orderInfo, OrderEditMode.ReadOnly))
            {
                var orderCloseRequest = orderStore.NewOrderCloseRequest(Order.Identifier);

                var oCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
                var oCancellationToken = oCancellationTokenSource.Token;

                oCancellationTokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1));

                isClosed = Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    orderCloseRequest.Execute(oCancellationToken);

                }, oCancellationToken).Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
            }

            return Task.FromResult(isClosed);
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Common;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Extensions;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Document;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response.Document;
using SoftPro.Documents.Client;
using SoftPro.Documents.Client.Rendering;
using SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Orders;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System.Diagnostics;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class DocumentExportService : IDocumentExportService
    {
        private readonly ILogService _logService;

        public DocumentExportService(ILogService logService)
        {
            _logService = logService;
        }
        public DocumentExportResponse Export(DocumentRenderRequest request)
        {
            var swRender = GetStopwatch();

            swRender.Start();

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + JsonConvert.SerializeObject(request.DocumentInfo));

            var response = new DocumentExportResponse();

            using (var selectServer = new SelectServerService().Open(request.Server))
            {
                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Server opened");

                var orderStore = selectServer.GetService<IOrderStore>();

                var orderInfo = orderStore.Orders.Where(t => t.Number == request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber).FirstOrDefault();

                var order = orderStore.OpenOrder(orderInfo, OrderEditMode.ReadOnly);

                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Order opened");

                var documentManager = selectServer.GetService<IDocumentManager>();
                IDocumentInfo docInfo = null;

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentIdentierName))
                {
                    docInfo = documentManager.Documents.First(t => t.Title.ToUpper() == request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName.ToUpper());
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentIdentierName))
                {
                    docInfo = documentManager.Documents.First(t => t.Title.ToUpper() == request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName.ToUpper() && t.Identifier.Name.ToUpper().Contains(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentIdentierName.ToUpper()));
                }
                _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber} Document found, Title:{docInfo.Title},ID:{docInfo.ID}");

                var context = GetDocumentContext(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName, order);

                var prompts = new RenderPrompts();
                var renderFactory = selectServer.GetService<IRendererFactory>();
                var renderer = renderFactory.Create();

                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Render factory created");

                var sw = GetStopwatch();
                sw.Start();
                var render = renderer.Render(docInfo, context, prompts);
                sw.Stop();
                var totalElapsedSeconds = sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;

                _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber} Total Elapsed seconds to render ` {request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName}` :{totalElapsedSeconds}");
                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Render completed");

                using (var file = new MemoryStream())
                {
                    Stream docStream = render.Export(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentFormat);
                    docStream.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.Begin);
                    docStream.CopyTo(file);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Document exported");

                    response.Base64String = Convert.ToBase64String(file.ToArray());
                }

                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Document Completed");
            }

            swRender.Stop();
            var totalRenderElapsedSeconds = swRender.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;

            _logService.LogInfo($"Order Number:{request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber} Total Elapsed seconds to complete document` {request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName}` render:{totalRenderElapsedSeconds}");
            return response;
        }

        private object GetDocumentContext(string documentName, IOrder order)
        {
            object context = null;
            switch (documentName.ToUpper())
            {
                case "INITIAL FEE QUOTE":
                    var invoices = (IList)order.GetProperty("Invoices");
                    context = (IOrderItem)invoices[0];
                    break;
                case "ALTA COMMITMENT 2021 WITH PRIVACY NOTICE (IL)":
                    var title = (IOrderItem)order.GetProperty("Title");
                    var commitments = (IList)title.GetProperty("Commitments");
                    context = (IOrderItem)commitments[0];
                    break;
                case "CLOSING DISCLOSURE FORM (CDF)":
                case "BORROWER CLOSING DISCLOSURE FORM (CDF)":
                    var cdfList = (IList)order.GetProperty("CDFs");
                    context = (IOrderItem)cdfList[0];
                    break;
                default:
                    context = order;
                    break;
            }

            return context;
        }

        private Stopwatch GetStopwatch()
        {
            return Stopwatch.StartNew();
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Document;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response.Document;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using SoftPro.Documents.Client;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Configuration;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class DocumentRenderService : IDocumentRenderService
    {
        private readonly IAppService _appService;
        private readonly ILogService _logService;
        public DocumentRenderService(IAppService appService, ILogService logService)
        {
            _appService = appService;
            _logService = logService;
        }

        public async Task<DocumentDownloadResponse> Download(DocumentRenderRequest request)
        {
            var documentDownloadResponse = new DocumentDownloadResponse();

            var appServiceValidationMessages = _appService.ValidateApprovedApps(request.AppId).Messages;

            if (appServiceValidationMessages.Any())
            {
                documentDownloadResponse.Messages.AddRange(appServiceValidationMessages);
                return documentDownloadResponse;
            }

            var args = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(request).Replace("\"", "\"\"");
            args = $"\"{args}\"";
            var startInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
            {
                FileName = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["DocumentExportExePath"],
                Arguments = args,
                CreateNoWindow = true,
                RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                UseShellExecute = false
            };

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " `" + request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName + "` *****Document Generation started*****");

            using (var myProcess = Process.Start(startInfo))
            {
                if (myProcess != null)
                {
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " Document Generation Process started");

                    var standardOutput = await myProcess.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync();

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(standardOutput) && standardOutput.StartsWith(SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage))
                    {
                        var fileBase64String = standardOutput.Replace(SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage, string.Empty).Trim();
                        documentDownloadResponse.ByteArray = Convert.FromBase64String(fileBase64String);
                        documentDownloadResponse.FileName = GetFileName(request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName,
                            request.DocumentInfo.DocumentFormat);

                        documentDownloadResponse.IsDocumentExported = true;

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " `" + request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName + "` Document Generation rendered successfully");

                    }
                    else
                    {
                        documentDownloadResponse.Messages.Add(standardOutput);
                        documentDownloadResponse.IsDocumentExported = false;

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " " + "Document Generation rendered failed for:" + " `" + request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName + "` " + standardOutput);
                    }

                    myProcess.WaitForExit();
                }
            }

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + request.DocumentInfo.OrderNumber + " `" + request.DocumentInfo.DocumentName + "` *****Document Generation Ended*****");


            return documentDownloadResponse;
        }

        private string GetFileName(string documentName, DocumentFormat format)
        {
            string documentFullName = string.Empty;

            switch (format)
            {
                case DocumentFormat.PortableDocumentFormat:
                    documentFullName = $"{documentName}.pdf";
                    break;
                case DocumentFormat.HTML:
                    documentFullName = $"{documentName}.html";
                    break;
                case DocumentFormat.MicrosoftExcel:
                    documentFullName = $"{documentName}.xlsx";
                    break;
                case DocumentFormat.MicrosoftWord:
                    documentFullName = $"{documentName}.docx";
                    break;
                case DocumentFormat.RichTextFormat:
                    documentFullName = $"{documentName}.rtf";
                    break;
            }

            return documentFullName;
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.CDFs;
using SoftPro.ClientModel;
using SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Orders;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using static SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Constants.Permissions.Order.EscrowClosing;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class LenderService : ILenderService
    {
        private readonly ILogService _logService;

        private string _orderNumber = string.Empty;

        public LenderService(ILogService logService)
        {
            _logService = logService;
        }
        public Task<string> DeleteOrClearLender(dynamic dOrder)
        {
            _orderNumber = dOrder.Number;

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "DeleteOrClearLender Started");

            var cdfs = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.CDFs;

            foreach (var cdf in cdfs)
            {
                var originationChargeLines = cdf.OriginationChargeSection.Lines;

                foreach (var originationChargeLine in originationChargeLines)
                {
                    ResetOriginationChargesOfLineItems(originationChargeLine);
                    ResetPag2LineItems(originationChargeLine);
                }
                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "OriginationChargeSection Lender Clear Done");

                var serviceNotShoppedForLines = cdf.ServiceNotShoppedForSection.Lines;

                foreach (var serviceNotShoppedForLine in serviceNotShoppedForLines)
                {
                    ResetPag2LineItems(serviceNotShoppedForLine);
                }
                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "ServiceNotShoppedForSection Lender Clear Done");

                var prepaidSectionLines = cdf.PrepaidSection.Lines;

                foreach (var prepaidSectionLine in prepaidSectionLines)
                {
                    ResetPag2LineItems(prepaidSectionLine);
                }
                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "PrepaidSection Lender Clear Done");

                var escrowSectionLines = cdf.EscrowSection.Lines;

                foreach (var escrowSectionLine in escrowSectionLines)
                {
                    ResetEscrowPaymentOfLineItems(escrowSectionLine);
                    ResetPag2LineItems(escrowSectionLine);
                }

                var totalClosingCostSectionLines = cdf.TotalClosingCostSection.Lines;

                foreach (var totalClosingCostSectionLine in totalClosingCostSectionLines)
                {
                    ResetTotalCostLineItems(totalClosingCostSectionLine);
                }
                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "TotalClosingCostSection Lender Clear Done");
            }

            var dLoans = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Loans;

            foreach (var loan in dLoans)
            {
                var loanItem = (IOrderItem)loan;

                if (loan != null && loanItem.HasProperty("Lender"))
                {
                    loan.Lender = null;
                    loan.LenderPerson = null;

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loans Lender Clear Done");

                    if (loan.InterimInterest != null)
                    {
                        var interimInterest = (IOrderItem)loan.InterimInterest;

                        loan.InterimInterest.DateTo = null;
                        interimInterest.Reset("PerDiemDays");
                        interimInterest.Reset("PerDiem");
                        interimInterest.Reset("PerDiemTotal");

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loans InterimInterest Done");

                    }
                }
            }

            foreach (var titleProduct in dOrder.Title.TitleProducts)
            {
                if (titleProduct.Type == TitleProductType.Commitment)
                {
                    foreach (var prepared in titleProduct.PreparedFor)
                    {
                        ((IOrderItem)prepared).Reset(SoftProConstants.Contact);

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loans TitleProducts Done");
                    }
                }

            }

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "DeleteOrClearLender Done");

            return Task.FromResult("Successfully Lender Deleted or Cleared");
        }
        private void ResetPag2LineItems(dynamic oCdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var dCharge = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges).First();
                var charge = (IOrderItem)dCharge;

                if (charge != null)
                {
                    if (charge.HasProperty("Contact"))
                    {
                        if (dCharge.Contact?.ContactTypeDescription == "Lender")
                        {
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidBeforeClosing"))
                            {
                                charge.Reset("BuyerPaidBeforeClosing"); 
                            }
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidAtClosing"))
                            {
                                charge.Reset("BuyerPaidAtClosing"); 
                            }
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("SellerPaidBeforeClosing"))
                            {
                                charge.Reset("SellerPaidBeforeClosing"); 
                            }
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("SellerPaidAtClosing"))
                            {
                                charge.Reset("SellerPaidAtClosing"); 
                            }
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaidByOthers"))
                            {
                                charge.Reset("PaidByOthers"); 
                            }
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Contact"))
                            {
                                charge.Reset("Contact"); 
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    foreach (var payor in dCharge.Payors)
                    {
                        if (payor != null)
                        {
                            var payorItem = (IOrderItem)payor;

                            if (payor.Contact?.ContactTypeDescription == "Lender")
                            {
                                payorItem.Reset("Contact");
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    foreach (var payee in dCharge.Payees)
                    {
                        if (payee != null)
                        {
                            var payeeItem = (IOrderItem)payee;

                            if (payee.Contact?.ContactTypeDescription == "Lender")
                            {
                                payeeItem.Reset("Contact");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void ResetEscrowPaymentOfLineItems(dynamic oCdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var dCharge = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges).First();
                var charge = (IOrderItem)dCharge;

                if (charge != null)
                {
                    if (charge.HasProperty("PaymentFrequency"))
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaymentFrequency"))
                        {
                            charge.Reset("PaymentFrequency"); 
                        }
                    }
                    if (charge.HasProperty("PaymentAmount"))
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaymentAmount"))
                        {
                            charge.Reset("PaymentAmount"); 
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void ResetOriginationChargesOfLineItems(dynamic oCdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var dCharge = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges).First();

                if (dCharge.Calculation != null)
                {
                    var calcItems = (IOrderItem)dCharge.Calculation;

                    if (calcItems != null && calcItems.HasProperty("Percent"))
                    {
                        if (!calcItems.GetIsReadOnly("Percent"))
                        {
                            calcItems.Reset("Percent"); 
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void ResetTotalCostLineItems(dynamic oCdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var dCharge = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges).First();
                var charge = (IOrderItem)dCharge;

                if (charge != null)
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidAtClosing"))
                    {
                        charge.Reset("BuyerPaidAtClosing");
                    }

                    foreach (var payor in dCharge.Payors)
                    {
                        if (payor != null)
                        {
                            var payorItem = (IOrderItem)payor;

                            if (payor.Contact?.ContactTypeDescription == "Lender")
                            {
                                payorItem.Reset("Contact");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Configuration;
using System.IO;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class LogService : ILogService
    {
        public void LogInfo(string message)
        {
            var path = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["SoftProSDKOrderLogsPath"];
            var enableLog = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["EnableSoftProSDKOrderLogsPath"];

            if (Convert.ToBoolean(enableLog))
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(path))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
                }
                var filePath = Path.Combine(path, $"{DateTime.Today:yyyy-MM-dd}.log");

                using (var writer = File.AppendText(filePath))
                {
                    writer.WriteLine($"Time:{DateTime.Now:T}:{message}");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.Specialized;
using System.Configuration;
using System.Linq;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.LookUps;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response;
using SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Lookups;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class LookUpService : ILookUpService
    {
        private readonly IAppService _appService;
        private readonly ISelectServerService _selectServerService;
        public LookUpService(ISelectServerService selectServerService, IAppService appService)
        {
            _selectServerService = selectServerService;
            _appService = appService;
        }
        public LookupDataResponse GetLookUpTableData(LookUpRequest request)
        {
            var lookupDataResponse = new LookupDataResponse();
            var appServiceValidationMessages = _appService.ValidateApprovedApps(request.AppId).Messages;

            if (appServiceValidationMessages.Any())
            {
                lookupDataResponse.Messages.AddRange(appServiceValidationMessages);
                return lookupDataResponse;
            }

            var selectServer = _selectServerService.Open(request.Server);

            var lookups = selectServer.GetService<ILookups>();

            var lookUpTable = lookups.QueryTable(request.LookupQuerySpec);

            lookupDataResponse.LookupRows = lookUpTable.Rows
                .Select(row => lookUpTable.Columns.ToDictionary(col => col.Name, c => row[c].Value));

            return lookupDataResponse;
        }

        public UpdateLookupDataResponse UpdateLookUpTableData(UpdateLookUpRequest request)
        {
            var lookupDataResponse = new UpdateLookupDataResponse();

            var appServiceValidationMessages = _appService.ValidateApprovedApps(request.AppId).Messages;

            if (appServiceValidationMessages.Any())
            {
                lookupDataResponse.Messages.AddRange(appServiceValidationMessages);
                return lookupDataResponse;
            }

            var selectServer = _selectServerService.Open(request.Server);

            var lookups = selectServer.GetService<ILookups>();

            var lookUpTable = lookups.QueryTable(request.LookupQuerySpec);

            foreach (var row in request.Rows)
            {
                var newRow = lookUpTable.NewRow();

                lookUpTable.Rows.Add(newRow);

                foreach (var col in row)
                {
                    newRow[col.Key] = newRow.NewValue(false, col.Value);
                }
            }

            lookups.ApplyChanges(lookUpTable);

            return lookupDataResponse;

        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services

    public class ReadOrderService : IReadOrderService
    {
        private readonly IAppService _appService;
        public ReadOrderService(IAppService appService)
        {
            _appService = appService;
        }

        public Task<OrderResponse> Read(ReadOrderRequest request)
        {
            var response = new OrderResponse();

            using (var selectServer = new SelectServerService().Open(request.Server))
            {
                var orderStore = selectServer.GetService<IOrderStore>();

                var orderInfo = orderStore.Orders.Where(t => t.Number == request.Payload.Select.Order.OrderNumber).First();

                var order = orderStore.OpenOrder(orderInfo, OrderEditMode.ReadOnly);
                var dynamicOrder = (dynamic)order;

                try
                {

                    response.Result.Select.Order.OrderData = order.Adapt<OrderData>();
                    
                    // For Custom Property.
                    response.Result.Select.Order.OrderData.AdditionalAttorneyAgentAmount = Convert.ToDecimal(order.GetProperty("NatlRate_AddlAttAgentAmt_FNFIL#"));

                    response.Result.Messages = order.GetMessages().Select(x => new OrderMessage { Text = x.Text });
                    response.Result.Status = !response.Result.Messages.Any() ? SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage : SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;

                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = dynamicOrder.Number;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderGuid = dynamicOrder.Identifier.Guid;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (order != null)
                    {
                        orderStore?.CloseOrder(order);
                        order.Dispose();
                    }
                }
            }

            return Task.FromResult(response);
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Net;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Server;
using SoftPro.Select.Client;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class SelectServerService : ISelectServerService
    { 
        //private readonly ISelectServer _selectServer;

        //public SelectServerService(ISelectServer selectServer)
        //{
        //    _selectServer = selectServer;
        //}

        public SelectServer Open(ServerRequest request)
        {
            var selectUri = new Uri(request.SelectUri);

            SelectServer selectServer;

            if (request.Credential == null)
            {
                selectServer = new SelectServer(selectUri);
            }
            else
            {
                var certValue = $"{request.SelectUri}|{request.CertPin}";

                Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(AppConstants.CertPin, certValue);
                selectServer = new SelectServer(selectUri, request.Credential);
            }

            if (selectServer.TryAuthenticate(out var reason))
            {
                selectServer.EnsureAuthenticated();
            }
            else
            {
                throw new Exception(reason);
            }

            return selectServer;
        }
    }
}
