using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Common;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Constants;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.CDFs;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.ClosingFigures.AdditionalTitleChargeDetails;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.Common;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.Loans;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.Parties;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.TitleDetails;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Request.Document;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.Response.Order;
using SoftPro.ClientModel;
using SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Lookups;
using SoftPro.OrderTracking.Client.Orders;
using SoftPro.Select.Client;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Enumerations;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Runtime;
using SoftPro.Select.Client.Security;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Contact = FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiDomain.OrderData.Parties.Contact;
using IEnumManager = SoftPro.Select.Client.Enumerations.IEnumManager;
using Task = System.Threading.Tasks.Task;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class UpdateOrderService : IUpdateOrderService
    {
        private readonly IAppService _appService;
        private readonly ICommonService _commonService;
        private readonly ILogService _logService;
        private readonly ILenderService _lenderService;

        private string _orderNumber = string.Empty;
        public UpdateOrderService(IAppService appService, ICommonService commonService, ILogService logService, ILenderService lenderService)
        {
            _appService = appService;
            _commonService = commonService;
            _logService = logService;
            _lenderService = lenderService;
        }

        public Task<OrderResponse> Update(UpdateOrderRequest request)
        {
            var response = new OrderResponse();

            using (var selectServer = new SelectServerService().Open(request.Server))
            {
                IOrderStore orderStore = null;
                IOrder order = null;
                IOrderInfo orderInfo = null;
                try
                {
                    _orderNumber = request.Payload?.Select?.Order?.OrderNumber;
                    // If ambiguity for multiple rows for lookup,take first row always.

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "****Update started****");

                    DisambiguateLookups(selectServer);

                    orderStore = selectServer.GetService<IOrderStore>();

                    orderInfo = orderStore.Orders.Where(t => t.Number == request.Payload.Select.Order.OrderNumber).First();

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Order Found");

                    order = orderStore.OpenOrder(orderInfo, OrderEditMode.ReadWrite);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Order Opened");

                    var dynamicOrder = (dynamic)order;

                    var orderData = request.Payload.Select.Order.OrderData;

                    var properties = JsonHelper.RetrievalUsingReflection(orderData);

                    if (properties.Any())
                    {
                        //var addAttorneyAmount = properties.FirstOrDefault(x => x == "NatlRate_AddlAttAgentAmt_FNFIL#");

                        SetCustomPropertyValue(order, "NatlRate_AddlAttAgentAmt_FNFIL#", orderData.AdditionalAttorneyAgentAmount);
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Custom property done");


                    SetDisbursementDate(dynamicOrder, orderData.DisbursementDate);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "DisbursementDate done");

                    CreateOrUpdatePropertyAddresses(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, orderData);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CreateOrUpdatePropertyAddresses done");

                    ClearRepresentsForListingAgent(dynamicOrder);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "ClearRepresentsForListingAgent done");

                    ClearRepresentsForSellingAgent(dynamicOrder);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "ClearRepresentsForSellingAgent done");

                    CreateOrUpdateContacts(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, orderData);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CreateOrUpdateContacts done");

                    SetRepresentsForListingAgent(dynamicOrder);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "SetRepresentsForListingAgent done");

                    if (orderData.SalesContract != null)
                    {
                        dynamicOrder.SalesContract.SalesPrice = orderData.SalesContract.SalesPrice;

                        if (orderData.SalesContract.EarnestMoney != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var deposit in orderData.SalesContract.EarnestMoney.Deposits)
                            {
                                var oDeposit = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dynamicOrder.SalesContract.EarnestMoney.Deposits)
                                    .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == deposit.Guid);

                                oDeposit.Amount = deposit.Amount;

                                if (deposit.PortionRetained?.RetainedBy != null)
                                {
                                    var orderContact = GetOrCreateGetContact(order, dynamicOrder, deposit.PortionRetained?.RetainedBy);

                                    oDeposit.PortionRetained.RetainedBy = orderContact;
                                }
                            }

                        }
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "SalesContract done");

                    UpdateLoans(order, dynamicOrder, orderData.Loans);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "UpdateLoans done");

                    UpdateCDFContacts(order, dynamicOrder, orderData.CDFs?.FirstOrDefault());

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "UpdateCDFContacts done");

                    UpdateTaxes(dynamicOrder, orderData.Properties);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "UpdateTaxes done");

                    if (orderData.Title != null && orderData.Title.AdditionalCharges != null)
                    {
                        AddOrRemoveAdditionalTitleCharges(order, dynamicOrder, orderData.Title.AdditionalCharges);
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "AddOrRemoveAdditionalTitleCharges done");

                    RemoveEndorsements(order, dynamicOrder, orderData.Title?.TitleInsuranceCalculations?.FirstOrDefault());

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "RemoveEndorsements done");

                    CreateOrUpdateLine(order, dynamicOrder, orderData.CDFs?.FirstOrDefault());

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CreateOrUpdateLine done");

                    UpdateTasks(selectServer, dynamicOrder, orderData.Tasks);

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "UpdateTasks done");

                    response.Result.Messages = order.GetMessages().Where(x => x.Level == OrderMessageLevel.Error).Select(x => new OrderMessage { Text = x.Text });

                    var resultMessages = response.Result.Messages as OrderMessage[] ?? response.Result.Messages.ToArray();

                    response.Result.Status = !resultMessages.Any() ? SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage : SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;

                    if (response.Result.Status == SoftProConstants.SuccessMessage)
                    {
                        orderStore.ApplyChanges(order);

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Order Saved success");

                        //response.Result.Select.Order.OrderData = order.Adapt<OrderData>();
                        response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = dynamicOrder.Number;
                        response.Result.SelectOrderGuid = dynamicOrder.Identifier.Guid;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + " Validation Errors-> " + string.Join(", ", resultMessages.Select(x => x.Text)));
                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Order Saved Failed");
                    }

                }
                catch (LockException ex)
                {
                    var message = $"Order Number:{_orderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";
                    _logService.LogInfo(message);

                    _commonService.OrderCloseRequest(orderStore, orderInfo);

                    // Return generic error response instead of throwing
                    response.Result.Status = SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = _orderNumber;
                    
                    var messages = new List<OrderMessage>
                    {
                        new OrderMessage { Text = ex.Message }
                    };
                    response.Result.Messages = messages;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    var message = $"Order Number:{_orderNumber} Message:{ex.Message} StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}Inner Exception:{ex.InnerException}";
                    _logService.LogInfo(message);

                    // Return generic error response instead of throwing
                    response.Result.Status = SoftProConstants.FailureMessage;
                    response.Result.SelectOrderNumber = _orderNumber;
                    
                    var messages = new List<OrderMessage>
                    {
                        new OrderMessage { Text = GetUserFriendlyErrorMessage(ex) }
                    };
                    response.Result.Messages = messages;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (order != null)
                    {
                        orderStore?.CloseOrder(order);
                        order.Dispose();
                    }

                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "****Update Ended****");
                }
            }

            return Task.FromResult(response);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extracts user-friendly error message without exposing stack traces
        /// </summary>
        private string GetUserFriendlyErrorMessage(Exception ex)
        {
            // Return only the exception message, not stack trace or inner exceptions
            return ex.Message;
        }

        private void SetCustomPropertyValue(IOrder order, string property, object value)
        {
            if (value != null)
            {
                order.SetProperty(property, value);
            }
        }
        private void SetDisbursementDate(dynamic dOrder, DateTime? date)
        {
            if (date != null)
            {
                dOrder.DisbursementDate = Date.Parse(date.ToShortString());
            }
        }
        private dynamic GetOrCreateGetContact(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, Contact contact)
        {
            var orderContacts = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts;

            var orderContact = orderContacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == contact?.Guid);

            if (contact != null)
            {
                if (contact.FindBy != null)
                {
                    orderContact = GetContactBySearchKey(orderContacts, contact.FindBy);
                }

                if (orderContact == null)
                {
                    orderContact = order.CreateNew(contact.ContactTypeDescription);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(contact.Name)) orderContact.Name = contact.Name;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(contact.OtherType))
                    {
                        var orderContactItem = (IOrderItem)orderContact;

                        if (orderContactItem.HasProperty("OtherType"))
                        {
                            orderContact.OtherType = contact.OtherType;
                        }
                    }

                    dOrder.Contacts.Add(orderContact);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(contact.Name)) orderContact.Name = contact.Name;
                }
            }

            return orderContact;
        }

        private void UpdateCDFContacts(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, ClosingFiguresCDF closingFigures)
        {

            if (closingFigures != null)
            {
                var oCdf = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.CDFs)?.FirstOrDefault();

                var cdfContacts = closingFigures.Contacts;

                if (cdfContacts != null)
                {
                    foreach (var cdfContact in cdfContacts)
                    {
                        var oCdfContacts = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdf.Contacts;

                        if (oCdfContacts != null)
                        {
                            var oCdfContact = oCdfContacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfContact.Guid);
                            var dContacts = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts;

                            if (oCdfContact != null && cdfContact.Contact != null)
                            {
                                var dContact = dContacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfContact.Contact.Guid);

                                if (dContact != null)
                                {
                                    oCdfContact.Contact = dContact;

                                    if (cdfContact.Person != null && cdfContact.Person.FindBy != null)
                                    {
                                        // Get person from contact based on search Key and Value.
                                        var dPerson = GetPersonBySearchKey(dContact, cdfContact.Person?.FindBy);

                                        if (dPerson != null)
                                        {
                                            oCdfContact.Person = dPerson;
                                        }
                                    }

                                }
                                _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "UpdateCDFContacts Contacts done");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private dynamic GetPersonBySearchKey(dynamic contact, FindObject findBy)
        {
            dynamic person = null;

            if (contact != null && findBy != null && findBy.SearchKeys != null && findBy.SearchKeys.Any())
            {
                var searchDict = findBy.SearchKeys.First();

                switch (searchDict.Key.ToUpper())
                {
                    case "GUID":
                        person = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)contact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == Guid.Parse(searchDict.Value));
                        break;
                    case "FIRSTNAME":
                        person = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)contact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.FirstName == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                    case "LASTNAME":
                        person = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)contact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.LastName == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                    case "EMAIL":
                        person = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)contact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Email == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                    case "PHONE":
                        person = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)contact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Phone == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                }
            }
            return person;
        }

        private dynamic GetContactBySearchKey(IEnumerable<dynamic> contacts, FindObject findBy)
        {
            dynamic contact = null;

            if (contacts != null && findBy != null && findBy.SearchKeys != null && findBy.SearchKeys.Any())
            {
                var searchDict = findBy.SearchKeys.First();

                switch (searchDict.Key.ToUpper())
                {
                    case "GUID":
                        contact = contacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == Guid.Parse(searchDict.Value));
                        break;
                    case "CODE":
                        contact = contacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                    case "NAME":
                        contact = contacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                    case "EMAIL":
                        contact = contacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Email == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                    case "PHONE":
                        contact = contacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Phone == searchDict.Value);
                        break;
                }
            }
            return contact;
        }
        private void CreateOrUpdateLine(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, ClosingFiguresCDF closingFigures)
        {
            if (closingFigures != null)
            {

                var cdfs = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.CDFs;

                foreach (var cdf in cdfs)
                {
                    // Closing Date
                    if (closingFigures?.ClosingDate != null)
                    {
                        cdf.ClosingDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind((DateTime)closingFigures.ClosingDate, DateTimeKind.Local);
                    }
                    // Purpose
                    if (closingFigures?.Preferences != null && cdf?.Preferences != null)
                    {
                        if (closingFigures.Preferences.Purpose != null)
                        {
                            cdf.Preferences.Purpose = closingFigures.Preferences.Purpose;
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF Preferences done");

                    if (closingFigures.OriginationChargeSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.OriginationChargeSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.OriginationChargeSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.OriginationChargeDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.OriginationChargeDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF OriginationChargeSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.ServiceShoppedForSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.ServiceShoppedForSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.ServiceShoppedForSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.ServiceShoppedForDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.ServiceShoppedForDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2ServiceShoppedLineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF ServiceShoppedForSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.ServiceNotShoppedForSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.ServiceNotShoppedForSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.ServiceNotShoppedForSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.ServiceNotShoppedForDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.ServiceNotShoppedForDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF ServiceNotShoppedForSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.TaxesAndGovernmentFeesSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.TaxesAndGovernmentFeesSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.TaxesAndGovernmentFeesSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.TaxesAndGovernmentFeesDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.TaxAndGovernmentDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF TaxesAndGovernmentFeesSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.PrepaidSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.PrepaidSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.PrepaidSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.PrepaidDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.PrepaidDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF PrepaidSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.EscrowSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.EscrowSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.EscrowSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.EscrowSectionDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.EscrowDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF EscrowSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.OtherCostSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.OtherCostSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.OtherCostSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine, CdfLineItemConstants.OtherCostDetailLine, CdfLineItemConstants.OtherCostDetailPayee);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF OtherCostSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.TotalClosingCostSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.TotalClosingCostSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.TotalClosingCostSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                UpdatePage2TotalCostLineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2TotalCostLineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF TotalClosingCostSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.PayoffAndPaymentSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.PayoffAndPaymentSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.PayoffAndPaymentSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                UpdatePage2PayOffAndPaymentLineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdf, cdfLine);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag2LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF PayoffAndPaymentSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.DueFromBuyerSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.DueFromBuyerSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.DueFromBuyerSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                UpdatePag3LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdfLine);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag3LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF DueFromBuyerSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.DueToBuyerSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.DueToBuyerSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.DueToBuyerSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                UpdatePag3LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdfLine);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag3LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF DueToBuyerSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.DueFromSellerSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.DueFromSellerSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.DueFromSellerSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                UpdatePag3LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdfLine);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag3LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF DueFromSellerSection done");

                    if (closingFigures.DueToSellerSection != null)
                    {
                        var lines = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)cdf.DueToSellerSection.Lines;

                        foreach (var cdfLine in closingFigures.DueToSellerSection.Lines)
                        {
                            var oCdfLine = lines.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == cdfLine.Guid);

                            if (!cdfLine.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                            {
                                UpdatePag3LineItems(order, dOrder, oCdfLine, cdfLine);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ResetPag3LineItems(oCdfLine);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "CDF DueToSellerSection done");

                    // Only first CDF and ignore other CDFs.
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        private void AddOrRemoveAdditionalTitleCharges(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, List<AdditionalCharge> additionalCharges)
        {
            var oAdditionalCharges = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Title.AdditionalCharges;

            foreach (var additionalCharge in additionalCharges)
            {
                var oAdditionalCharge = oAdditionalCharges?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == additionalCharge.Guid);

                if (!additionalCharge.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                {
                    if (oAdditionalCharge == null)
                    {
                        oAdditionalCharge = order.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.AdditionalTitleCharge);

                        dOrder.Title.AdditionalCharges.Add(oAdditionalCharge);
                    }

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(additionalCharge.Description)) oAdditionalCharge.Description = additionalCharge.Description;
                    if (additionalCharge.SellerPayPercent != null) oAdditionalCharge.SellerPayPercent = Convert.ToDecimal(additionalCharge.SellerPayPercent);

                    var addChargeCalc = additionalCharge.ChargeCalculation;

                    if (addChargeCalc?.FinalCharge != null) oAdditionalCharge.ChargeCalculation.FinalCharge = Convert.ToDecimal(addChargeCalc.FinalCharge);

                }
                else if (additionalCharge.IsDeleted.CanDelete() && oAdditionalCharge != null)
                {
                    dOrder.Title.AdditionalCharges.Remove(oAdditionalCharge);
                }
            }
        }
        private void RemoveEndorsements(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, TitleInsuranceCalculation titleInsuranceCalculation)
        {
            var otitleInsuranceCalculations = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Title.TitleInsuranceCalculations;

            foreach (var otitleInsuranceCalculation in otitleInsuranceCalculations)
            {
                var oOwnerPolicyEndorsements = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)otitleInsuranceCalculation.OwnersPolicy?.Endorsements;

                if (titleInsuranceCalculation?.OwnersPolicy?.Endorsements != null)
                {
                    foreach (var endorsement in titleInsuranceCalculation.OwnersPolicy.Endorsements.Where(x => x.IsDeleted.CanDelete()))
                    {
                        var oEndorsement = oOwnerPolicyEndorsements?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == endorsement.Guid);

                        if (oEndorsement != null)
                        {
                            otitleInsuranceCalculation.OwnersPolicy.Endorsements.Remove(oEndorsement);
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (titleInsuranceCalculation?.LoanPolicy?.Endorsements != null)
                {
                    var oLoanPolicyEndorsements = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)otitleInsuranceCalculation.LoanPolicy?.Endorsements;

                    foreach (var endorsement in titleInsuranceCalculation.LoanPolicy.Endorsements.Where(x => x.IsDeleted.CanDelete()))
                    {
                        var oEndorsement = oLoanPolicyEndorsements?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == endorsement.Guid);

                        if (oEndorsement != null)
                        {
                            otitleInsuranceCalculation.LoanPolicy.Endorsements.Remove(oEndorsement);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

        }

        private void CreateUpdatePag2LineItems(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, dynamic oCdfLine, dynamic cdf, CDFLine cdfLine, string detailLine, string detailLinePayee)
        {
            if (oCdfLine == null)
            {
                oCdfLine = order.CreateNew(detailLine);

                cdf.Lines.Add(oCdfLine);
            }
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var charge = (IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0];

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Description))
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Description"))
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].Description = cdfLine.Description;
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Reference))
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Reference"))
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].Reference = cdfLine.Reference;
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.ContactName))
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("ContactName"))
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].ContactName = cdfLine.ContactName;
                }
                if (cdfLine.SellerPaidAtClosing != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.SellerPaidAtClosing != 0)
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("SellerPaidAtClosing"))
                            oCdfLine.Charges[0].SellerPaidAtClosing = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.SellerPaidAtClosing);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("SellerPaidAtClosing"))
                            ((IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0]).Reset("SellerPaidAtClosing");
                    }
                }
                if (cdfLine.BuyerPaidAtClosing != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.BuyerPaidAtClosing != 0)
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidAtClosing"))
                            oCdfLine.Charges[0].BuyerPaidAtClosing = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.BuyerPaidAtClosing);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidAtClosing"))
                            ((IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0]).Reset("BuyerPaidAtClosing");
                    }
                }
                if (cdfLine.BuyerPaidBeforeClosing != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.BuyerPaidBeforeClosing != 0)
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidBeforeClosing"))
                            oCdfLine.Charges[0].BuyerPaidBeforeClosing = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.BuyerPaidBeforeClosing);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("BuyerPaidBeforeClosing"))
                            ((IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0]).Reset("BuyerPaidBeforeClosing");
                    }
                }
                if (cdfLine.PaidByOthers != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.PaidByOthers != 0)
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaidByOthers"))
                            oCdfLine.Charges[0].PaidByOthers = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.PaidByOthers);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaidByOthers"))
                            ((IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0]).Reset("PaidByOthers");
                    }
                }
                if (cdfLine.Contact != null)
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Contact"))
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].Contact = GetOrCreateGetContact(order, dOrder, cdfLine.Contact);
                }

                var cdfCharges = cdfLine.Charges;

                if (cdfCharges != null && cdfCharges.Any())
                {
                    var cdfCharge = cdfCharges.First();

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfCharge.CostPaidMethod))
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("CostPaidMethod"))
                            oCdfLine.Charges[0].CostPaidMethod = GeCostPaidType(cdfCharge.CostPaidMethod);
                    }

                    if (cdfCharge.Payors != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var payor in cdfCharge.Payors)
                        {
                            if (payor.CanSetContactToNewLine == true)
                            {
                                var oPayor =
                                ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges[0].Payors).FirstOrDefault(x =>
                                    x.Contact == null);

                                if (oPayor == null)
                                {
                                    oPayor =
                                       ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges[0].Payors).FirstOrDefault(x =>
                                           x.Contact?.Code == "L");
                                }
                                if (oPayor != null)
                                {
                                    oPayor.Contact = GetOrCreateGetContact(order, dOrder, payor.Contact);
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                var oPayor =
                                    ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges[0].Payors).FirstOrDefault(x =>
                                        x.Guid == payor.Guid);

                                if (oPayor != null)
                                {
                                    oPayor.Contact = GetOrCreateGetContact(order, dOrder, payor.Contact);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (cdfCharge.Payees != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var payee in cdfCharge.Payees)
                        {
                            var oPayee =
                                ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oCdfLine.Charges[0].Payees).FirstOrDefault(x =>
                                    x.Guid == payee.Guid);

                            if (oPayee == null)
                            {
                                oPayee = order.CreateNew(detailLinePayee);

                                oCdfLine.Charges[0].Payees.Add(oPayee);
                            }

                            if (oPayee != null)
                            {
                                oPayee.Contact = GetOrCreateGetContact(order, dOrder, payee.Contact);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Months (only for Prepaid)
                if (detailLine == CdfLineItemConstants.PrepaidDetailLine)
                {
                    if (cdfCharges != null && cdfCharges.Any())
                    {
                        var cdfCharge = cdfCharges.First();

                        if (cdfCharge.Months != null)
                        {
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Months"))
                                oCdfLine.Charges[0].Months = Convert.ToInt32(cdfCharge.Months);
                        }
                    }

                }
                if (detailLine == CdfLineItemConstants.EscrowSectionDetailLine)
                {
                    if (cdfCharges != null && cdfCharges.Any())
                    {
                        var cdfCharge = cdfCharges.First();

                        if (cdfCharge.PaymentAmount != null)
                        {
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaymentAmount"))
                                oCdfLine.Charges[0].PaymentAmount = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfCharge.PaymentAmount);
                        }
                        if (cdfCharge.PaymentFrequency != null)
                        {
                            if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("PaymentFrequency"))
                                oCdfLine.Charges[0].PaymentFrequency = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfCharge.PaymentFrequency);
                        }

                    }
                }
                // Percent Loan Calculation.
                if (detailLine == CdfLineItemConstants.OriginationChargeDetailLine)
                {
                    if (cdfCharges != null && cdfCharges.Any())
                    {
                        var cdfCharge = cdfCharges.First();

                        if (cdfCharge.Calculation != null)
                        {
                            if (cdfCharge.Calculation.Percent != null)
                            {
                                oCdfLine.Charges[0].Calculation.Percent = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfCharge.Calculation.Percent);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void UpdatePage2TotalCostLineItems(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, dynamic oCdfLine, dynamic cdf, TotalClosingCostDetailLine cdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Description))
                {
                    oCdfLine.Charges[0].Description = cdfLine.Description;
                }
                if (cdfLine.BuyerPaidAtClosing != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.BuyerPaidAtClosing != 0)
                    {
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].BuyerPaidAtClosing = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.BuyerPaidAtClosing);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ((IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0]).Reset("BuyerPaidAtClosing");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void UpdatePage2PayOffAndPaymentLineItems(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, dynamic oCdfLine, dynamic cdf, PayoffAndPaymentSummaryLine cdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Description))
                {
                    oCdfLine.Charges[0].Description = cdfLine.Description;
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Reference))
                {
                    oCdfLine.Charges[0].Reference = cdfLine.Reference;
                }
                if (cdfLine.Amount != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.Amount != 0)
                    {
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].Amount = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.Amount);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ((IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0]).Reset("Amount");
                    }
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.ContactName))
                {
                    oCdfLine.Charges[0].ContactName = cdfLine.ContactName;
                }
                if (cdfLine.Contact != null)
                {
                    oCdfLine.Charges[0].Contact = GetOrCreateGetContact(order, dOrder, cdfLine.Contact);
                }
            }
        }

        private void UpdatePag3LineItems(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, dynamic oCdfLine, SummaryLine cdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var charge = (IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0];

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Description))
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Description"))
                    {
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].Description = cdfLine.Description;
                    }
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cdfLine.Reference))
                {
                    if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Reference"))
                    {
                        oCdfLine.Charges[0].Reference = cdfLine.Reference;
                    }
                }

                if (cdfLine.Charges != null && cdfLine.Charges[0]?.Amount != null)
                {
                    if (cdfLine.Charges[0].Amount > 0)
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Amount"))
                        {
                            oCdfLine.Charges[0].Amount = Convert.ToDecimal(cdfLine.Charges[0].Amount);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (!charge.GetIsReadOnly("Amount"))
                        {
                            charge.Reset("Amount");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void ResetPag2LineItems(dynamic oCdfLine)
        {
            if (oCdfLine != null)
            {
                var charge = (IOrderItem)oCdfLine.Charges[0];

                if (charge != null)
                {
                    // charge.Reset("Description");
                    charge.Reset("Reference");
                    charge.Reset("Contact");
                    charge.Reset("SellerPaidAtClosing");
                    charge.Reset("BuyerPaidAtClosing");
                    charge.Reset("PaidByOthers");

                    if (charge.HasProperty("Amount"))
                    {
                        charge.Reset("Amount");
                    }

                }
            }
        }

            if (oCdfLine != null)

                    charge.Reset("BuyerPaidAtClosing");
                }
            }
        }

        private void UpdateTaxes(dynamic dOrder, List<PropertyAddress> properties)
        {
            if (properties != null)
            {
                foreach (var property in properties)
                {
                    var oProperties = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Properties;

                    if (property != null)
                    {
                        var oProperty = oProperties.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == property.Guid);

                        if (property.Taxes != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var tax in property.Taxes)
                            {
                                if (oProperty != null)
                                {
                                    var oTax = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)oProperty.Taxes).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == tax.Guid);

                                    if (oTax != null && oTax.BuyerTax != null)
                                    {
                                        oTax.BuyerTax.Amount = tax.BuyerTax.Amount;

                                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tax.BuyerTax.PeriodFrom))
                                        {
                                            oTax.BuyerTax.PeriodFrom = Date.Parse(tax.BuyerTax.PeriodFrom);
                                        }
                                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tax.BuyerTax.PeriodTo))
                                        {
                                            oTax.BuyerTax.PeriodTo = Date.Parse(tax.BuyerTax.PeriodTo);
                                        }

                                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "UpdateTaxes Property Tax done");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void UpdateTasks(SelectServer selectServer, dynamic dOrder, List<ApiDomain.OrderData.Tasks.Task> tasks)
        {
            if (tasks != null)
            {
                var securityManager = selectServer.GetService<ISecurityManager>();

                foreach (var task in tasks)
                {
                    var oTask = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Tasks).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == task.Guid);

                    if (oTask != null)
                    {
                        if (task.AssignedTo != null)
                        {
                            var identity = securityManager.Identities.FirstOrDefault(item => item.ID == task.AssignedTo.ID);

                            oTask.AssignedTo = identity;
                        }

                        oTask.Status = GetTaskType(task.Status);

                    }
                }
            }
        }


        private void CreateOrUpdatePropertyAddresses(SelectServer selectServer, IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, OrderData orderData)
        {
            if (orderData.Properties != null)
            {
                foreach (var property in orderData.Properties)
                {
                    var dProperty = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Properties).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == property.Guid);

                    if (!property.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdatePropertyAddress(selectServer, dProperty?.Address, property.Address);
                        UpdatePropertyAddressOtherDetails(selectServer, dProperty, property);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteProperty(dOrder, property.Address);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void UpdateLoans(IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, List<Loan> loans)
        {
            if (loans != null)
            {
                foreach (var loan in loans)
                {
                    var dLoan = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Loans).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == loan.Guid);

                    if (dLoan == null)
                    {
                        dLoan = order.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.Loan);

                        dOrder.Loans.Add(dLoan);
                    }

                    dLoan.Number = loan.Number;

                    if (loan.Product != null) dLoan.Product = GetProductType(loan.Product);

                    if (loan.Type != null)
                    {
                        var loanType = GetLoanType(loan.Type);

                        dLoan.Type = loanType;

                        if (loanType == LoanType.Other) dLoan.TypeDescription = loan.TypeDescription;
                    }

                    if (loan.MortgageInsuranceCaseNumber != null) dLoan.MortgageInsuranceCaseNumber = loan.MortgageInsuranceCaseNumber;

                    if (loan.Funding != null && dLoan.Funding != null)
                    {
                        dLoan.Funding.LoanAmount = loan.Funding.LoanAmount;
                    }
                    _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loan Basic done");

                    // Loan Terms.
                    if (loan.Terms != null && dLoan.Terms != null)
                    {
                        if (loan.Terms.LoanTerm != null) dLoan.Terms.LoanTerm = loan.Terms.LoanTerm;
                        if (loan.Terms.LoanTermYears != null) dLoan.Terms.LoanTermYears = Convert.ToInt32(loan.Terms.LoanTermYears);
                        if (loan.Terms.InterestRate != null) dLoan.Terms.InterestRate = Convert.ToDecimal(loan.Terms.InterestRate);
                        if (loan.Terms.HasPrepaymentPenalty != null) dLoan.Terms.HasPrepaymentPenalty = Convert.ToBoolean(loan.Terms.HasPrepaymentPenalty);
                        if (loan.Terms.HasBalloonPayment != null) dLoan.Terms.HasBalloonPayment = Convert.ToBoolean(loan.Terms.HasBalloonPayment);
                        if (loan.Terms.CanLoanBalanceRise != null) dLoan.Terms.CanLoanBalanceRise = Convert.ToBoolean(loan.Terms.CanLoanBalanceRise);
                        if (loan.Terms.CanInterestRateRise != null) dLoan.Terms.CanInterestRateRise = Convert.ToBoolean(loan.Terms.CanInterestRateRise);

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loan Terms done");
                    }


                    if (loan.InterimInterest != null && dLoan.InterimInterest != null)
                    {
                        if (loan.InterimInterest.DateFrom != null)
                        {
                            var interimInterest = (IOrderItem)dLoan.InterimInterest;

                            if (!interimInterest.GetIsReadOnly("DateFrom"))
                            {
                                dLoan.InterimInterest.DateFrom = Date.Parse(loan.InterimInterest.DateFrom.ToShortString());
                            }
                        }
                        if (loan.InterimInterest.DateTo != null) dLoan.InterimInterest.DateTo = Date.Parse(loan.InterimInterest.DateTo.ToShortString());

                        if (loan.InterimInterest.PerDiemDays != null) dLoan.InterimInterest.PerDiemDays = Convert.ToInt32(loan.InterimInterest.PerDiemDays);
                        if (loan.InterimInterest.PerDiem != null) dLoan.InterimInterest.PerDiem = Convert.ToDecimal(loan.InterimInterest.PerDiem);
                        if (loan.InterimInterest.PerDiemTotal != null) dLoan.InterimInterest.PerDiemTotal = Convert.ToDecimal(loan.InterimInterest.PerDiemTotal);

                        _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loan InterimInterest done");

                    }

                    var dContacts = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts;

                    if (dContacts != null)
                    {
                        if (loan.Lender != null)
                        {
                            var dLender = dContacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == loan.Lender.Guid);

                            if (dLender != null)
                            {
                                dLoan.Lender = dLender;
                            }
                            if (loan.LenderPerson != null)
                            {
                                var dLenderPerson = GetPersonBySearchKey(dLender, loan.LenderPerson?.FindBy);

                                if (dLenderPerson != null)
                                {
                                    dLoan.LenderPerson = dLenderPerson;
                                }
                            }
                            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loan Lender done");

                        }

                        if (loan.MortgageBroker != null)
                        {
                            var dMortgageBroker = dContacts.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == loan.MortgageBroker.Guid);

                            // If MortgageBroker contact is not found by Guid, then try to find by SearchKey.
                            if (dMortgageBroker == null)
                            {
                                dMortgageBroker = GetContactBySearchKey(dContacts, loan.MortgageBroker.FindBy);
                            }
                            if (dMortgageBroker != null)
                            {
                                dLoan.MortgageBroker = dMortgageBroker;
                            }

                            var dMortgageBrokerPerson = GetPersonBySearchKey(dMortgageBroker, loan.MortgageBrokerPerson?.FindBy);

                            if (dMortgageBrokerPerson != null)
                            {
                                dLoan.MortgageBrokerPerson = dMortgageBrokerPerson;
                            }

                            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Loan MortgageBroker done");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void CreateOrUpdateContacts(SelectServer selectServer, IOrder order, dynamic dynamicOrder, OrderData orderData)
        {
            if (orderData.Attorneys != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.Attorneys)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.Attorney);

                        // Clear Represents if it is set to ClearRepresents.
                        if (contact.Represents?.ClearRepresents == true)
                        {
                            ClearRepresentsAttorney(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Attorneys done");

            if (orderData.ListingAgentBrokers != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.ListingAgentBrokers)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.ListingAgentBroker);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "ListingAgentBrokers done");

            if (orderData.SellingAgentBrokers != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.SellingAgentBrokers)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.SellingAgentBroker);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "SellingAgentBrokers done");

            if (orderData.SettlementAgents != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.SettlementAgents)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.SettlementAgent);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "SettlementAgents done");

            if (orderData.MortgageBrokers != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.MortgageBrokers)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.MortgageBroker);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "MortgageBrokers done");

            if (orderData.Lenders != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.Lenders)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.Lender);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Clear all references of Lender before delete based on the flag.
                        if (contact.ShouldClearReferences == true)
                        {

                            _lenderService.DeleteOrClearLender(dynamicOrder);

                        }
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Lenders done");

            if (orderData.PayoffLenders != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.PayoffLenders)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.PayoffLender);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "PayoffLenders done");

            if (orderData.HazardInsuranceAgents != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.HazardInsuranceAgents)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.HazardInsuranceAgent);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "HazardInsuranceAgents done");

            if (orderData.Governments != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.Governments)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateContact(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.Government);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Governments done");

            if (orderData.Sellers != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.Sellers)
                {
                    if (!contact.IsDeleted.CanDelete())
                    {
                        CreateOrUpdateSeller(selectServer, order, dynamicOrder, contact, SoftProConstants.Seller);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DeleteContact(dynamicOrder, contact.Guid);
                    }
                }
            }
            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Sellers done");

            if (orderData.Buyers != null)
            {
                foreach (var contact in orderData.Buyers)
                {

                    {

            _logService.LogInfo("Order Number:" + _orderNumber + " " + "Buyers done");

        }

        private void CreateOrUpdateContact(SelectServer selectServer, IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, ThickContact contact, string contactType)
        {
            var dContact = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == contact.Guid);

            if (dContact == null)
            {
                dContact = order.CreateNew(contactType);

                dOrder.Contacts.Add(dContact);
            }

            if (contact.Name != null) dContact.Name = contact.Name;
            if (contact.Phone != null) dContact.Phone = contact.Phone;
            if (contact.Fax != null) dContact.Fax = contact.Fax;
            if (contact.Email != null) dContact.Email = contact.Email;
            if (contact.NationwideMortgageLicenseID != null) dContact.NationwideMortgageLicenseID = contact.NationwideMortgageLicenseID;

            if (contact.License != null)
            {
                if (contact.License.Number != null) dContact.License.Number = contact.License.Number;
            }

            if (contact.IsMarketingSource != null) dContact.IsMarketingSource = Convert.ToBoolean(contact.IsMarketingSource);

            UpdateContactAddress(selectServer, dContact.Address, contact.Address);
            CreateOrUpdateThickPeople(order, dContact, contact.People);
        }
        private void DeleteContact(dynamic dOrder, Guid contactGuid)
        {
            var dContact = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == contactGuid);

            if (dContact != null)
            {
                // Dereference represents to delete contact successfully.
                var contactItem = (IOrderItem)dContact;

                if (contactItem.HasProperty("Represents"))
                {
                    dContact.Represents = null;
                }
                dOrder.Contacts.Remove(dContact);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateContactAddress(SelectServer selectServer, dynamic contactAddress, Address address)
        {
            if (address != null && contactAddress != null)
            {
                if (address.Address1 != null) contactAddress.Address1 = address.Address1;
                if (address.Address2 != null) contactAddress.Address2 = address.Address2;
                if (address.City != null) contactAddress.City = address.City;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(address.State))
                {
                    var enumManger = selectServer.GetService<IEnumManager>();
                    var states = enumManger.GetEnum<IState>();

                    var state = states.Values.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Code?.ToUpper() == address.State.ToUpper() || s.Description?.ToUpper() == address.State.ToUpper());

                    contactAddress.State = state;
                }
                if (address.Zip != null) contactAddress.Zip = address.Zip;
            }
        }

        private void CreateOrUpdatePeople(IOrder order, dynamic dContact, List<Person> people)
        {
            if (people != null)
            {
                foreach (var person in people)
                {
                    var dContactPerson = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dContact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == person.Guid);

                    // Create a new person if not exist.
                    if (dContactPerson == null)
                    {
                        dContactPerson = order.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.Person);

                        dContact.People.Add(dContactPerson);
                    }

                    if (person.FirstName != null) dContactPerson.FirstName = person.FirstName;
                    if (person.MiddleName != null) dContactPerson.MiddleName = person.MiddleName;
                    if (person.LastName != null) dContactPerson.LastName = person.LastName;
                    if (person.Phone != null) dContactPerson.Phone = person.Phone;
                    if (person.Cell != null) dContactPerson.Cell = person.Cell;
                    if (person.Home != null) dContactPerson.Home = person.Home;
                    if (person.Fax != null) dContactPerson.Fax = person.Fax;
                    if (person.Email != null) dContactPerson.Email = person.Email;
                    if (person.IsMainPerson != null) dContactPerson.IsMainPerson = Convert.ToBoolean(person.IsMainPerson);
                    if (person.LookupCode != null) dContactPerson.LookupCode = person.LookupCode;
                }
            }
        }

        private void CreateOrUpdateThickPeople(IOrder order, dynamic dContact, List<ThickPerson> people)
        {
            if (people != null)

                foreach (var person in people)

                    var dContactPerson = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dContact.People).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == person.Guid);

                    // Create a new person if not exist.
                    if (dContactPerson == null)
                    {
                        dContactPerson = order.CreateNew(SoftProConstants.Person);

                        dContact.People.Add(dContactPerson);
                    }

                    if (person.FirstName != null) dContactPerson.FirstName = person.FirstName;
                    if (person.MiddleName != null) dContactPerson.MiddleName = person.MiddleName;
                    if (person.LastName != null) dContactPerson.LastName = person.LastName;
                    if (person.Phone != null) dContactPerson.Phone = person.Phone;
                    if (person.Cell != null) dContactPerson.Cell = person.Cell;
                    if (person.Home != null) dContactPerson.Home = person.Home;
                    if (person.Fax != null) dContactPerson.Fax = person.Fax;
                    if (person.Email != null) dContactPerson.Email = person.Email;
                    if (person.IsMainPerson != null) dContactPerson.IsMainPerson = Convert.ToBoolean(person.IsMainPerson);
                    if (person.LookupCode != null) dContactPerson.LookupCode = person.LookupCode;
                    if (person.NationwideMortgageLicenseID != null) dContactPerson.NationwideMortgageLicenseID = person.NationwideMortgageLicenseID;

                    if (person.License != null && dContactPerson.License != null)

                        if (person.License.Number != null) dContactPerson.License.Number = person.License.Number;

                }
            }
        }
        private void CreateOrUpdateSeller(SelectServer selectServer, IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, Seller contact, string contactType)
        {
            var dContact = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == contact.Guid);

            if (dContact == null)
            {
                dContact = order.CreateNew(contactType);

                dOrder.Contacts.Add(dContact);
            }

            if (contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "MALE" || contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "FEMALE" || contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "JOINT")
            {
                if (contact.BuyerSellerType != null) dContact.BuyerSellerType = GetBuyerSellerType(contact.BuyerSellerType);

                if (contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "MALE" || contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "FEMALE")
                {
                    if (contact.Individual1 != null)
                    {
                        SetIndividual(dContact.Individual1, contact.Individual1);
                    }
                }
                else if (contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "JOINT")
                {
                    if (contact.Individual1 != null)
                    {
                        SetIndividual(dContact.Individual1, contact.Individual1);
                    }
                    if (contact.Individual2 != null)
                    {
                        SetIndividual(dContact.Individual2, contact.Individual2);
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (contact.BuyerSellerType != null) dContact.BuyerSellerType = GetBuyerSellerType(contact.BuyerSellerType);
                if (contact.Name != null) dContact.Name = contact.Name;
                if (contact.Phone != null) dContact.Phone = contact.Phone;
                if (contact.Fax != null) dContact.Fax = contact.Fax;
                if (contact.Email != null) dContact.Email = contact.Email;
            }

            UpdateContactAddress(selectServer, dContact.ForwardingAddress?.Address, contact.ForwardingAddress?.Address);
            UpdateContactAddress(selectServer, dContact.Address, contact.Address);
        }
        private void CreateOrUpdateBuyer(SelectServer selectServer, IOrder order, dynamic dOrder, Buyer contact, string contactType)
        {
            var dContact = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Contacts).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == contact.Guid);

            if (dContact == null)

            }

            if (contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "MALE" || contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "FEMALE" || contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "JOINT")
            {
                if (contact.BuyerSellerType != null) dContact.BuyerSellerType = GetBuyerSellerType(contact.BuyerSellerType);

                if (contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "MALE" || contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "FEMALE")
                {
                    if (contact.Individual1 != null)
                    {
                        SetIndividual(dContact.Individual1, contact.Individual1);
                    }
                }
                else if (contact.BuyerSellerType?.ToUpper() == "JOINT")
                {
                    if (contact.Individual1 != null)
                    {
                        SetIndividual(dContact.Individual1, contact.Individual1);
                    }
                    if (contact.Individual2 != null)
                    {
                        SetIndividual(dContact.Individual2, contact.Individual2);
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (contact.BuyerSellerType != null) dContact.BuyerSellerType = GetBuyerSellerType(contact.BuyerSellerType);
                if (contact.Name != null) dContact.Name = contact.Name;
                if (contact.Phone != null) dContact.Phone = contact.Phone;
                if (contact.Fax != null) dContact.Fax = contact.Fax;
                if (contact.Email != null) dContact.Email = contact.Email;

            UpdateContactAddress(selectServer, dContact.Address, contact.Address);
        }
        private void SetIndividual(dynamic dIndividual, Individual individual)
