            if (individual.MiddleName != null) dIndividual.MiddleName = individual.MiddleName;
            if (individual.LastName != null) dIndividual.LastName = individual.LastName;
            if (individual.Phone != null) dIndividual.Phone = individual.Phone;
            if (individual.Home != null) dIndividual.Home = individual.Home;
            if (individual.Fax != null) dIndividual.Fax = individual.Fax;
            if (individual.Cell != null) dIndividual.Cell = individual.Cell;
            if (individual.Email != null) dIndividual.Email = individual.Email;
        }
        private void CreateOrUpdatePropertyAddress(SelectServer selectServer, dynamic dPropertyAddress, Address propertyAddress)
        {
            if (propertyAddress != null && dPropertyAddress != null)
            {
                if (propertyAddress.Address1 != null) dPropertyAddress.Address1 = propertyAddress.Address1;
                if (propertyAddress.Address2 != null) dPropertyAddress.Address2 = propertyAddress.Address2;
                if (propertyAddress.City != null) dPropertyAddress.City = propertyAddress.City;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyAddress.State))
                {
                    var enumManger = selectServer.GetService<IEnumManager>();
                    var states = enumManger.GetEnum<IState>();

                    var state = states.Values.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Code == propertyAddress.State.ToUpper());

                    dPropertyAddress.State = state;
                }
                if (propertyAddress.Zip != null) dPropertyAddress.Zip = propertyAddress.Zip;
            }
        }
        private void UpdatePropertyAddressOtherDetails(SelectServer selectServer, dynamic dProperty, PropertyAddress property)
        {
            if (property != null && dProperty != null)
            {
                // Appriasal
                if (property.Appraisal != null && dProperty.Appraisal != null)
                {
                    if (property.Appraisal.AppraisedValue != null)
                    {
                        dProperty.Appraisal.AppraisedValue = Convert.ToDecimal(property.Appraisal.AppraisedValue);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void DeleteProperty(dynamic dOrder, Address propertyAddress)
        {
            var dProperty = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Properties).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Address.Guid == propertyAddress.Guid);

            if (dProperty != null)
            {
                dOrder.Properties.Remove(dProperty);
            }
        }
        private TaskStatusType GetTaskType(string taskType)
        {
            var softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.None;

            switch (taskType)
            {
                case "None":
                    softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.None;
                    break;
                case "Required":
                    softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.Required;
                    break;
                case "Requested":
                    softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.Requested;
                    break;
                case "Completed":
                    softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.Completed;
                    break;
                case "Received":
                    softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.Received;
                    break;
                case "NA":
                    softProTaskType = TaskStatusType.NA;
                    break;
            }

            return softProTaskType;
        }

        private BuyerSellerType GetBuyerSellerType(string buyerSellerType)
        {
            var softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Male;

            switch (buyerSellerType.ToUpper())
            {
                case "MALE":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Male;
                    break;
                case "FEMALE":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Female;
                    break;
                case "JOINT":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Joint;
                    break;
                case "CORPORATION":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Corporation;
                    break;
                case "LIMITEDLIABILITYCOMPANY":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.LimitedLiabilityCompany;
                    break;
                case "LIMITEDLIABILITYCORP":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.LimitedLiabilityCorp;
                    break;
                case "LIMITEDPARTNERSHIP":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.LimitedPartnership;
                    break;
                case "PARTNERSHIP":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Partnership;
                    break;
                case "TRUST":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Trust;
                    break;
                case "ESTATE":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Estate;
                    break;
                case "OTHER":
                    softProBuyerSellerType = BuyerSellerType.Other;
                    break;
            }

            return softProBuyerSellerType;
        }
        private LoanType GetLoanType(string loanType)
        {
            var softProLoanType = LoanType.None;

            switch (loanType.ToUpper())
            {
                case "CONVENTIONALINSURED":
                    softProLoanType = LoanType.ConventionalInsured;
                    break;
                case "CONVENTIONALUNINSURED":
                    softProLoanType = LoanType.ConventionalUninsured;
                    break;
                case "FHA":
                    softProLoanType = LoanType.FHA;
                    break;
                case "VA":
                    softProLoanType = LoanType.VA;
                    break;
                case "OTHER":
                    softProLoanType = LoanType.Other;
                    break;
            }

            return softProLoanType;
        }
        private LoanProductType GetProductType(string productType)
        {
            var softProLoanType = LoanProductType.None;

            switch (productType.ToUpper())
            {
                case "FIXEDRATE":
                    softProLoanType = LoanProductType.FixedRate;
                    break;
                case "ADJUSTABLERATE":
                    softProLoanType = LoanProductType.AdjustableRate;
                    break;
                case "STEPRATE":
                    softProLoanType = LoanProductType.StepRate;
                    break;
                case "GRADUATEDPAYMENTARM":
                    softProLoanType = LoanProductType.GraduatedPaymentARM;
                    break;
                case "GRADUATEDPAYMENTMORTGAGE":
                    softProLoanType = LoanProductType.GraduatedPaymentMortgage;
                    break;
                case "GROWINGEQUITYMORTGAGE":
                    softProLoanType = LoanProductType.GrowingEquityMortgage;
                    break;
            }

            return softProLoanType;
        }
        private CostPaidMethod GeCostPaidType(string costPaidType)
        {
            var softProCostPaidType = CostPaidMethod.AtClosing;

            switch (costPaidType.ToUpper())
            {
                case "AT CLOSING":
                    softProCostPaidType = CostPaidMethod.AtClosing;
                    break;
                case "BEFORE CLOSING":
                    softProCostPaidType = CostPaidMethod.BeforeClosing;
                    break;
                case "BY OTHERS":
                    softProCostPaidType = CostPaidMethod.ByOthers;
                    break;
            }

            return softProCostPaidType;
        }
        private void ClearRepresentsForListingAgent(dynamic dOrder)
        {
            var listingAgents = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.ListingAgentBrokers;

            if (listingAgents != null)
            {
                foreach (var listingAgent in listingAgents)
                {
                    var contactItem = (IOrderItem)listingAgent;

                    if (contactItem.HasProperty("Represents"))
                    {
                        listingAgent.Represents = null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void ClearRepresentsForSellingAgent(dynamic dOrder)
        {
            var sellingAgents = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.SellingAgentBrokers;

            if (sellingAgents != null)
            {
                foreach (var sellingAgent in sellingAgents)
                {
                    var contactItem = (IOrderItem)sellingAgent;

                    if (contactItem.HasProperty("Represents"))
                    {
                        sellingAgent.Represents = null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void ClearRepresentsAttorney(dynamic dOrder, Guid contactGuid)
        {
            var dAttorneyContact = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Attorneys).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Guid == contactGuid);

            if (dAttorneyContact != null)
            {
                var contactItem = (IOrderItem)dAttorneyContact;

                if (contactItem.HasProperty("Represents"))
                {
                    dAttorneyContact.Represents = null;
                }
            }
        }
        private void SetRepresentsForListingAgent(dynamic dOrder)
        {
            var seller = ((IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.Sellers).FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "S");
            var listingAgents = (IEnumerable<dynamic>)dOrder.ListingAgentBrokers;

            if (listingAgents != null && seller != null)
            {
                foreach (var listingAgent in listingAgents)
                {
                    var contactItem = (IOrderItem)listingAgent;

                    if (contactItem.HasProperty("Represents"))
                    {
                        listingAgent.Represents = seller;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void DisambiguateLookups(SelectServer selectServer)
        {
            var lookups = selectServer.GetService<ILookups>();

            lookups.DisambiguateLookupRow += (obj, e) =>
            {
                e.SelectRow(e.LookupTable.Rows.First());
            };
        }
    }

}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ApplicationBuilderExtensions
    {
        public static IApplicationBuilder AppendHeader(this IApplicationBuilder builder,Dictionary<string,string> headers)
        {
            return builder.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                foreach (var header in headers)
                {
                    context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value); 
                }

                await next();
            });
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ConfigurationExtension
    {
        public static void AddConfiguration<T>(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration, string configurationTag = null) where T : class
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(configurationTag))
            {
                configurationTag = typeof(T).Name;
            }

            var instance = Activator.CreateInstance<T>();
            new ConfigureFromConfigurationOptions<T>(configuration.GetSection(configurationTag)).Configure(instance);
            services.AddSingleton(instance);
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\TitlePoint\FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.Api\Extensions\ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions.cs
=================================================

using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.Api.Extensions
{
    public static class ExceptionMiddlewareExtensions
    {
        public static void ConfigureExceptionHandler(this IApplicationBuilder app, ILogger logger, Dictionary<string, string> headers = null)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler(appError =>
            {

                appError.Run(async context =>
                {
                    // Add custom headers to the response.
                    if (headers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var header in headers)
                        {
                            context.Response.Headers.Append(header.Key, header.Value);
                        }
                    }

                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

                    var contextFeature = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>();

                    if (contextFeature is not null)
                    {
                        logger.LogError(contextFeature.Error, contextFeature.Error.Message);

                        var internalServerJson = new ErrorDetails
                        {
                            StatusCode = context.Response.StatusCode,
                            Message = "Internal Server Error."
                        };

                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(internalServerJson);
                    }

                });
            });
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\TitlePoint\FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure\Services\AddressSearchService.cs
=================================================

using System.ServiceModel;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using TitlePointService;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class AddressSearchService : IAddressSearch
    {
        private const int MaxWaitSeconds = 20;

        private readonly ICreateService3 _service3;
        private readonly IGetResultsByID3 _getResultsById3;
        private readonly IRequestSummaries _requestSummaries;
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;

        public AddressSearchService(ICreateService3 service3, IGetResultsByID3 getResultsById3,
            IRequestSummaries requestSummaries, ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration)
        {
            _service3 = service3;
            _getResultsById3 = getResultsById3;
            _requestSummaries = requestSummaries;
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;
        }
        public AddressSearchResponse AddressSearch(TitlePointRequest request)
        {
            var addressSearchResponse = new AddressSearchResponse
            {
                PickListResults = [],
                TaxReportResults = [],
                OwnershipAndEncumbranceResults = []
            };

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != request.AppId))
            {
                addressSearchResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                return addressSearchResponse;
            }

            var response = _service3.CreateService(request);

            if (!response.CreateService3Result.ReturnErrors.Any())
            {
                GetRequestSummariesRequest summaryRequest = new()
                {
                    maxWaitSeconds = MaxWaitSeconds,
                    userID = request.userID,
                    password = request.password,
                    requestId = response.CreateService3Result.RequestID
                };
                List<RequestSummary> requestSummaries;
                do
                {
                    requestSummaries = _requestSummaries.GetRequestSummaries(summaryRequest);
                } while (requestSummaries[0].Status == AsynchronousRequestStatus.Processing);

                if (requestSummaries.Any() && requestSummaries.First().Status == AsynchronousRequestStatus.Complete)
                {
                    GetResultByID3Request resultById3Request = new()
                    {
                        company = request.company,
                        department = request.department,
                        titleOfficer = request.titleOfficer,
                        userID = request.userID,
                        password = request.password
                    };

                    var resultById3Responses = _getResultsById3.GetResultsByID3(requestSummaries, resultById3Request);

                    foreach (var resultById3Response in resultById3Responses)
                    {
                        var result = resultById3Response.GetResultByID3Result.Result;

                        if (result is PickListResult pickListResult)
                        {
                            addressSearchResponse.PickListResults.Add(pickListResult);
                        }
                        else if (result is TaxReportResult taxReportResult)
                        {
                            addressSearchResponse.TaxReportResults.Add(taxReportResult);
                        }
                        else if (result is OwnershipAndEncumbranceResult ownershipAndEncumbranceResult)
                        {
                            addressSearchResponse.OwnershipAndEncumbranceResults.Add(ownershipAndEncumbranceResult);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                foreach (var error in response.CreateService3Result.ReturnErrors)
                {
                    addressSearchResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ErrorDescription, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                }
            }

            return addressSearchResponse;
        }
    }
}

using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using System.ServiceModel;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using TitlePointImageServices;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class GetDocumentByKeyService : IGetDocumentByKey
    {
        private readonly ConnectedServiceConfiguration _connectedServiceConfiguration;
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;

        public GetDocumentByKeyService(ConnectedServiceConfiguration connectedServiceConfiguration, ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration)
        {
            _connectedServiceConfiguration = connectedServiceConfiguration;
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;
        }

        public GetDocByKeyResponse GetDocumentByKey(DocumentByKeyRequest request)
        {
            GetDocByKeyResponse docByKeyResponse = new();

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != request.AppId))
            {
                docByKeyResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                return docByKeyResponse;
            }

            var tpsClient = new TpsImageSoapClient(TpsImageSoapClient.EndpointConfiguration.TpsImageSoap);
            tpsClient.Endpoint.Address = new EndpointAddress(_connectedServiceConfiguration.TitlePointImageServiceBaseAddress);

            var geDocumentResponses = tpsClient.GetDocumentByKey(request);

FILE: Src\TitlePoint\FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure\Services\GetResultsByID3Service.cs
=================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.ServiceModel;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using TitlePointService;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class GetResultsById3Service : IGetResultsByID3
    {
        private readonly ConnectedServiceConfiguration _connectedServiceConfiguration;
        public GetResultsById3Service(ConnectedServiceConfiguration connectedServiceConfiguration)
        {
            _connectedServiceConfiguration = connectedServiceConfiguration;
        }
        public List<GetResultByID3Response> GetResultsByID3(List<RequestSummary> requestSummaries, GetResultByID3Request request)
        {
            List<GetResultByID3Request> resultRequest = new List<GetResultByID3Request>();

            List<GetResultByID3Response> resultResponse = new List<GetResultByID3Response>();

            var tpsClient = new TpsServiceSoapClient(TpsServiceSoapClient.EndpointConfiguration.TpsServiceSoap);

            tpsClient.Endpoint.Address = new EndpointAddress(_connectedServiceConfiguration.TitlePointServiceBaseAddress);

            // Look at each summary and call GetResultsByID3
            foreach (RequestSummary summary in requestSummaries)
            {
                foreach (Service item in summary.Order.Services)
                {
                    foreach (ResultThumbNail nail in item.ThumbNails)
                    {
                        GetResultByID3Request newRequest = new()
                        {
                            userID = request.userID,
                            password = request.password,
                            company = request.company,
                            department = request.department,
                            titleOfficer = request.titleOfficer,
                            resultID = nail.ID
                        };

                        switch (nail.ResultType)
                        {
                            case "TitlePoint.StarterResult":
                            case "TitlePoint.OwnershipAndEncumbranceResult":
                                newRequest.requestingTPXML = false;
                                resultRequest.Add(newRequest);
                                break;
                            case "TitlePoint.ResultWithLineItems":
                                break;
                            default:
                                newRequest.requestingTPXML = true;
                                resultRequest.Add(newRequest);
                                break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Now we call GetResultsByID3 with each summary ID from GetSummaries response

            foreach (GetResultByID3Request orderRequest in resultRequest)
            {
                var response = tpsClient.GetResultByID3(orderRequest);
                resultResponse.Add(response);
            }

            return resultResponse;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\TitlePoint\FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure\Services\NameSearchService.cs
=================================================

using System.ServiceModel;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using TitlePointService;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class NameSearchService : INameSearch
    {
        private const int MaxWaitSeconds = 20;

        private readonly ICreateService _createService;
        private readonly IGetResultsByID3 _getResultsById3;
        private readonly IRequestSummaries _requestSummaries;
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;

        public NameSearchService(ICreateService service3, IGetResultsByID3 getResultsById3,
            IRequestSummaries requestSummaries, ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration)
        {
            _createService = service3;
            _getResultsById3 = getResultsById3;
            _requestSummaries = requestSummaries;
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;

        }
        public NameSearchResponse NameSearch(NameSearchRequest request)
        {
            var nameSearchResponse = new NameSearchResponse
            {
                DocumentListResults = new List<DocumentListResult>()
            };

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != request.AppId))
            {
                nameSearchResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                return nameSearchResponse;
            }

            var response = _createService.CreateServices(request);

            List<RequestSummary> requestSummaries = new();
            RequestSummary summary = new();
            foreach (var serviceReturn in response.CreateServicesResult)
            {
                if (serviceReturn is { ReturnStatus: ReturnStatus.Success })
                {
                    do
                    {
                        GetRequestSummariesRequest summaryRequest = new()
                        {
                            maxWaitSeconds = MaxWaitSeconds,
                            userID = request.userID,
                            password = request.password,
                            requestId = serviceReturn.RequestID
                        };
                        var summaries = _requestSummaries.GetRequestSummaries(summaryRequest);

                        if (summaries != null && summaries.Any())
                        {
                            summary = summaries.First();
                        }
                        if (summary.Status == AsynchronousRequestStatus.Complete)
                            requestSummaries.Add(summary);

                    } while (summary.Status == AsynchronousRequestStatus.Processing);

                }
                else
                {
                    // If any errors, add to error list response 
                    foreach (var returnError in serviceReturn.ReturnErrors)
                    {
                        nameSearchResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(returnError.ErrorDescription, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                    }
                }
            }


            GetResultByID3Request resultById3Request = new()
            {
                company = request.company,
                department = request.department,
                titleOfficer = request.titleOfficer,
                userID = request.userID,
                password = request.password
            };

            if (requestSummaries.Any())
            {
                var resultById3Responses = _getResultsById3.GetResultsByID3(requestSummaries, resultById3Request);

                foreach (var resultById3Response in resultById3Responses)
                {
                    if (resultById3Response.GetResultByID3Result.ReturnStatus == ReturnStatus.Success)
                    {
                        var result3Response = (DocumentListResult)resultById3Response.GetResultByID3Result.Result;
                        nameSearchResponse.DocumentListResults.Add(result3Response);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // If any errors, add to error list response 
                        foreach (var returnError in resultById3Response.GetResultByID3Result.ReturnErrors)
                        {
                            nameSearchResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(returnError.ErrorDescription, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return nameSearchResponse;
        }
    }
}

=================================================

using System.ServiceModel;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiContract.Interfaces;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.AppConfiguration;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Request;
using FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response;
using TitlePointService;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class PriorTitleSearchService : IPriorTitleSearch
    {
        private const int MaxWaitSeconds = 20;

        private readonly ICreateService3 _service3;
        private readonly IGetResultsByID3 _getResultsById3;
        private readonly IRequestSummaries _requestSummaries;
        private readonly ApprovedAppsConfiguration _approvedAppsConfiguration;

        public PriorTitleSearchService(ICreateService3 service3, IGetResultsByID3 getResultsById3,
            IRequestSummaries requestSummaries, ApprovedAppsConfiguration approvedAppsConfiguration)
        {
            _service3 = service3;
            _getResultsById3 = getResultsById3;
            _requestSummaries = requestSummaries;
            _approvedAppsConfiguration = approvedAppsConfiguration;

        }
        public PriorTitleResponse PriorTitleSearch(TitlePointRequest request)
        {
            var priorTitleResponse = new PriorTitleResponse
            {
                StarterResults = new List<StarterResult>()
            };

            if (_approvedAppsConfiguration.AppInfos.All(app => app.AppId != request.AppId))
            {
                priorTitleResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage("Invalid AppId, please provide valid AppId", ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));

                return priorTitleResponse;
            }

            var response = _service3.CreateService(request);

            if (!response.CreateService3Result.ReturnErrors.Any())
            {
                GetRequestSummariesRequest summaryRequest = new()
                {
                    maxWaitSeconds = MaxWaitSeconds,
                    userID = request.userID,
                    password = request.password,
                    requestId = response.CreateService3Result.RequestID
                };
                List<RequestSummary> requestSummaries;
                do
                {
                    requestSummaries = _requestSummaries.GetRequestSummaries(summaryRequest);
                } while (requestSummaries[0].Status == AsynchronousRequestStatus.Processing);

                if (requestSummaries.Any() && requestSummaries.First().Status == AsynchronousRequestStatus.Complete)
                {
                    GetResultByID3Request resultById3Request = new()
                    {
                        company = request.company,
                        department = request.department,
                        titleOfficer = request.titleOfficer,
                        userID = request.userID,
                        password = request.password
                    };

                    var resultById3Responses = _getResultsById3.GetResultsByID3(requestSummaries, resultById3Request);


                    foreach (var resultId3Response in resultById3Responses)
                    {
                        if (resultId3Response.GetResultByID3Result.Result.ResultType == "TitlePoint.StarterResult")
                        {
                            var result3StarterResult = (StarterResult)resultId3Response.GetResultByID3Result.Result;

                            priorTitleResponse.StarterResults.Add(result3StarterResult);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            else
            {
                foreach (var error in response.CreateService3Result.ReturnErrors)
                {
                    priorTitleResponse.Messages.Add(new ResponseMessage(error.ErrorDescription, ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error));
                }
            }

            return priorTitleResponse;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiInfrastructure.Services
{
    public class RequestSummariesService : IRequestSummaries
    {
        private readonly ConnectedServiceConfiguration _connectedServiceConfiguration;
        public RequestSummariesService(ConnectedServiceConfiguration connectedServiceConfiguration)
        {
            _connectedServiceConfiguration = connectedServiceConfiguration;
        }
        public List<RequestSummary> GetRequestSummaries(GetRequestSummariesRequest request)
        {
            var tpsClient = new TpsServiceSoapClient(TpsServiceSoapClient.EndpointConfiguration.TpsServiceSoap);

            tpsClient.Endpoint.Address = new EndpointAddress(_connectedServiceConfiguration.TitlePointServiceBaseAddress);
            List<RequestSummary> requestSummaries = new List<RequestSummary>();

            GetRequestSummariesResponse summaryResponse = tpsClient.GetRequestSummaries(request);

            if (summaryResponse != null)
            {
                requestSummaries.AddRange(summaryResponse.GetRequestSummariesResult.RequestSummaries);
            }

            return requestSummaries;
        }
    }
}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseBase
    {

        private List<ResponseMessage> _messages = new List<ResponseMessage>();

        public virtual bool HasErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error) > 0; }
        }
        public virtual bool HasValidationErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation) > 0; }
        }

        public virtual List<ResponseMessage> Messages
        {
            get { return _messages; }
            private set { _messages = value; }
        }

        public void SetResponseMessage(ResponseMessage msg)
        {
            Messages.Add(msg);
        }

        public void SetMessages(IEnumerable<ResponseMessage> messages)
        {
            if (messages != null)
                Messages.AddRange(messages);
        }
    }
}

FILE: Src\AddressVerification\FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain\Entities\Response\ResponseMessage.cs

using System.Xml.Serialization;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AddressVerification.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseMessage
    {
        public enum LevelEnum { Message = 0, Warning = 1, Debug = 2, Validation = 20, Error = 500 }
        private int _id;
        private string _message;
        private LevelEnum _level;

        [XmlIgnore]

        public LevelEnum Level
        {
            get { return _level; }
            set { _level = value; }
        }

        public string Message
        {
            get { return _message; }
            set { _message = value; }
        }

        public ResponseMessage()
        {

        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
        }

        public ResponseMessage(Exception ex)
        {
            Message = GetExceptionMessageText(ex);
            Level = LevelEnum.Error;

        }

        public ResponseMessage(string message, Exception ex) : this(ex)
        {
            Message = message;
        }

        public static string GetExceptionMessageText(Exception ex)
        {
            string err =
                $"Exception '{ex.Message}' \nTARGET: {ex.TargetSite} \nSOURCE: {ex.Source} \nSTACK: {ex.StackTrace}\n\n  ";
            if (ex.InnerException != null)
                err += GetExceptionMessageText(ex.InnerException);
            return err;
        }

    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.AuditTracking.ApiInfrastructure.Common.Helpers
{
    public static class PredicateBuilder
    {
        /// <summary>    
        /// Creates a predicate that evaluates to true.    
        /// </summary>    
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> True<T>() { return param => true; }

        /// <summary>    
        /// Creates a predicate that evaluates to false.    
        /// </summary>    
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> False<T>() { return param => false; }

        /// <summary>    
        /// Creates a predicate expression from the specified lambda expression.    
        /// </summary>    
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> Create<T>(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate) { return predicate; }

        /// <summary>    
        /// Combines the first predicate with the second using the logical "and".    
        /// </summary>    
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> And<T>(this Expression<Func<T, bool>> first, Expression<Func<T, bool>> second)
        {
            return first.Compose(second, Expression.AndAlso);
        }

        /// <summary>    
        /// Combines the first predicate with the second using the logical "or".    
        /// </summary>    
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> Or<T>(this Expression<Func<T, bool>> first, Expression<Func<T, bool>> second)
        {
            return first.Compose(second, Expression.OrElse);
        }

        /// <summary>    
        /// Negates the predicate.    
        /// </summary>    
        public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> Not<T>(this Expression<Func<T, bool>> expression)
        {
            var negated = Expression.Not(expression.Body);
            return Expression.Lambda<Func<T, bool>>(negated, expression.Parameters);
        }

        /// <summary>    
        /// Combines the first expression with the second using the specified merge function.    
        /// </summary>    
        static Expression<T> Compose<T>(this Expression<T> first, Expression<T> second, Func<Expression, Expression, Expression> merge)
        {
            // zip parameters (map from parameters of second to parameters of first)    
            var map = first.Parameters
                .Select((f, i) => new { f, s = second.Parameters[i] })
                .ToDictionary(p => p.s, p => p.f);

            // replace parameters in the second lambda expression with the parameters in the first    
            var secondBody = ParameterRebinder.ReplaceParameters(map, second.Body);

            // create a merged lambda expression with parameters from the first expression    
            return Expression.Lambda<T>(merge(first.Body, secondBody), first.Parameters);
        }

        class ParameterRebinder : ExpressionVisitor
        {
            readonly Dictionary<ParameterExpression, ParameterExpression> map;

            ParameterRebinder(Dictionary<ParameterExpression, ParameterExpression> map)
            {
                this.map = map ?? new Dictionary<ParameterExpression, ParameterExpression>();
            }

            public static Expression ReplaceParameters(Dictionary<ParameterExpression, ParameterExpression> map, Expression exp)
            {
                return new ParameterRebinder(map).Visit(exp);
            }

            protected override Expression VisitParameter(ParameterExpression p)
            {
                ParameterExpression replacement;

                if (map.TryGetValue(p, out replacement))
                {
                    p = replacement;
                }

                return base.VisitParameter(p);
            }
        }
    }

}

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseBase
    {

        private List<ResponseMessage> _messages = new List<ResponseMessage>();

        public virtual bool HasErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error) > 0; }
        }
        public virtual bool HasValidationErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation) > 0; }
        }

        public virtual List<ResponseMessage> Messages
        {
            get { return _messages; }
            private set { _messages = value; }
        }

        public void SetResponseMessage(ResponseMessage msg)
        {
            Messages.Add(msg);
        }

        public void SetMessages(IEnumerable<ResponseMessage> messages)
        {
            if (messages != null)
                Messages.AddRange(messages);
        }
    }
}

using System.Xml.Serialization;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SmartView.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseMessage
    {
        public enum LevelEnum { Message = 0, Warning = 1, Debug = 2, Validation = 20, Error = 500 }
        private int _id;
        private string _message;
        private LevelEnum _level;
        private string _responsecode;
        private Exception _exceptionThrown;

        [XmlIgnore]
        //public Exception ExceptionThrown
        //{
        //    get { return _exceptionThrown; }
        //    set { _exceptionThrown = value; }
        //}

        //public string ExceptionMessage
        //{
        //    get { return ExceptionThrown != null ? ExceptionThrown.Message : ""; }
        //    set { }
        //}
        //public string ExceptionStackTrace
        //{
        //    get { return ExceptionThrown != null ? ExceptionThrown.StackTrace : ""; }
        //    set { }
        //}

        //public virtual string ResponseCode
        //{
        //    get { return _responsecode; }
        //    set { _responsecode = value; }
        //}

        public LevelEnum Level
        {
            get { return _level; }
            set { _level = value; }
        }

        public string Message
        {
            get { return _message; }
            set { _message = value; }
        }

        //public int Id
        //{
        //    get { return _id; }
        //    set { _id = value; }
        //}

        public ResponseMessage()
        {

        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level, string responseCode)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
            //ResponseCode = responseCode;
        }

        public ResponseMessage(Exception ex)
        {
            Message = GetExceptionMessageText(ex);
            Level = LevelEnum.Error;
            //ExceptionThrown = ex;
            //ResponseCode = "0";

        }

        public ResponseMessage(string message, Exception ex) : this(ex)
        {
            Message = message;
        }

        public static string GetExceptionMessageText(Exception ex)
        {
            string err = string.Format("Exception '{0}' \nTARGET: {1} \nSOURCE: {2} \nSTACK: {3}\n\n  ", ex.Message, ex.TargetSite, ex.Source, ex.StackTrace);
            if (ex.InnerException != null)
                err += GetExceptionMessageText(ex.InnerException);
            return err;
        }

    }
}

FILE: Src\SoftProSdk\FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api\Areas\HelpPage\ApiDescriptionExtensions.cs

using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Web;
using System.Web.Http.Description;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage
{
    public static class ApiDescriptionExtensions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Generates an URI-friendly ID for the <see cref="ApiDescription"/>. E.g. "Get-Values-id_name" instead of "GetValues/{id}?name={name}"
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="description">The <see cref="ApiDescription"/>.</param>
        /// <returns>The ID as a string.</returns>
        public static string GetFriendlyId(this ApiDescription description)
        {
            string path = description.RelativePath;
            string[] urlParts = path.Split('?');
            string localPath = urlParts[0];
            string queryKeyString = null;
            if (urlParts.Length > 1)
            {
                string query = urlParts[1];
                string[] queryKeys = HttpUtility.ParseQueryString(query).AllKeys;
                queryKeyString = String.Join("_", queryKeys);
            }

            StringBuilder friendlyPath = new StringBuilder();
            friendlyPath.AppendFormat("{0}-{1}",
                description.HttpMethod.Method,
                localPath.Replace("/", "-").Replace("{", String.Empty).Replace("}", String.Empty));
            if (queryKeyString != null)
            {
                friendlyPath.AppendFormat("_{0}", queryKeyString.Replace('.', '-'));
            }
            return friendlyPath.ToString();
        }
    }
}

using System.Web.Http;
using System.Web.Mvc;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage
{
    public class HelpPageAreaRegistration : AreaRegistration
    {
        public override string AreaName
        {
            get
            {
                return "HelpPage";
            }
        }

        public override void RegisterArea(AreaRegistrationContext context)
        {
            context.MapRoute(
                "HelpPage_Default",
                "Help/{action}/{apiId}",
                new { controller = "Help", action = "Index", apiId = UrlParameter.Optional });

            HelpPageConfig.Register(GlobalConfiguration.Configuration);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Web.Http;
using System.Web.Http.Controllers;
using System.Web.Http.Description;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage.ModelDescriptions;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage.Models;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage
{
    public static class HelpPageConfigurationExtensions
    {
        private const string ApiModelPrefix = "MS_HelpPageApiModel_";

        /// <summary>
        /// Sets the documentation provider for help page.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config">The <see cref="HttpConfiguration"/>.</param>
        /// <param name="documentationProvider">The documentation provider.</param>
        public static void SetDocumentationProvider(this HttpConfiguration config, IDocumentationProvider documentationProvider)
        {
            config.Services.Replace(typeof(IDocumentationProvider), documentationProvider);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sets the objects that will be used by the formatters to produce sample requests/responses.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config">The <see cref="HttpConfiguration"/>.</param>
        /// <param name="sampleObjects">The sample objects.</param>
        public static void SetSampleObjects(this HttpConfiguration config, IDictionary<Type, object> sampleObjects)
        {
            config.GetHelpPageSampleGenerator().SampleObjects = sampleObjects;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sets the sample request directly for the specified media type and action.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config">The <see cref="HttpConfiguration"/>.</param>
        /// <param name="sample">The sample request.</param>
        /// <param name="mediaType">The media type.</param>
        /// <param name="controllerName">Name of the controller.</param>
        /// <param name="actionName">Name of the action.</param>
        public static void SetSampleRequest(this HttpConfiguration config, object sample, MediaTypeHeaderValue mediaType, string controllerName, string actionName)
        {
            config.GetHelpPageSampleGenerator().ActionSamples.Add(new HelpPageSampleKey(mediaType, SampleDirection.Request, controllerName, actionName, new[] { "*" }), sample);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sets the sample request directly for the specified media type and action with parameters.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config">The <see cref="HttpConfiguration"/>.</param>
        /// <param name="sample">The sample request.</param>
        /// <param name="mediaType">The media type.</param>
        /// <param name="controllerName">Name of the controller.</param>
        /// <param name="actionName">Name of the action.</param>
        /// <param name="parameterNames">The parameter names.</param>
        public static void SetSampleRequest(this HttpConfiguration config, object sample, MediaTypeHeaderValue mediaType, string controllerName, string actionName, params string[] parameterNames)
        {
            config.GetHelpPageSampleGenerator().ActionSamples.Add(new HelpPageSampleKey(mediaType, SampleDirection.Request, controllerName, actionName, parameterNames), sample);
        }

        /// <summary>

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the model description generator.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
        /// <returns>The <see cref="ModelDescriptionGenerator"/></returns>
        public static ModelDescriptionGenerator GetModelDescriptionGenerator(this HttpConfiguration config)
        {
            return (ModelDescriptionGenerator)config.Properties.GetOrAdd(
                typeof(ModelDescriptionGenerator),
                k => InitializeModelDescriptionGenerator(config));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the model that represents an API displayed on the help page. The model is initialized on the first call and cached for subsequent calls.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config">The <see cref="HttpConfiguration"/>.</param>
        /// <param name="apiDescriptionId">The <see cref="ApiDescription"/> ID.</param>
        /// <returns>
        /// An <see cref="HelpPageApiModel"/>
        /// </returns>
        public static HelpPageApiModel GetHelpPageApiModel(this HttpConfiguration config, string apiDescriptionId)
        {
            object model;
            string modelId = ApiModelPrefix + apiDescriptionId;
            if (!config.Properties.TryGetValue(modelId, out model))
            {
                Collection<ApiDescription> apiDescriptions = config.Services.GetApiExplorer().ApiDescriptions;
                ApiDescription apiDescription = apiDescriptions.FirstOrDefault(api => String.Equals(api.GetFriendlyId(), apiDescriptionId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (apiDescription != null)
                {
                    model = GenerateApiModel(apiDescription, config);
                    config.Properties.TryAdd(modelId, model);
                }
            }

            return (HelpPageApiModel)model;
        }

        private static HelpPageApiModel GenerateApiModel(ApiDescription apiDescription, HttpConfiguration config)
        {
            HelpPageApiModel apiModel = new HelpPageApiModel()
            {
                ApiDescription = apiDescription,
            };

            ModelDescriptionGenerator modelGenerator = config.GetModelDescriptionGenerator();
            HelpPageSampleGenerator sampleGenerator = config.GetHelpPageSampleGenerator();
            GenerateUriParameters(apiModel, modelGenerator);
            GenerateRequestModelDescription(apiModel, modelGenerator, sampleGenerator);
            GenerateResourceDescription(apiModel, modelGenerator);
            GenerateSamples(apiModel, sampleGenerator);

            return apiModel;
        }

        private static void GenerateUriParameters(HelpPageApiModel apiModel, ModelDescriptionGenerator modelGenerator)
        {
            ApiDescription apiDescription = apiModel.ApiDescription;
            foreach (ApiParameterDescription apiParameter in apiDescription.ParameterDescriptions)
            {
                if (apiParameter.Source == ApiParameterSource.FromUri)
                {
                    HttpParameterDescriptor parameterDescriptor = apiParameter.ParameterDescriptor;
                    Type parameterType = null;
                    ModelDescription typeDescription = null;
                    ComplexTypeModelDescription complexTypeDescription = null;
                    if (parameterDescriptor != null)
                    {
                        parameterType = parameterDescriptor.ParameterType;
                        typeDescription = modelGenerator.GetOrCreateModelDescription(parameterType);
                        complexTypeDescription = typeDescription as ComplexTypeModelDescription;
                    }

                    // Example:
                    // [TypeConverter(typeof(PointConverter))]
                    // public class Point
                    // {
                    //     public Point(int x, int y)
                    //     {
                    //         X = x;
                    //         Y = y;
                    //     }
                    //     public int X { get; set; }
                    //     public int Y { get; set; }
                    // }
                    // Class Point is bindable with a TypeConverter, so Point will be added to UriParameters collection.
                    // 
                    // public class Point
                    // {
                    //     public int X { get; set; }
                    //     public int Y { get; set; }
                    // }
                    // Regular complex class Point will have properties X and Y added to UriParameters collection.
                    if (complexTypeDescription != null
                        && !IsBindableWithTypeConverter(parameterType))
                    {
                        foreach (ParameterDescription uriParameter in complexTypeDescription.Properties)
                        {
                            apiModel.UriParameters.Add(uriParameter);
                        }
                    }
                    else if (parameterDescriptor != null)
                    {
                        ParameterDescription uriParameter =
                            AddParameterDescription(apiModel, apiParameter, typeDescription);

                        if (!parameterDescriptor.IsOptional)
                        {
                            uriParameter.Annotations.Add(new ParameterAnnotation() { Documentation = "Required" });
                        }

                        object defaultValue = parameterDescriptor.DefaultValue;
                        if (defaultValue != null)
                        {
                            uriParameter.Annotations.Add(new ParameterAnnotation() { Documentation = "Default value is " + Convert.ToString(defaultValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Debug.Assert(parameterDescriptor == null);

                        // If parameterDescriptor is null, this is an undeclared route parameter which only occurs
                        // when source is FromUri. Ignored in request model and among resource parameters but listed
                        // as a simple string here.
                        ModelDescription modelDescription = modelGenerator.GetOrCreateModelDescription(typeof(string));
                        AddParameterDescription(apiModel, apiParameter, modelDescription);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool IsBindableWithTypeConverter(Type parameterType)
        {
            if (parameterType == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            return TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(parameterType).CanConvertFrom(typeof(string));
        }

        private static ParameterDescription AddParameterDescription(HelpPageApiModel apiModel,
            ApiParameterDescription apiParameter, ModelDescription typeDescription)
        {
            ParameterDescription parameterDescription = new ParameterDescription
            {
                Name = apiParameter.Name,
                Documentation = apiParameter.Documentation,
                TypeDescription = typeDescription,
            };

            apiModel.UriParameters.Add(parameterDescription);
            return parameterDescription;
        }

        private static void GenerateRequestModelDescription(HelpPageApiModel apiModel, ModelDescriptionGenerator modelGenerator, HelpPageSampleGenerator sampleGenerator)
        {
            ApiDescription apiDescription = apiModel.ApiDescription;
            foreach (ApiParameterDescription apiParameter in apiDescription.ParameterDescriptions)
            {
                if (apiParameter.Source == ApiParameterSource.FromBody)
                {
                    Type parameterType = apiParameter.ParameterDescriptor.ParameterType;
                    apiModel.RequestModelDescription = modelGenerator.GetOrCreateModelDescription(parameterType);
                    apiModel.RequestDocumentation = apiParameter.Documentation;
                }
                else if (apiParameter.ParameterDescriptor != null &&
                    apiParameter.ParameterDescriptor.ParameterType == typeof(HttpRequestMessage))
                {
                    Type parameterType = sampleGenerator.ResolveHttpRequestMessageType(apiDescription);

                    if (parameterType != null)
                    {
                        apiModel.RequestModelDescription = modelGenerator.GetOrCreateModelDescription(parameterType);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private static void GenerateResourceDescription(HelpPageApiModel apiModel, ModelDescriptionGenerator modelGenerator)
        {
            ResponseDescription response = apiModel.ApiDescription.ResponseDescription;
            Type responseType = response.ResponseType ?? response.DeclaredType;
            if (responseType != null && responseType != typeof(void))
            {
                apiModel.ResourceDescription = modelGenerator.GetOrCreateModelDescription(responseType);
            }
        }

        [SuppressMessage("Microsoft.Design", "CA1031:DoNotCatchGeneralExceptionTypes", Justification = "The exception is recorded as ErrorMessages.")]
        private static void GenerateSamples(HelpPageApiModel apiModel, HelpPageSampleGenerator sampleGenerator)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var item in sampleGenerator.GetSampleRequests(apiModel.ApiDescription))
                {
                    apiModel.SampleRequests.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
                    LogInvalidSampleAsError(apiModel, item.Value);
                }

                foreach (var item in sampleGenerator.GetSampleResponses(apiModel.ApiDescription))
                {
                    apiModel.SampleResponses.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
                    LogInvalidSampleAsError(apiModel, item.Value);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                apiModel.ErrorMessages.Add(String.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                    "An exception has occurred while generating the sample. Exception message: {0}",
                    HelpPageSampleGenerator.UnwrapException(e).Message));
            }
        }

        private static bool TryGetResourceParameter(ApiDescription apiDescription, HttpConfiguration config, out ApiParameterDescription parameterDescription, out Type resourceType)
        {
            parameterDescription = apiDescription.ParameterDescriptions.FirstOrDefault(
                p => p.Source == ApiParameterSource.FromBody ||
                    (p.ParameterDescriptor != null && p.ParameterDescriptor.ParameterType == typeof(HttpRequestMessage)));

            if (parameterDescription == null)
            {
                resourceType = null;
                return false;
            }

            resourceType = parameterDescription.ParameterDescriptor.ParameterType;

            if (resourceType == typeof(HttpRequestMessage))
            {
                HelpPageSampleGenerator sampleGenerator = config.GetHelpPageSampleGenerator();
                resourceType = sampleGenerator.ResolveHttpRequestMessageType(apiDescription);
            }

            if (resourceType == null)
            {
                parameterDescription = null;
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        private static ModelDescriptionGenerator InitializeModelDescriptionGenerator(HttpConfiguration config)
        {
            ModelDescriptionGenerator modelGenerator = new ModelDescriptionGenerator(config);
            Collection<ApiDescription> apis = config.Services.GetApiExplorer().ApiDescriptions;
            foreach (ApiDescription api in apis)
            {
                ApiParameterDescription parameterDescription;
                Type parameterType;
                if (TryGetResourceParameter(api, config, out parameterDescription, out parameterType))
                {
                    modelGenerator.GetOrCreateModelDescription(parameterType);
                }
            }
            return modelGenerator;
        }

        private static void LogInvalidSampleAsError(HelpPageApiModel apiModel, object sample)
        {
            InvalidSample invalidSample = sample as InvalidSample;
            if (invalidSample != null)
            {
                apiModel.ErrorMessages.Add(invalidSample.ErrorMessage);
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Web.Http.Controllers;
using System.Web.Http.Description;
using System.Xml.XPath;
using FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage.ModelDescriptions;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.SoftProSdk.Api.Areas.HelpPage
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A custom <see cref="IDocumentationProvider"/> that reads the API documentation from an XML documentation file.
    /// </summary>
    public class XmlDocumentationProvider : IDocumentationProvider, IModelDocumentationProvider
    {
        private XPathNavigator _documentNavigator;
        private const string TypeExpression = "/doc/members/member[@name='T:{0}']";
        private const string MethodExpression = "/doc/members/member[@name='M:{0}']";
        private const string PropertyExpression = "/doc/members/member[@name='P:{0}']";
        private const string FieldExpression = "/doc/members/member[@name='F:{0}']";
        private const string ParameterExpression = "param[@name='{0}']";

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="XmlDocumentationProvider"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="documentPath">The physical path to XML document.</param>
        public XmlDocumentationProvider(string documentPath)
        {
            if (documentPath == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException("documentPath");
            }
            XPathDocument xpath = new XPathDocument(documentPath);
            _documentNavigator = xpath.CreateNavigator();
        }

        public string GetDocumentation(HttpControllerDescriptor controllerDescriptor)
        {
            XPathNavigator typeNode = GetTypeNode(controllerDescriptor.ControllerType);
            return GetTagValue(typeNode, "summary");
        }

        public virtual string GetDocumentation(HttpActionDescriptor actionDescriptor)
        {
            XPathNavigator methodNode = GetMethodNode(actionDescriptor);
            return GetTagValue(methodNode, "summary");
        }

        public virtual string GetDocumentation(HttpParameterDescriptor parameterDescriptor)
        {
            ReflectedHttpParameterDescriptor reflectedParameterDescriptor = parameterDescriptor as ReflectedHttpParameterDescriptor;
            if (reflectedParameterDescriptor != null)
            {
                XPathNavigator methodNode = GetMethodNode(reflectedParameterDescriptor.ActionDescriptor);
                if (methodNode != null)
                {
                    string parameterName = reflectedParameterDescriptor.ParameterInfo.Name;
                    XPathNavigator parameterNode = methodNode.SelectSingleNode(String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ParameterExpression, parameterName));
                    if (parameterNode != null)
                    {
                        return parameterNode.Value.Trim();
                    }
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        public string GetResponseDocumentation(HttpActionDescriptor actionDescriptor)
        {
            XPathNavigator methodNode = GetMethodNode(actionDescriptor);
            return GetTagValue(methodNode, "returns");
        }

        public string GetDocumentation(MemberInfo member)
        {
            string memberName = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", GetTypeName(member.DeclaringType), member.Name);
            string expression = member.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field ? FieldExpression : PropertyExpression;
            string selectExpression = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, expression, memberName);
            XPathNavigator propertyNode = _documentNavigator.SelectSingleNode(selectExpression);
            return GetTagValue(propertyNode, "summary");
        }

        public string GetDocumentation(Type type)
        {
            XPathNavigator typeNode = GetTypeNode(type);
            return GetTagValue(typeNode, "summary");
        }

        private XPathNavigator GetMethodNode(HttpActionDescriptor actionDescriptor)
        {
            ReflectedHttpActionDescriptor reflectedActionDescriptor = actionDescriptor as ReflectedHttpActionDescriptor;
            if (reflectedActionDescriptor != null)
            {
                string selectExpression = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, MethodExpression, GetMemberName(reflectedActionDescriptor.MethodInfo));
                return _documentNavigator.SelectSingleNode(selectExpression);
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string GetMemberName(MethodInfo method)
        {
            string name = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", GetTypeName(method.DeclaringType), method.Name);
            ParameterInfo[] parameters = method.GetParameters();
            if (parameters.Length != 0)
            {
                string[] parameterTypeNames = parameters.Select(param => GetTypeName(param.ParameterType)).ToArray();
                name += String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0})", String.Join(",", parameterTypeNames));
            }

            return name;
        }

        private static string GetTagValue(XPathNavigator parentNode, string tagName)
        {
            if (parentNode != null)
            {
                XPathNavigator node = parentNode.SelectSingleNode(tagName);
                if (node != null)
                {
                    return node.Value.Trim();
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private XPathNavigator GetTypeNode(Type type)
        {
            string controllerTypeName = GetTypeName(type);
            string selectExpression = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, TypeExpression, controllerTypeName);
            return _documentNavigator.SelectSingleNode(selectExpression);
        }

        private static string GetTypeName(Type type)
        {
            string name = type.FullName;
            if (type.IsGenericType)
            {
                // Format the generic type name to something like: Generic{System.Int32,System.String}
                Type genericType = type.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
                Type[] genericArguments = type.GetGenericArguments();
                string genericTypeName = genericType.FullName;

                // Trim the generic parameter counts from the name
                genericTypeName = genericTypeName.Substring(0, genericTypeName.IndexOf('`'));
                string[] argumentTypeNames = genericArguments.Select(t => GetTypeName(t)).ToArray();
                name = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{{{1}}}", genericTypeName, String.Join(",", argumentTypeNames));
            }
            if (type.IsNested)
            {
                // Changing the nested type name from OuterType+InnerType to OuterType.InnerType to match the XML documentation syntax.
                name = name.Replace("+", ".");
            }

            return name;
        }
    }
}

        private static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding GetBindingForEndpoint(EndpointConfiguration endpointConfiguration)
        {
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsImageSoap))
            {
                System.ServiceModel.BasicHttpBinding result = new System.ServiceModel.BasicHttpBinding();
                result.MaxBufferSize = int.MaxValue;
                result.ReaderQuotas = System.Xml.XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max;
                result.MaxReceivedMessageSize = int.MaxValue;
                result.AllowCookies = true;
                result.Security.Mode = System.ServiceModel.BasicHttpSecurityMode.Transport;
                return result;
            }
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsImageSoap12))
            {
                System.ServiceModel.Channels.CustomBinding result = new System.ServiceModel.Channels.CustomBinding();
                System.ServiceModel.Channels.TextMessageEncodingBindingElement textBindingElement = new System.ServiceModel.Channels.TextMessageEncodingBindingElement();
                textBindingElement.MessageVersion = System.ServiceModel.Channels.MessageVersion.CreateVersion(System.ServiceModel.EnvelopeVersion.Soap12, System.ServiceModel.Channels.AddressingVersion.None);
                result.Elements.Add(textBindingElement);
                System.ServiceModel.Channels.HttpsTransportBindingElement httpsBindingElement = new System.ServiceModel.Channels.HttpsTransportBindingElement();
                httpsBindingElement.AllowCookies = true;
                httpsBindingElement.MaxBufferSize = int.MaxValue;
                httpsBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = int.MaxValue;
                result.Elements.Add(httpsBindingElement);
                return result;
            }
            throw new System.InvalidOperationException(string.Format("Could not find endpoint with name \'{0}\'.", endpointConfiguration));
        }

        private static System.ServiceModel.EndpointAddress GetEndpointAddress(EndpointConfiguration endpointConfiguration)
        {
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsImageSoap))
            {
                return new System.ServiceModel.EndpointAddress("https://qa2.titlepoint.biz/TitlePointServices/tpsimage.asmx");
            }
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsImageSoap12))
            {
                return new System.ServiceModel.EndpointAddress("https://qa2.titlepoint.biz/TitlePointServices/tpsimage.asmx");
            }
            throw new System.InvalidOperationException(string.Format("Could not find endpoint with name \'{0}\'.", endpointConfiguration));
        }

        {
            return base.Channel.DeleteItemAsync(request);
        }

        public virtual System.Threading.Tasks.Task OpenAsync()

        {

        }

        private static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding GetBindingForEndpoint(EndpointConfiguration endpointConfiguration)
        {
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsServiceSoap))
            {
                System.ServiceModel.BasicHttpBinding result = new System.ServiceModel.BasicHttpBinding();
                result.MaxBufferSize = int.MaxValue;
                result.ReaderQuotas = System.Xml.XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max;
                result.MaxReceivedMessageSize = int.MaxValue;
                result.AllowCookies = true;
                result.Security.Mode = System.ServiceModel.BasicHttpSecurityMode.Transport;
                return result;
            }
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsServiceSoap12))
            {
                System.ServiceModel.Channels.CustomBinding result = new System.ServiceModel.Channels.CustomBinding();
                System.ServiceModel.Channels.TextMessageEncodingBindingElement textBindingElement = new System.ServiceModel.Channels.TextMessageEncodingBindingElement();
                textBindingElement.MessageVersion = System.ServiceModel.Channels.MessageVersion.CreateVersion(System.ServiceModel.EnvelopeVersion.Soap12, System.ServiceModel.Channels.AddressingVersion.None);
                result.Elements.Add(textBindingElement);
                System.ServiceModel.Channels.HttpsTransportBindingElement httpsBindingElement = new System.ServiceModel.Channels.HttpsTransportBindingElement();
                httpsBindingElement.AllowCookies = true;
                httpsBindingElement.MaxBufferSize = int.MaxValue;
                httpsBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = int.MaxValue;
                result.Elements.Add(httpsBindingElement);
                return result;
            }
            throw new System.InvalidOperationException(string.Format("Could not find endpoint with name \'{0}\'.", endpointConfiguration));
        }

        private static System.ServiceModel.EndpointAddress GetEndpointAddress(EndpointConfiguration endpointConfiguration)
        {
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsServiceSoap))
            {
                return new System.ServiceModel.EndpointAddress("https://qa2.TitlePoint.biz/TitlePointServices/TpsService.asmx");
            }
            if ((endpointConfiguration == EndpointConfiguration.TpsServiceSoap12))
            {
                return new System.ServiceModel.EndpointAddress("https://qa2.TitlePoint.biz/TitlePointServices/TpsService.asmx");
            }
            throw new System.InvalidOperationException(string.Format("Could not find endpoint with name \'{0}\'.", endpointConfiguration));
        }

        public enum EndpointConfiguration
        {

            TpsServiceSoap,

            TpsServiceSoap12,
        }
    }

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseBase
    {

        private List<ResponseMessage> _messages = new List<ResponseMessage>();

        public virtual bool HasErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Error) > 0; }
        }
        public virtual bool HasValidationErrors
        {
            get { return Messages.Count(i => i.Level == ResponseMessage.LevelEnum.Validation) > 0; }
        }

        public virtual List<ResponseMessage> Messages
        {
            get { return _messages; }
            private set { _messages = value; }
        }

        public void SetResponseMessage(ResponseMessage msg)
        {
            Messages.Add(msg);
        }

        public void SetMessages(IEnumerable<ResponseMessage> messages)
        {
            if (messages != null)
                Messages.AddRange(messages);
        }
    }
}

using System.Xml.Serialization;

namespace FNF.CommonApi.TitlePoint.ApiDomain.Entities.Response
{
    public class ResponseMessage
    {
        public enum LevelEnum { Message = 0, Warning = 1, Debug = 2, Validation = 20, Error = 500 }
        private int _id;
        private string _message;
        private LevelEnum _level;
        private string _responsecode;
        private Exception _exceptionThrown;

        [XmlIgnore]
        //public Exception ExceptionThrown
        //{
        //    get { return _exceptionThrown; }
        //    set { _exceptionThrown = value; }
        //}

        //public string ExceptionMessage
        //{
        //    get { return ExceptionThrown != null ? ExceptionThrown.Message : ""; }
        //    set { }
        //}
        //public string ExceptionStackTrace
        //{
        //    get { return ExceptionThrown != null ? ExceptionThrown.StackTrace : ""; }
        //    set { }
        //}

        //public virtual string ResponseCode
        //{
        //    get { return _responsecode; }
        //    set { _responsecode = value; }
        //}

        public LevelEnum Level
        {
            get { return _level; }
            set { _level = value; }
        }

        public string Message
        {
            get { return _message; }
            set { _message = value; }
        }

        //public int Id
        //{
        //    get { return _id; }
        //    set { _id = value; }
        //}

        public ResponseMessage()
        {

        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
        }
        public ResponseMessage(string message, LevelEnum level, string responseCode)
        {
            Message = message;
            Level = level;
            //ResponseCode = responseCode;
        }

        public ResponseMessage(Exception ex)
        {
            Message = GetExceptionMessageText(ex);
            Level = LevelEnum.Error;
            //ExceptionThrown = ex;
            //ResponseCode = "0";

        }

        public ResponseMessage(string message, Exception ex) : this(ex)
        {
            Message = message;
        }

        public static string GetExceptionMessageText(Exception ex)
        {
            string err = string.Format("Exception '{0}' \nTARGET: {1} \nSOURCE: {2} \nSTACK: {3}\n\n  ", ex.Message, ex.TargetSite, ex.Source, ex.StackTrace);
            if (ex.InnerException != null)
                err += GetExceptionMessageText(ex.InnerException);
            return err;
        }

    }

        private static object GeneratePageResult(HelpPageSampleGenerator sampleGenerator, Type type)
        {
            if (type.IsGenericType)
            {
                Type openGenericType = type.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
                if (openGenericType == typeof(PageResult<>))

                    Debug.Assert(typeParameters.Length == 1);

                    // Create an enumeration to pass as the first parameter to the PageResult<T> constuctor
                    Type itemsType = typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(typeParameters);
                    object items = sampleGenerator.GetSampleObject(itemsType);

                    // Fill in the other information needed to invoke the PageResult<T> constuctor
                    Type[] parameterTypes = new Type[] { itemsType, typeof(Uri), typeof(long?), };
                    object[] parameters = new object[] { items, null, (long)ObjectGenerator.DefaultCollectionSize, };

                    // Call PageResult(IEnumerable<T> items, Uri nextPageLink, long? count) constructor
                    ConstructorInfo constructor = type.GetConstructor(parameterTypes);
                    return constructor.Invoke(parameters);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }
#endif
    }
}
